jobs.title: Head of Technology & Data Business - Indonesia
jobs.descriptionHtml: You will lead a distributed team across Indonesia, India, the Philippines, and Sri Lanka: * **Product Leadership —** discovery, roadmap, requirements, prioritization, and design partners (pilot clients). * **Data Product —** methodology, models, datasets, analytics, and rapid prototyping. * **Engineering —** architecture, APIs, systems of record, delivery, and reliability. * **Sales & Monetization —** a new [VP] role you will hire, driving pipeline development and sales execution. * **UX/UI Design —** a new role you will hire, owning user flows and interface design. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**: **1. Commercial Strategy & P&L** * Own overall commercial outcomes for IIX Fintech: P&L, revenue targets, budget, pricing, and unit economics * Set commercial strategy, targets, and pricing; the Sales & Monetization lead drives pipeline development and sales execution against them * Build and execute a 3–5 year growth strategy that positions IIX as a technology-driven player in impact finance * Lead closing of strategic contracts with institutional clients, investors, and partners * Scan the market continuously — strategy meetings, industry conferences, competitor tracking — to identify white spaces where IIX has a defensible value proposition **2. Product Portfolio & Go-to-Market** * Take Proofloop and Capital OS from pilot to paying customers, including the flagship launch at the Singapore Fintech Festival 2027 * Run a product-led process: customer discovery first, then build — working backwards from customer problems, not internal specifications * Require evidence of willingness to pay (such as design partner commitments, letters of intent, or paid pilots) before committing significant development resources * Manage the product roadmap and prioritization with the Product Lead; recruit design partners to test new products * Define pricing, packaging, and positioning for institutional buyers — investors, financial institutions, corporates, and development finance institutions **3. Data Strategy & Monetization** * Build a shared data foundation (90,000+ MSME data points, impact verification data) that enables multiple products across IIX Fintech * Pursue external data monetization only where there is a validated customer need * Oversee methodology, models, and datasets with the Data Product team; ensure data privacy and compliance standards are met **4. Embedding Product Thinking Across IIX** * Work with business unit leads to identify and package their own products and pilots, so product-led thinking is distributed across IIX * Partner with Asset Management and Advisory to embed data and analytics into investment strategies, client reporting, and advisory solutions * Engage IIX Institute as an integration partner on certification and training linked to IIX Values scoring **5. Team Leadership** * Lead a distributed team spanning product, data, engineering, sales, and design * Hire the Sales & Monetization lead and UX/UI Designer, and build the team as products scale * Set team KPIs, operating rhythm, and a culture of rapid iteration, ownership, and learning from failure * Balance support for existing platforms with protected capacity for new product development * Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent aligned with IIX's mission and PREM values **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** * **First 90 days:** Take over Proofloop and Capital OS; validate pricing with at least 3 target customers; hire the Sales & Monetization lead and UX/UI Designer; agree team KPIs and roadmap with leadership. * **6 months:** At least 2 design partners live on a priority product; sales pipeline built against agreed lead, pipeline-value, and conversion targets. * **12 months:** First signed revenue contracts; flagship product launched at the Singapore Fintech Festival 2027; repeatable product discovery process adopted by business units. **Experience & Skills** * Typically 15+ years across fintech, digital platforms, financial services, or technology businesses; we prioritize demonstrated commercial ownership, product execution, and technical fluency over tenure * Proven track record of taking technology products to market and generating revenue, with P&L or revenue ownership; founder, co-founder, or Chief Product Officer experience is a strong advantage * A blend of structured corporate experience and startup or venture-building experience * Hands-on understanding of the product and software development life cycle: discovery, roadmap, prototyping, release, and iteration * B2B or enterprise sales to institutional buyers such as financial institutions, investors, DFIs, or governments * Emerging markets experience in Southeast Asia, South Asia, or Africa, including navigating regulatory environments * Experience leading distributed, multi-country teams * Product management and go-to-market strategy, including pricing and packaging * Data strategy and data product design; working familiarity with analytics tools (e.g., Python, SQL, BI tools) and AI/ML applications * Strong grasp of UX/UI principles and user-centered design * Understanding of financial markets and ESG/impact measurement preferred * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Administration, or a related field; a Master's is an advantage

jobs.title: Associate CSSC Back Office Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: As our new **Associate CSSC Application Engineer, IND**, you'll be providing technical application engineering support for industrial pump selections and system configurations that ensure customers across the globe receive optimal, reliable solutions. **What you will be doing** As a key part of the Customer Sales & Service Centre (CSSC) team, you'll create impact by delivering accurate, timely technical recommendations that help industrial customers maximize efficiency and performance in their operations. **Your main responsibilities include:** * Evaluate customer inquiries and provide technically sound pump and system selections for industrial applications * Perform hydraulic calculations, product sizing, and system analysis to recommend optimal Grundfos solutions * Collaborate with sales teams and customers to clarify technical requirements and resolve application challenges * Prepare and review technical quotations, ensuring accuracy in product specifications and pricing * Support the sales organization with technical documentation, drawings, and application guidance * Continuously develop product and application knowledge to stay current with Grundfos industrial offerings **What makes you a great fit** Above all, you're a technically curious engineer with strong problem-solving skills, a customer-oriented mindset, and a solid foundation in fluid mechanics or mechanical engineering. We'd also imagine that you are/have: * Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline * 1-3 years of experience in application engineering, or technical sales support * Proficiency in technical calculation tools and Microsoft Office; comfort learning new selection software **It's a plus if you also:** * Experience with Grundfos products or similar industrial pump manufacturers * Working knowledge of SAP, CRM or ERP systems used in a sales support environment **Why you'll love working here** Day to day, you can look forward to: * Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well-being activities. * Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering. * On-demand training and structured development programmes to support your growth. Valuing our differences helps us see possibilities where others can't. We therefore welcome and encourage applications from all abilities, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our commitment to a safe and compliant hiring process, final candidates may be required to undergo a background check, subject to applicable local laws and regulations. **Join Grundfos, apply today!**

jobs.title: General Process Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **Job Descriptions** * Develop, configure, and optimize industrial processes from inception through startup and certification. * Assess and evaluate production processes by taking accurate measurements and interpreting data. * Design and implement innovative processes, systems, and solutions to enhance production rates and output quality. * Manage the introduction of new products and processes into the production environment for mass production. * Maintain and reduce production costs and time constraints to ensure efficient operations. * Perform risk assessments to identify potential failures in the production process through PFMEA/DFMEA. * Review design for manufacturability (ease of assembly), 2D Review, 3D Review, develop BOM, assembly chronology, and prepare standard work instructions. ### **Requirements** **Educational Qualification:** * Minimum Diploma (D3/D4) in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related field. **Experience:** * Experience in process simulations and various manufacturing systems and improvements such as Kaizen, lean manufacturing, PFMEA, and PDCA. **Technical Skills:** * Have an understanding of new product development processes. * Have the ability to analyze statistical data. * Have the ability to use CAD/CAM (Experience with Solidworks or Onshape is a plus). * Have knowledge of process-related standards and health-safety regulations. * Have a working knowledge of using process engineering software. **Soft Skills:** * Excellent problem-solving, critical thinking, and analytical skills. * Good communication skills in English, both oral and written. * Effective communication and teamwork skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams. ### **How to Apply** * Please fill in your personal data via the link below (Duration : ± 30 minutes) Apply Now * After submit the personal data, you will get the PIN number to do the online test (will appear on a pop-up message and sent to your email) * Click the PIN number to start the online test (Duration : ± 30 minutes) *Notes:* *- Pin number is only valid once* *- The online test is related to basic mechanical and logical thinking.* Best of luck! If you have any questions or problems during this stage, please reach us at email **forindojob@formulatrix.com** or Whatsapp 085741651917

jobs.title: Software Developer Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml: We are looking for a Software Developer Lead to guide a team building and running system-integration products. You will turn business requirements into production outcomes by shaping architecture, making and communicating technical decisions, and helping engineers deliver and improve continuously. We want someone who stays hands-on and technically credible, while raising the quality of decisions across the team and working well with other teams, external partners, and non-technical stakeholders. **Responsibilities:** **1. System Design and Architecture** * Translate business requirements into technical solutions, defining components, service boundaries, APIs, data flows, and data models. * Choose between synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns and evaluate architectural trade-offs. * Consider scalability, reliability, security, observability, and maintainability from the start. **2. System Integration** * Design and oversee integrations with internal services and external or third-party systems (REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven flows). * Define how the system behaves under timeouts, retries, duplicate requests, partial failures, and inconsistent data, including idempotency and reconciliation. * Own API contracts, versioning, authentication and authorization, and data ownership across system boundaries. **3. Technical Leadership** * Make and document technical decisions, including the alternatives considered and the reasons for the choice. * Set technical direction, resolve technical disagreements, and constructively challenge proposals. * Guide, mentor, and unblock engineers, and establish engineering practices within the team. * Identify technical risks early and escalate appropriately. **4. Technical Execution** * Take part in code reviews, design reviews, technical planning, and testing strategy. * Debug and troubleshoot production issues, and identify and manage technical debt. * Move between architecture, service design, API and data model, implementation, and production concerns. **5. Communication and Collaboration** * Explain technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs clearly to engineers, product, and management. * Collaborate with other Tech Leads, teams, and external partners, and raise problems proactively. * Produce clear technical documentation. **Requirements** * Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline. * Minimum 7+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong software engineering fundamentals and proven hands-on experience building production systems. * Strong system design skills, able to independently design a moderately complex system and explain its components, data flow, API boundaries, data model, failure scenarios, and scalability considerations. * Real-world experience integrating multiple systems, including external or third-party ones, and handling unavailable dependencies, timeouts, duplicate requests, partial failures, and data inconsistencies. * Solid understanding of APIs and service communication: REST, API contracts, versioning, authentication and authorization, rate limiting, and webhooks. * Understanding of data modelling, data ownership, consistency, and reliability. * Demonstrated ability to make technical decisions, provide direction, guide engineers, and explain trade-offs. * Ability to review designs and implementations, and to troubleshoot production problems. * Clear verbal and written communication, with the ability to adapt the message for technical and non-technical audiences. * Ownership mindset and proactive, cross-team collaboration. * Coming from Top University will be a plus consideration **Nice-to-have experience:** * Experience with distributed systems and event-driven architecture. * Experience with message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Pub/Sub. * Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure), plus Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code. * Familiarity with Go, Java, .NET, or React/Next.js. Equivalent experience is welcome, since we value transferable fundamentals over a specific stack. * Experience with SQL and NoSQL data stores, advanced observability, and security architecture. * Domain exposure to payment systems, ERP/CRM, enterprise integration, or government and third-party integrations. * Experience with large-scale systems, architecture governance, engineering standards, or influencing multiple teams. **Benefits** By submitting your resume/CV, you consent and agree to allow the information provided to be used and processed by or on behalf of Xtremax Pte Ltd for purposes related to your registration of interest in current or future employment with us and for the processing of your application for employment. The personal data held by us relating to your application will be kept strictly confidential and in accordance with the PDPA. You may also refer to our Privacy Policy for more details here: https://www.xtremax.com/privacy-policy.

jobs.title: Principal Mechanical Design Engineer (Data Center)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Overview** We are looking for Senior/Principal Mechanical Engineer to join our Indonesia team. The ideal candidate will lead the mechanical design efforts for our regional data center projects, while training junior team members. This role involves collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, managing project timelines, and ensuring systems meet the highest industry standards. **Key Responsibilities** * Lead the design of mechanical systems for data centers and other critical facilities while ensuring compliance with local and international regulations. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers. * Conduct load calculations and system assessments to determine heating and cooling requirements. * Develop detailed equipment specifications, selection criteria, and performance metrics. * Review technical drawings, schematics, and construction documentation. * Assist in developing HVAC system strategies for high-efficiency, sustainable designs. * Liaise with design teams across the APAC region to ensure alignment on project objectives, best practices, and design standards. * Act as the primary point of contact for clients, understanding their needs and ensuring that project deliverables meet their expectations. * Facilitate coordination between various disciplines (MEP, Architecture, structural, civil) to ensure integrated design solutions **Skills & Qualifications** **Required Skills** * Proficient in **design software** (e.g., AutoCAD, Revit, Navisworks, HAP, pipe and duct sizing) * Knowledge in relevant **Data Center codes** (TIA, Uptime, ASHRAE TC 9.9) * Strong leadership and communication skills * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. * Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines. **Education & Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in **Mechanical Engineering** or related field * **Fluency in English** * **7-15 years of experience in Mechanical design consultancy, including in Data Centres projects** * **Proven experience in managing a team and mentoring junior staff,** either within the same office or across different countries Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Responsibilities** * ⁠Collect, clean, process, and analyze data to generate actionable business insights and support data-driven decision-making. * Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualizations to monitor business and operational performance. * ⁠Identify opportunities to improve business processes through data analytics, AI implementation, and workflow automation. * Develop and maintain internal web-based tools and applications to support business and operational needs. * ⁠Build AI-powered solutions by integrating existing AI tools, models, and APIs into internal applications. * ⁠Integrate data, databases, and APIs to support internal applications and automation. * Collaborate with internal stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions. * Perform testing, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of internal applications and AI-based solutions. **Requirements** * ⁠Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Statistics, Informatics Engineering, or a related field. * 1–2 years of experience in Data Analytics, Software Development, or a related role. Fresh graduates with relevant projects or portfolios are welcome to apply. * Proficient in SQL and Python for data processing, analysis, and automation. * Familiar with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker Studio. * Basic understanding of web development and database management. * Familiarity with web development frameworks (e.g., React, Next.js, Node.js, Flask, or FastAPI), AI API integration, and workflow automation tools such as n8n is a plus. * Able to translate business requirements into practical technical solutions. * Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and communication skills. * ⁠Willing to work under a hybrid arrangement across our Cirendeu and Daan Mogot offices. **About Segari** Launched in 2020, Segari is one of the fastest growing commerce grocery start-ups in Indonesia, delivering fresh produce to consumers around Jakarta, Tangerang, and Bekasi areas. Founded by Yosua Setiawan, Farandy Ramadhana, and Farand Anugerah, Segari was initiated to help solving Indonesia’s age-old agriculture supply chain issue and a mission to make e-grocery and the end-to-end supply chain in Indonesia to be more efficient and reliable within 15 hours delivery from farm to table. A seamless grocery shopping experience is consistently being committed by Segari to provide a full range of high-quality groceries across fruit, vegetables, meat and staples categories at the best price. Within less than 12 months of operation, Segari has achieved over 20 times growth in users, number of platform transactions, and revenues (AC Insights, 2021) while empowering local farmer communities and providing the best quality of fresh produce to support Indonesian moms in providing healthy and nutritious food for their families. Follow us to know more about job openings and exciting updates on Life at Segari (Instagram: @lifeatsegari)

jobs.title: Specification Engineer Intern (Software Requirements & Testing)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Specification Engineer Intern (Software Requirements & Testing)** * **Location:** Yogyakarta, Indonesia * **Work Arrangement:** Full-time, On-site * **Working Hours:** Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00 WIB **About the Role** Zettabyte is looking for a **Specification Engineer Intern** who is passionate about software technology, analytical thinking, and technical documentation. In this role, you will work closely with our engineering team to understand software requirements, analyze technical documentation, identify inconsistencies, and support software quality assurance activities. **This is a software and IT-focused position, not a civil, mechanical, or industrial engineering specification role.** **Key Responsibilities** * Read, analyze, and organize software requirements and technical documentation, primarily written in English. * Prepare and maintain structured software specifications, functional requirements, and technical documentation. * Develop test scenarios, test cases, and checklists based on software requirements. * Identify inconsistencies, missing information, and potential issues in specifications or software functionality. * Support software testing, bug reporting, and documentation of test results. * Collaborate with Specification Engineers and Developers, using AI-assisted tools when appropriate. **Required Qualifications** * Final-year undergraduate student majoring in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a closely related software-focused discipline**. * **Fluent English communication skills**, particularly reading technical documentation, understanding written requirements, and explaining technical information verbally. * Good understanding of software development concepts, software requirements, and basic testing principles. * Strong analytical thinking, logical reasoning, and problem-solving abilities. * Excellent attention to detail, accuracy, and consistency when reviewing information. * Comfortable working with structured documentation and AI tools such as ChatGPT. **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with software testing, bug reporting, or QA processes. * Basic understanding of programming, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or API concepts. * Experience with software-related academic projects, technical documentation, or requirement analysis. **Ideal Working Style** We are particularly interested in candidates who: * Enjoy analyzing complex information and identifying small details that others may overlook. * Prefer structured, accurate, and well-organized work. * Are comfortable reading extensive technical documentation in English. * Can explain findings clearly and communicate with technical team members. * Demonstrate curiosity, discipline, and a commitment to producing high-quality work. **Recruitment Process** Shortlisted candidates will undergo English communication screening, technical assessments, and interviews to evaluate their suitability for the role. **How to Apply** If you’re passionate about technology, detail-oriented, and ready to learn from a global QA team, we’d love to meet you! Send your CV and application to **internship@zettabyte.life** with the subject line: **Application – Specification Engineer Intern** **Ready to develop your skills in software requirements and quality assurance? Apply and grow with Zettabyte!** Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Engineer – IS/IT International
jobs.descriptionHtml: Location: Jakarta, Indonesia Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. Thales has been present in the Republic of Indonesia for 45 years in the defence, aerospace and space domains, delivering a wide range of civil and defence solutions that highlight our strong commitment to working with the Indonesian government and local stakeholders. In recent years, our innovative solutions in air traffic management systems and telecom satellites have further strengthened our presence in the country alongside our digital portfolio of solutions such as biometrics, data protection and cybersecurity now serving the needs of diverse customers in civil sectors. **Key Responsibilities** **1. AI Solution Development & Deployment** * Design, develop, test, and deploy AI applications, including generative AI assistants, knowledge search solutions, workflow automation, and machine learning use cases. * Translate business requirements into technical designs and working solutions, from proof of concept through production deployment. * Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, approved AI platforms, APIs, and business data sources. * Implement evaluation methods to assess accuracy, relevance, reliability, and business suitability. * Develop reusable components and deployment practices that support adoption across regions. **2. Business Engagement & Value Delivery** * Work with business stakeholders to identify challenges and assess where AI can deliver practical benefits. * Evaluate use cases based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, cost, and risk. * Define success criteria and track outcomes such as time saved, improved quality, adoption, and operational efficiency. * Support demonstrations, user testing, training, and adoption. * Act as an accessible IS/IT partner, helping business teams navigate AI opportunities and use approved capabilities. **3. IS/IT AI Vision & Regional Roadmap** * Contribute to a shared AI vision and roadmap for AMEWA, Asia, and India. * Assess existing initiatives, capabilities, and business needs across the three regions. * Identify opportunities to reuse solutions, share knowledge, and coordinate related initiatives. * Align regional delivery with Group AI strategy, architecture, and approved platforms. * Collaborate with the AI Champions program to communicate business needs and connect them with relevant Group capabilities. **4. Production Operations & Continuous Improvement** * Monitor deployed AI solutions for availability, performance, output quality, usage, and cost. * Troubleshoot incidents and maintain reliable integrations and data flows. * Implement version control, automated testing, and CI/CD practices for AI applications. * Establish operational documentation, support procedures, and clear ownership before production release. * Improve solutions based on user feedback, evaluation results, and changing business requirements. **5. Security, Governance & Knowledge Sharing** * Work with cybersecurity, data protection, architecture, and relevant governance teams throughout delivery. * Apply appropriate access controls, data handling practices, human oversight, and safeguards against misuse. * Document solution designs, data dependencies, evaluation results, limitations, and operating procedures. * Share practical guidance and reusable approaches with IS/IT colleagues and business teams. **Requirements Technical Skills** **Must Have** * Strong proficiency in Python and software engineering practices. * Hands-on experience developing AI or machine learning applications and deploying them into production. * Practical experience with large language models, prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and vector search. * Experience integrating applications through REST APIs and connecting AI solutions to enterprise data sources. * Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure and enterprise AI services. * Solid understanding of SQL, data preparation, and data quality. * Experience with Git-based source control, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines. * Understanding of AI evaluation, monitoring, security, and responsible AI principles. * Ability to assess trade-offs between solution quality, latency, scalability, and cost. **Nice to Have** * Experience with Azure AI services, Azure Machine Learning, or comparable enterprise AI platforms. * Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and enterprise AI assistant capabilities. * Experience with containerization, infrastructure automation, and MLOps or LLMOps practices. * Experience with document processing, enterprise knowledge management, or workflow automation. * Familiarity with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow and delivery tools such as Jira and GitLab. **Soft Skills** * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a practical focus on business outcomes. * Ability to explain AI capabilities, limitations, and technical choices to nontechnical stakeholders. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. * Ability to work independently and collaborate across functions, cultures, and time zones. * Sound judgment when balancing innovation, operational reliability, and security. * A continuous learning mindset and willingness to share knowledge. * Professional fluency in English; French is a plus. **Education / Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. * At least 3 years of relevant experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, or a related role, including hands-on AI solution delivery. * Experience taking solutions from business requirements and prototyping through deployment and operational support. * Experience working with business stakeholders to deliver measurable improvements. * Experience working in Agile delivery environments. * Experience collaborating in multinational organizations, preferably across multiple regions. At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

jobs.descriptionHtml: ###### **Key Responsibilities** * Conduct accurate topographic and geodetic surveys to support ground improvement projects. * Perform site assessments, including boundary surveys, elevation measurements, and layout verification. * Ensure proper alignment and positioning of equipment and materials. * Identify discrepancies between field measurements and designs plans. * Ensure proper alignment and positioning of equipment and materials. * Operate and maintain survey instruments such as total stations, GPS systems, and levels to ensure precise measurements. * Calibrate and troubleshoot survey equipment as needed. * Prepare detailed survey reports, maps, and as-built drawings for submission to the project team. * Follow project-specific standards and adhere to HSE Guidelines while working on-site. * Work closely with engineers, supervisors, and contractors to ensure survey activities align with project timelines and objectives. * Bachelor's degree in geodesy engineering or civil engineering, or a related field. * 2+ years of experience in land and construction surveying, preferably in ground improvement or geotechnical projects. * Proven expertise in using surveying equipment, including total stations, GPS systems, and levelling instruments. * Experience in setting out and verifying layouts for ground improvement techniques. * Proficiency in survey data processing software such as AutoCAD, Civil 3D, or GIS tools. * Demonstrated ability to prepare accurate reports, maps, and as-built drawings. * Experience in working under various site conditions and tight project schedules. Menard Asia is part of the Menard Group, a world specialist in ground improvement. Our parent company, Soletanche Freyssinet, belongs to VINCI — the global leader in concessions and construction, with more than 180,000 employees across 100 countries. jobs.title: Senior Front-End Engineer (React)
jobs.descriptionHtml: At Provido, we’re more than a technology company. We are a global hub of innovation, creativity, and engineering excellence. Our teams design and deliver intelligent, secure, and high-performance digital solutions that help organizations modernize operations, scale their platforms, and succeed in an increasingly digital world. As part of a dynamic international ecosystem, we bring together forward-thinking engineers, technology specialists, designers, and delivery professionals who transform ideas into scalable, real-world solutions with measurable business impact. If you are motivated by challenge, inspired by technology, and ready to grow with a company that truly invests in its people, your journey starts here. **Why We Need You** We are looking for a talented and experienced English speaking Senior Front-End Developer to join our Jakarta team in a hybrid work arrangement. You will lead and develop high-performance, visually polished, and accessible web experiences. You will be a technical leader within our development team, making architecture decisions, driving code quality, and mentoring junior developers while delivering complex features across our digital products, and play a key role in driving the adoption of AI-assisted development practices, leading the effective use of AI-enabled engineering tool solutions to improve developer productivity, code quality, test coverage, and delivery velocity. **What You’ll Be Doing** * Front-End Development - Architect and build scalable, maintainable, responsive front-end solutions using React and TypeScript, following modern React architecture, coding standards, and development best practices. * Performance Optimization - Optimize for Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting, and fast load times to deliver a smooth user experience at scale. * Component Libraries - Design and maintain reusable component libraries and contribute to the front-end design system, ensuring consistency and efficiency across products. * API Integration - Integrate with RESTful APIs and backend services; handle real-time data via WebSockets or Server-Sent Events. * Code Quality - Write clean, testable code; conduct code reviews and uphold engineering standards using ESLint, Prettier, and automated testing frameworks. * AI-Enabled Development Practices - Lead effective use of AI-assisted development tools to improve team productivity, code quality, test coverage, and delivery velocity while ensuring security, maintainability, and architectural standards are upheld. * Mentorship - Guide and mentor junior and mid-level front-end developers; contribute to technical decisions and front-end strategy. * Collaboration - Work closely with UX/UI designers, back-end developers, QAs, and product managers in an Agile environment to deliver features end-to-end. **What You Bring to the Team** * 5+ years of front-end development experience, including 2+ years in a senior role * Expert proficiency in React and TypeScript, with proven experience designing and developing scalable, enterprise-grade applications * Strong understanding of browser rendering, performance optimisation, and Core Web Vitals * Strong knowledge of modern react state management (Context API, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query/TanStack Query), HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, responsive design, accessibility (WCAG), and modern CSS architecture. * Strong knowledge of SCSS/Sass, MaterialUI and Tailwind * Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern front-end build tooling (Vite, Webpack, npm, esbuild) * Experience working with modern React ecosystem tools such as React Router, Storybook, and Playwright. * Excellent problem-solving skills and strong communication with cross-functional teams * Experience working with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude or similar platforms is highly desirable. * Professional proficiency in English is required. **Preferred Skills** * Experience in Agency and Credit platform highly preferred * Knowledge in automated testing (playwright, jest) is preferred * Experience in fintech, or high-traffic consumer products * Familiarity with micro-frontend architecture and module federation * Experience with React-based SSR/SSG frameworks such as Next.js is highly desirable. **Why You’ll Love Working with Us** * **Employee Benefits & Advantages** At Provido, we value our employees and nurture a culture of progress and creativity. Our team members enjoy a supportive, inclusive, and growth-focused environment. * **Competitive Compensation & Performance Incentives** Provido offers an attractive salary package and performance-based bonuses to recognize and reward your contribution. * **Flexible Working Options** We support remote and hybrid working models to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance. * **Health & Well-being Support** We provide comprehensive health insurance, wellness initiatives, and resources to support both physical and mental well-being. * **Career Advancement & Development Programs** We invest in continuous learning through training programs, mentorship, and clearly defined career development paths. * **Team-Oriented & Inclusive Workplace** Our culture is built on diversity, inclusion, and collaboration. Every voice matters and innovation is encouraged. * **Team Events & Social Activities** We organize regular team-building activities and social events to strengthen relationships and create a positive, connected workplace.

jobs.title: Frontend Software Engineer - Global Payment - Jakarta
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Location :** Jakarta **Team :** Frontend **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A137843 Responsibilities About Global Payment Team Our Web and Client team in Global Payment is committed to building a highly integrated payment product that can be easily connected to the Web, App, cross-platform and other forms of Global Payment capabilities. In addition, we provide efficient and comprehensive services to developers, merchants and others through a series of platforms. Responsibilities - Build global consumer digital wallets and payment products to support global ecosystem business and users. As part of the international payment team, participate in system design, research and development, technological innovation, etc; - Build payment products for consumer users and cross platform products based on Web technology, including mobile and PC products; - Collaborate with product design, product management and software engineering teams to drive business success in efficiency and safety; - Keep at the forefront of emerging web-based technologies and trends, research and evaluate the latest web development frameworks, apply new technologies to drive iterative product improvements. Qualifications Minimum Qualification(s) - Experience in developing frontend web applications - Strong in JavaScript/HTML/CSS frontend experience, skilled in common web platforms such as React/Vue/Angular, and have good practice and understanding of common web compilation and bundling frameworks, including Webpack/Rollup/Babel/AST; - Have solid experience in implementing web applications with high performance, high availability, and excellent user experience; - Good problem solving skills and thinking patterns in web-based system design. Preferred Qualification(s) - Minimum 5 years relevant work experience from a large-scale internet business. - Experience in e-wallet and payment product development; - Agile, quick self learner, highly self-motivated with a strong sense of product ownership and creative problem solver; - Good collaborator and team player, comfortable working in a fast pace, diversified and global team environment. Job Information About Us Founded in 2012, ByteDance's mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. With a suite of more than a dozen products, including TikTok, Lemon8, CapCut and Pico as well as platforms specific to the China market, including Toutiao, Douyin, and Xigua, ByteDance has made it easier and more fun for people to connect with, consume, and create content. ​ Why Join ByteDance Inspiring creativity is at the core of ByteDance's mission. Our innovative products are built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and enrich life - a mission we work towards every day. ​ As ByteDancers, we strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our Company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​ Diversity & Inclusion ​ ByteDance is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At ByteDance, our mission is to inspire creativity and enrich life. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Make an impact with NTT DATA** Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive. **Your day at NTT DATA** The Senior Software Applications Development Engineer is an advanced subject matter expert, responsible for developing new applications and improve upon existing applications based on the needs of the internal organization and / or external clients. **Key responsibilities:** * Develop and maintain responsive, high-quality user interfaces * Build modern web applications using **React JS** * Develop mobile applications using **React Native** * Collaborate with backend developers, designers, and product teams * Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications * Participate in code reviews and technical discussions **To thrive in this role, you need to have:** * **2–5 years of professional experience** in frontend development * Strong proficiency in **React JS** * Hands-on experience with **React Native** * Good understanding of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS * Experience with RESTful APIs integration * Familiarity with version control tools (e.g., Git) * Strong problem-solving and communication skills. **Academic qualifications and certifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent in computer science or software engineering or related field. * Certification in various programming languages, for example (but not limited to) Java, Perl, Python, C++ preferred. **Required experience:** * Experience with state management tools (Redux, Zustand, etc.) * Advanced with **React Js and** Hands-on experience with **React Native** * Advanced Software Applications Engineering, Software Development experience, or related work experience. * Advanced experience with Programming Languages such as (but not limited to) C, C++, Java, Python. * Knowledge of UI/UX best practices * Experience with testing frameworks * Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodology **Workplace type****:** **About NTT DATA** NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D. **Equal Opportunity Employer** NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today. **Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters** NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters—whether in writing or by phone—in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an **@nttdata.com** email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please *contact us*.

jobs.title: Frontend Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Description** **What is Novocall?** Novocall is a inbound sales automation startup. We help businesses that sells high-value products to increase their sales conversions by reducing response time. To date, we have **over 2,000 businesses across 42 countries**, and got featured on Product Hunt thrice. **Job Description** **What is this role about?** We are looking for a passionate **Front-End Engineers** to share our mission and reach toward our vision of seamless sales conversations. **Your main responsibilities:** * Designing, developing, and testing UI for our web application * Build reusable code and libraries for future use * Accurately translate user and business needs into functional frontend code * Communicating with the CTO and rest of team (devs, designers and PMs) **What you'll get** * Career Progression - We're growing fast and we need team leaders. * Remote Work - We're a remote-first company, work from the comfort of your home * Young and Vibrant Team - We're a bunch of fun, casual group (who actually deliver performance), you'll fit right in :) **You should join us if...** * You want to contribute heavily to a company and see actual results * Joining a rocketship company with fast month-on-month growth * You find professional and personal growth a priority in your career * You enjoy working remotely and flexible working hours * You are AMBITIOUS and want to innovate on how businesses communicate **Application process** We will move through the following steps to qualify you and if you meet our expectations, we will extend an offer to you: * Submission of CV and Portfolio * Pre-qualification Test * Interview + Tell us about yourself and your front-end experiences + What are your goals and how we can align them with Novocall's * Pair programming code review session **SHOW YOUR PORTFOLIO** We believe strongly that a front-end developer's portfolio speaks volumes about his/her capabilities. Show, don’t tell. Drop us a link to your website/portfolio and we’ll take a look. If you do not have a website yet, feel free to wrap up your project in a ZIP file labelled FirstNameLastName.zip. **Qualifications** **Our requirements:** We're looking for someone who is fully invested in building frontend experiences. You love React, JS frameworks and the like. You care deeply about interactions whether that's animated hover states, scroll-based experiences, or pixel perfect execution. * 2 years in in a front-end development * Experience with React.js (hooks, reducers, es2016) and modern JavaScript frameworks (next, nuxt, etc) * Experience with front end languages (HTML, CSS, modern CSS, JavaScript) * Experience with git version control tools (GitHub) * Experience with frontend project management (SCRUM, agile, etc) * Experience with frontend testing tools and frameworks (Jest, etc) * Proficient in English is a must **Bonus:** * Experience working in SaaS or technology companies is preferred * Experience with CSS animations, optimisation a plus

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Next.js)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** ============ Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ **About the role** ================== We are looking for a disciplined, highly autonomous Middle Next.js Developer to build and ship product features for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will own features end to end across a TypeScript monorepo — a Next.js App Router client, a Fastify + Payload CMS API on PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers at the edge — from the moment you receive a task, through breaking it down, estimating, implementing, testing, and observability, to a clean release to production and confirmation that it works for real users. This is a hands-on engineering role suited for someone who treats production as the standard, not the finish line. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. The codebase is convention-heavy — a layered Feature-Sliced Design structure with strict import rules — and you are expected to work inside those conventions rather than around them. You are accountable for every task you take on and for every area of the product you touch: if it breaks, regresses, or stays half-finished, that is yours to see through. We expect maximum autonomy and real involvement in the product — you work independently within a sprint, communicate risks before they become blockers, and escalate architectural decisions to senior engineers rather than guessing. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **Feature Development** * Build features across the Next.js client and the Fastify + Payload CMS backend according to product requirements * Write code that follows the team's Feature-Sliced Design layering, naming, and import conventions * Ship changes behind feature flags and A/B experiments, fully localized across every supported locale * Integrate third-party providers — billing, email/CRM, analytics — over REST APIs and webhooks ### **Quality & Reliability** * Cover functionality with unit, integration, and e2e tests at the level the team expects * Run a thorough self-review before code review, and review teammates' code with the same rigour * Fix bugs and perform root-cause analysis for recurring issues * Optimize page and endpoint performance — rendering and caching strategy, database queries, bundle size ### **Security & Observability** * Apply secure development practices: schema validation, access control, safe handling of secrets * Follow observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerts — using existing tooling ### **Collaboration** * Break down, estimate, and ship your own tasks to production within the sprint — and stay accountable for them after release * Own the areas of the product you work in: their stability, performance, and follow-up fixes * Surface requirement clarifications, estimate changes, and risks early and in writing * Escalate complex architectural decisions and critical risks to senior engineers **Qualifications** ================== ### **Must-Have Experience** * 2+ years of commercial React experience, including 1+ year with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, route handlers, rendering and caching strategies) and solid TypeScript * Node.js backend experience on a typed HTTP framework (Fastify, Nest, or Express) with PostgreSQL — REST API design, schema migrations, integrations over REST and webhooks (signature verification, idempotency, retries) — plus a working understanding of HTTP/REST, auth mechanisms, and web security fundamentals * Hands-on with the modern client stack: TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, Tailwind CSS, and a React component library such as HeroUI, MUI, or shadcn/ui * Experience with a code-first headless CMS on PostgreSQL (Payload, Strapi, Directus, or equivalent) — collections, access control, generated types, migrations * Testing and delivery discipline: e2e tests (Cypress or Playwright) and unit/integration tests (Vitest or Jest), Git flow, code review, working with CI * Daily use of AI development tools (Claude Code or equivalents), including configuring them for a project — context, instructions, rules, MCP/integrations — with full ownership of the quality, security, and correctness of generated code * English — B1+ ### **Leadership Attributes** * Owns the outcome — takes a task from requirement to production without waiting to be pushed, and stays accountable for the result and the area it touches * Maximally autonomous and involved — needs a goal, not step-by-step instructions, and cares how the product performs, not just whether the ticket is closed * Verifies before trusting — treats AI output, third-party responses, and your own code as unproven until tested * Structured communicator — surfaces risks, blockers, and estimate changes early, in writing, in a remote team * Knows the edge of their scope — escalates architectural and security decisions instead of improvising them * Learns from incidents — fixes the root cause, not just the symptom **Location** ============ Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours. **Benefits** ============ Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer: * **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance. * **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days. * **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge. * **Company-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them. * **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. jobs.descriptionText: **About us** ============ Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ **About the role** ================== We are looking for a disciplined, highly autonomous Middle Next.js Developer to build and ship product features for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will own features end to end across a TypeScript monorepo — a Next.js App Router client, a Fastify + Payload CMS API on PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers at the edge — from the moment you receive a task, through breaking it down, estimating, implementing, testing, and observability, to a clean release to production and confirmation that it works for real users. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. recurring issues * Optimize page and endpoint performance — rendering and caching strategy, database queries, bundle size ### **Security & Observability** * Apply secure development practices: schema validation, access control, safe handling of secrets * Follow observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerts — using existing tooling ### **Collaboration** * Break down, estimate, and ship your own tasks to production within the sprint — and stay accountable for them after release * Own the areas of the product you work in: their stability, performance, and follow-up fixes * strategies) and solid TypeScript * Node.js backend experience on a typed HTTP framework (Fastify, Nest, or Express) with PostgreSQL — REST API design, schema migrations, integrations over REST and webhooks (signature verification, idempotency, retries) — plus a working understanding of HTTP/REST, auth mechanisms, and web security fundamentals * Hands-on with the modern client stack: TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, Tailwind CSS, and a React component library such as HeroUI, MUI, or shadcn/ui * Experience with a code-first headless CMS on PostgreSQL (Payload, Strapi, jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-1 Job Title Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core Job Description We’re hiring **Junior Software Engineers (Backend)** to join the **Core Payment Platform team** at Flip. If you’re passionate about building reliable systems, eager to learn, and excited to work on products that impact millions of Indonesians, this is your chance. **About Core Payment Platform** As part of the Payment Platform group, our team builds and maintains the critical services that power Flip’s ecosystem. We run over 20 projects that are essential for all business verticals, from money transfers to financial products. Our current mission is to break down Flip’s monolith service and set new engineering standards across the company. This is a rare opportunity to work on systems at scale, while learning modern backend practices in a supportive environment. We primarily use **Go** for our backend services, with **PostgreSQL** and **Redis** as our main data stores. Depending on the project, we use a mix of in-house tools and **Google Cloud Platform** services. **About Flip** Flip was founded in 2015 by three friends from Universitas Indonesia — Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar — with the goal of making money transfers fairer for Indonesians. Today, millions of individuals and businesses trust Flip to send trillions of rupiah across banks every year. We’re backed by leading investors such as **Sequoia India, Insight Partners, and Insignia**, and our mission is simple: **to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world.** At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you’ll do** * Work with senior engineers to build and maintain backend services used across Flip’s ecosystem. * Write clear, tested, and efficient code, mainly in Go. * Review and learn from code written by peers and provide constructive feedback. * Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver reliable features. * Help troubleshoot and resolve production issues under guidance. **What you’ll need** * Basic programming experience in any backend language (Go experience is a strong plus). * Understanding of core computer science concepts: data structures, algorithms, OOP, and clean code principles. * Willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly. * Good problem-solving mindset and eagerness to grow. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team. * Alignment with Flip’s values of fairness, respect, and continuous learning. **Why join Flip?** * Learn directly from experienced engineers working on large-scale systems. * Be part of a mission-driven company making finance fairer in Indonesia. * Grow your career in a supportive and collaborative environment. * Enjoy fair rewards, clear goals, and recognition for your contributions.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java]
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-2 Job Title Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java] Job Description We are looking for Software Engineer (Backend). As a software engineer, you'll be the brain behind crafting, developing, testing, going live, and maintaining the system. You are passionate in understanding the business context for features built to drive better customer experience and adoption. **About E-Money** As part of Flip's Consumer Solutions group, you will be the go-to person to work on our e-money part, mainly the Flip Saldo feature. You will be working with a cross-functional team to answer various business questions e.g. increasing the number of transacting users with Flip Saldo. You will be utilizing different tech stacks for various use cases, such as Java (for E-Money core system), Go (cash top-up feature in one of the top Indonesian retailers), and PHP to a certain use case (integration with monolithic system). **About Flip** Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After nine years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you'll do** * Work cross-functionally with the Product, Design, Operations, and Backend teams across the squads to ship world-class products and features. * Write code that's clear, concise, performant, tested, and easily understood by others. * Partner with the product management team to execute the feature roadmap. * Work with the overall backend teams to execute the engineering roadmap. * Help debug production issues across services and levels of the stack. **What you'll need** * Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions. * Experience working with payment and/or accounting system is preferrable. * Knowledge and experience in Java and Go, PHP Yii2 experience is a plus. * Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency system is a plus. * Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code. * Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability. * Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.

jobs.title: Lead (Backend) Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the GEO Team** ---------------------- GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. The GEO team builds products that help multi-location brands understand and improve how they are represented, cited, and recommended across AI-powered search and answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. We are building backend capabilities that collect and analyse signals from rapidly evolving AI platforms, measure brand visibility, and turn complex data into actionable recommendations for our customers. **About the Role** ------------------ As Backend Engineering Lead for Uberall’s GEO team, you will combine hands-on technical leadership with responsibility for the growth and effectiveness of the engineering team. You will shape the architecture behind our AI-search products, lead the delivery of new capabilities, and help the team navigate a fast-moving and technically ambiguous domain. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders, you will translate customer needs and emerging developments in generative AI into reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend solutions. Historically, our backend has been built on Groovy and Kotlin. Today we work AI-first, and much of our engineering work runs through AI-assisted development. As a result, we place far less weight on a specific stack than we used to. What matters is that you know your way around backend engineering and can apply sound judgment, whatever the language. **Your Responsibilities** ------------------------- * Lead, develop, and grow the GEO engineering team, starting with two engineers and scaling as the product grows. * Define how the team builds, reviews, evaluates, and ships, including how it uses AI-assisted development day to day. * Guide the design and operation of backend systems that integrate with LLMs and AI-powered search platforms. * Establish robust approaches for evaluating the quality and consistency of AI-generated results. * Ensure that LLM-enabled capabilities are observable, testable, cost-efficient, and resilient to changing models and external providers. * Help the team manage the particular challenges of generative AI systems, including non-deterministic behaviour, latency, rate limits, data quality, and graceful degradation. * Stay informed about relevant developments in LLMs and AI search, assessing them pragmatically rather than adopting technology for its own sake. **Your Profile** ---------------- * Experience leading or mentoring engineers, whether as a tech lead or engineering manager, including hiring and developing team members. * Solid backend engineering experience with at least one object-oriented language (for example, Java, Kotlin, Groovy, C#, or Python). Prior experience with Groovy or Kotlin is helpful but not required. * Comfort working AI-first, using AI-assisted development as a core part of how you and your team build and ship. * Hands-on experience building or operating production systems that use LLMs, generative AI, or AI-powered external services. * An understanding of how to evaluate and monitor LLM-enabled features beyond traditional deterministic testing. * Experience designing reliable integrations with third-party APIs and managing concerns such as cost, latency, rate limits, observability, and provider failure. * The ability to distinguish between an effective AI use case and one better solved with conventional software. * Experience with prompt management, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, or LLM evaluation frameworks is beneficial but not essential. * No experience training foundation models is required; this is primarily a backend engineering and technical leadership role. No experience training foundation models is required; this is a backend engineering and engineering leadership role.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: #### **Build the backbone of BYD's supply chain digital ecosystem — architect high-performance backend systems powering operations across Indonesia and beyond.** #### **Location: Subang, Indonesia** ### **Job Responsibilities** * Oversee the back-end technical system planning, architecture design and continuous iteration of the supply chain business line, to guarantee the forward-looking design, stability and scalability of the systems. * Take the lead in major business projects and core system reconstruction, and resolve technical challenges including high concurrency, high availability and data consistency. * Formulate and drive the implementation of development specifications, quality standards and performance baselines for the team. * Act as the technical lead, take charge of core talent cultivation and echelon building, and conduct critical technical decision-making and technical reviews. * Gain an in-depth understanding of business, participate in product and business planning, and translate complex business requirements into efficient and implementable technical solutions. * Keep track of industry technical trends and formulate the evolution roadmap of the team's technology stack. ### **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree or above; majors related to Computer Science such as Software Engineering, Network Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Digital Media Technology and Electronic Information are preferred. * Solid English skills in reading, writing and communication; proficiency in an additional foreign language is a plus. * No less than 5 years of back-end development experience with proven experience in developing large-scale distributed systems. * Solid foundational knowledge of Java, proficient in IO, multithreading, collections and mainstream basic frameworks, in-depth research on underlying principles, and familiar with the internal operating mechanism of JVM. * Skilled in mainstream development frameworks including Spring Boot and Spring Cloud. * Experienced with message queues (Kafka), distributed cache, ElasticSearch and other middleware technologies. * Familiar with relational databases (Oracle) and NoSQL databases, capable of designing heterogeneous data systems. ### **Recruitment Fraud Notice** PT BYD Auto Indonesia **does not charge any fees** at any stage of the recruitment process. This includes, but is not limited to, application fees, testing fees, interview fees, medical examination (MCU) fees, processing fees, travel expenses, or any other recruitment-related costs. jobs.title: Backend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: Portcast is a venture-backed, Singapore-based logistics technology startup helping freight forwarders turn data into better decisions and measurable business impact. Portcast uses AI to surface shipment exceptions, cost risks, and the right actions, helping teams focus on the shipments that need their attention, keep freight costs under control, and make procurement decisions with confidence. Our vision is to be the AI data and intelligence layer that powers exception management and margin improvement on every shipment. Founded in 2018 and backed by leading technology investors, we are building for an industry at a critical inflection point of digital transformation. Our team of software engineers, data scientists, and logistics experts is on a mission to build the technology that helps freight forwarders protect margin, improve operational efficiency, and differentiate their offering. ### **ABOUT THE ROLE:** As our Backend Engineer, you will be reporting directly to our Engineering Manager and will work closely with our Product team to develop new products, scale existing ones and manage deployments and architecture. You won't just take tickets here. You'll dig into how the system actually works, ask why before how, and chase a problem past the surface to the real cause. Curiosity isn't a nice-to-have on this team, it's how we build. ### **WHAT YOU’LL OWN:** * Design, build and maintain APIs, services and systems and debug production issues across multiple levels of the stack. * Collaborate closely with our Business, Product and Data Science teams to understand and solve customer pain points at scale. * Design, Develop, Implement and Deploy enterprise level, high availability web application platforms, with support from the design team at Portcast. * Create a technology infrastructure that functions well at scale. You will design and improve the system architecture. * Own end-to-end the design AND implementation of how our product handles real-time data at scale, from event ingestion across dozens of carrier sources, through data normalization, through ML-powered risk and ETA models, to the user-visible recommendations our enterprise customers act on. * Build features customers actually use, harden internal tooling the team relies on, and create the alerting and monitoring surfaces that catch issues before customers do. You're a builder first, with the judgment to know what's worth building. * Make architecture trade-offs explicit and defensible. * Instrument what you build, find real bottlenecks, and pick fixes that survive the next 10× of growth, not just the next sprint. You measure before you optimize, and your numbers are reproducible. ### **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:** * Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or equivalent work experience in the field. * Work Experience: Minimum 5+ years of experience in a technical role designing, developing and releasing technical solutions and building production systems. * Curious by Default: You dig deeper instead of following instructions to the letter. When something in the system surprises you, you chase the why, not just the fix. You treat every layer of the stack as something worth understanding, and you ask the good questions early. * System Architecture: You understand how parts of a system fit together and have a strong background in building scalable products or systems. You are comfortable in dealing with lots of moving pieces/data sources and possess meticulous attention to detail. You are quick to generate ideas and give suggestions on how to improve the tech stack and feature developments. * First Principles Thinker: When you explain a past decision, the trade-offs come out before the tools. You name the constraint, the alternatives you considered, and why you picked what you picked. You don't reach for a new framework when a tighter use of an existing tool would do the job. * You use AI tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude, etc.) where they make you faster, and you know exactly where they fall short. You read what they produce, you don't just paste it. You can defend a code path the AI suggested, or override it with reasoning the AI couldn't have known. You flag AI-assisted decisions in code review and submissions without being asked. We treat AI as a tool that makes good thinking faster, not a shortcut around thinking. * Team Player: You have experience working in a diverse, dynamic and cross-cultural team. This role is an opportunity to drive engineering excellence within the team and participate in key architectural discussions. You are a hands-on goal-orientated engineer who works according to milestones and software guidelines, following agile principles. * Empathetic Communicator: You can communicate nuanced ideas clearly, from real-time remote brainstorming to explaining a technical decision in writing. You may be opinionated, but in disagreements you engage thoughtfully with other perspectives and can compromise when needed. * You've either been an early engineering hire at a startup where you took a technical product from scratch to scale, OR you've owned real system design at a FAANG-tier engineering org, defended architectural decisions in actual design reviews, not just contributed to someone else's blueprint. Either path counts! We'd love to hear the learnings and the trade-offs you'd make differently today. * Tech Stack: Ideally you are proficient with Python-based backend programming, web frameworks like Flask, Amazon Web Services. You are able to design RESTful APIs and are aware of best practices. Experience with Docker, Git, Elasticsearch, Spark, CI/CD is a plus. The specific stack matters less than how you reason about it. Strong engineers in any stack pick ours up quickly. ### **WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:** * Globally distributed, remote-first flexibility: Work with a fully distributed team across Asia and Europe, built on trust, accountability, and collaboration. Our diversity of perspectives fuels innovation and keeps us curious. * Tech-first team: You’ll work with like-minded individuals who share a passion for solving difficult problems using technology. * Accelerated growth: Compress the learning curve in a couple of years by owning the web app from day one as your own baby. We are building our company to be the next B2B market leader in predictive global supply chains and you’ll be a major part of our story. * Impact you can see: With a lean structure, your work is effective from the start. You’ll see the results of your ideas and decisions directly moving the business forward. ### **Our CORE Values Guide Everything We Do:** * Curiosity: We read the code before we trust it. We dig into why a system behaves the way it does, not just how to make the error go away. * Ownership: We act like founders. We don't wait for a ticket to fix what's broken, and we stay on a problem until it's actually solved in production. * Raising the bar: We do not settle for code that only works locally or solves the immediate request. We aim for backend systems that are reliable, scalable, maintainable, and easy for the team to reason about. * Effectiveness: We focus on engineering work that creates real product and customer impact. We prioritize the right problems, make practical trade-offs, and ship solutions that improve outcomes, not just output. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
