jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.descriptionHtml: ##### **What we're looking for** We are seeking a talented, endlessly curious individual to join our team. You’ll be working closely with our group of companies in the fintech sector as part of the Engineering department. This company is a leading B2B fintech platform in its field, processing over US$2B across multiple currencies annually. We’re looking for individuals who are driven to create meaningful value, take full ownership of what they build, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. If you’re motivated by impactful work and eager to be part of an innovative team, we’d love to hear from you. ##### **What you’ll do** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Go, with a strong emphasis on code quality and maintainability * Integrate with third-party payment services (e.g. banks, e-wallets) and handle edge cases such as ambiguous or delayed responses * Write robust unit and integration tests for all new features and ensure proper validation for critical payment flows * Collaborate cross-functionally with product, infra, and QA teams to define, design, and ship high-impact features * Guide and mentor junior and mid-level engineers, providing technical leadership through code reviews, design discussions and pairing sessions * Lead by example in enforcing clean architecture, clear documentation, and reliable observability practices * Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, improve system resilience, and optimize for correctness and traceability * Stay up to date with emerging technologies and propose improvements aligned with business goals * Build software with security and compliance in mind, ensuring proper access control, logging, and auditing * Deploy applications to AWS infrastructure and support operational readiness of services ##### **What you should have** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a relevant field * 5+ years of backend engineering experience, with production-level experience in Go * Proven track record of integrating with external APIs, especially in payment, banking, or financial services * Strong foundation in system design, test-driven development, and writing maintainable, well-documented code * Comfortable working with PostgreSQL and Redis in high-availability environment * Experience with test automation and methodologies for both unit and integration testing * Strong communication skills - able to explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders * Familiarity with Agile practices and a commitment to continuous improvement * Security-conscious mindset; familiarity with OWASP vulnerabilities and mitigation techniques * Demonstrated leadership in team settings - mentoring, reviewing and leveling up peers * Excellent communication and documentation skills in English. ##### **About Us** Xenith is a B2B payment service provider focused on enabling seamless cross-border commerce. With an MSB license in Canada and PJP III license in Indonesia, we offer global merchants a one-stop solution to manage multi-currency payments - with a strong focus on alternative payment methods in emerging markets. Our deep regional expertise and strong partnerships with top local gateways, we simplify the complexity of fragmented payment landscapes, helping global merchants expand faster and more efficiently. At Xenith, we believe in building a culture where people feel empowered, trusted, and challenged to do their best work. Join us as we build the financial infrastructure of tomorrow!

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Description** GudangAda is a leading B2B marketplace platform with USD 120+ million raised from Sequoia Capital, Alpha JWC, Asia Partner, and Falcon Edge. We focus on addressing the underserved needs of millions of traditional retailers in Indonesia, a segment that faces challenges including limited product variety, uncompetitive wholesale prices, lack of access to producers’ promotional support, and lack of reliable and cost-effective delivery services. **Job Description** Our Tech & Product team members hail from the top company working experiences such as Facebook, Google, Amazon, Uber, Twitter, and Traveloka. Responsibilities: * You'll brainstorm with Product Managers, Designers, and Frontend Engineers on your team to conceptualize and build new features for GudangAda large (and growing!) user base. * You’ll produce high-quality results by contributing heavily to team projects that have a significant impact on the business. * You’ll actively own team features or systems and define their long-term health, while also improving the health of surrounding systems. * You'll assist our skilled support team and operations team in triaging and resolving production issues. * You'll mentor other engineers and deeply review code. * You’ll improve engineering standards, tooling, and processes **Qualifications** We are looking for someone with: * Deep passion for software engineering with an excellent understanding of software engineering concepts, design patterns, and algorithms. * You can contribute to technical architecture discussions and help drive technical decisions within your team. * You write understandable, testable code with an eye towards maintainability. * You are a strong communicator. jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the role** We build software for a regulated, safety-critical industry, where the decisions our users make have to be accurate, traceable, and defensible. jobs.title: Middle Full-Stack Developer (Next.js)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** ============ Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ **About the role** ================== We are looking for a disciplined, highly autonomous Middle Next.js Developer to build and ship product features for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will own features end to end across a TypeScript monorepo — a Next.js App Router client, a Fastify + Payload CMS API on PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers at the edge — from the moment you receive a task, through breaking it down, estimating, implementing, testing, and observability, to a clean release to production and confirmation that it works for real users. This is a hands-on engineering role suited for someone who treats production as the standard, not the finish line. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. The codebase is convention-heavy — a layered Feature-Sliced Design structure with strict import rules — and you are expected to work inside those conventions rather than around them. You are accountable for every task you take on and for every area of the product you touch: if it breaks, regresses, or stays half-finished, that is yours to see through. We expect maximum autonomy and real involvement in the product — you work independently within a sprint, communicate risks before they become blockers, and escalate architectural decisions to senior engineers rather than guessing. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **Feature Development** * Build features across the Next.js client and the Fastify + Payload CMS backend according to product requirements * Write code that follows the team's Feature-Sliced Design layering, naming, and import conventions * Ship changes behind feature flags and A/B experiments, fully localized across every supported locale * Integrate third-party providers — billing, email/CRM, analytics — over REST APIs and webhooks ### **Quality & Reliability** * Cover functionality with unit, integration, and e2e tests at the level the team expects * Run a thorough self-review before code review, and review teammates' code with the same rigour * Fix bugs and perform root-cause analysis for recurring issues * Optimize page and endpoint performance — rendering and caching strategy, database queries, bundle size ### **Security & Observability** * Apply secure development practices: schema validation, access control, safe handling of secrets * Follow observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerts — using existing tooling ### **Collaboration** * Break down, estimate, and ship your own tasks to production within the sprint — and stay accountable for them after release * Own the areas of the product you work in: their stability, performance, and follow-up fixes * Surface requirement clarifications, estimate changes, and risks early and in writing * Escalate complex architectural decisions and critical risks to senior engineers **Qualifications** ================== ### **Must-Have Experience** * 2+ years of commercial React experience, including 1+ year with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, route handlers, rendering and caching strategies) and solid TypeScript * Node.js backend experience on a typed HTTP framework (Fastify, Nest, or Express) with PostgreSQL — REST API design, schema migrations, integrations over REST and webhooks (signature verification, idempotency, retries) — plus a working understanding of HTTP/REST, auth mechanisms, and web security fundamentals * Hands-on with the modern client stack: TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, Tailwind CSS, and a React component library such as HeroUI, MUI, or shadcn/ui * Experience with a code-first headless CMS on PostgreSQL (Payload, Strapi, Directus, or equivalent) — collections, access control, generated types, migrations * Testing and delivery discipline: e2e tests (Cypress or Playwright) and unit/integration tests (Vitest or Jest), Git flow, code review, working with CI * Daily use of AI development tools (Claude Code or equivalents), including configuring them for a project — context, instructions, rules, MCP/integrations — with full ownership of the quality, security, and correctness of generated code * English — B1+ ### **Leadership Attributes** * Owns the outcome — takes a task from requirement to production without waiting to be pushed, and stays accountable for the result and the area it touches * Maximally autonomous and involved — needs a goal, not step-by-step instructions, and cares how the product performs, not just whether the ticket is closed * Verifies before trusting — treats AI output, third-party responses, and your own code as unproven until tested * Structured communicator — surfaces risks, blockers, and estimate changes early, in writing, in a remote team * Knows the edge of their scope — escalates architectural and security decisions instead of improvising them * Learns from incidents — fixes the root cause, not just the symptom **Location** ============ Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours. **Benefits** ============ Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer: * **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance. * **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days. * **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge. * **Company-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them. * **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1\_mni\_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth! **Interview Process** ===================== After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps: * Recruiter Screening (40 minutes) * Technical Interview (60 minutes) **Life at Ruby Labs** ===================== At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day. This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen. Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success. #LI-Remote

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Location** ------------ Batam **About this role** ------------------- The Full Stack Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining web-based applications across both front-end and back-end systems. jobs.title: Front-end (React) Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Description** Bibit.id is a platform to help you to start your investment in mutual fund in a very simple way. **Job Description** We're currently looking for a top-notch full-stack developer to grow with our Developer team. Your primary focus will be on developing user interface components and implementing them following well-known React.js workflows. You will ensure that these components and the overall application are robust and easy to maintain. You will coordinate with the rest of the team working on different layers of the infrastructure. Therefore, a commitment to collaborative problem solving, sophisticated design, and quality product is important. We're looking for someone who will constantly challenge themselves to be on the cutting-edge of new technology and grow the team's knowledge of best practices. Responsibilities * Develop a maintainable, secure, scalable, well-tested and well-written web-based application. * Work seamlessly with the other team in particular Product teams, Backend Devs, UI Designers & QA teams. * Work with product team and graphic designers to understand user interactions * Maintaining our design system components which will be used app-wide **Qualifications** Requirements * Strong knowledge in Javascript * Strong knowledge in ReactJS concepts along with its popular accompanying libraries such as Redux, thunk, axios etc * Strong knowledge in HTML+CSS especially with general web interactivity * Understand how to construct a clean & efficient codebase within a React project * Experience in using testing framework such as Jest, Mocha, @testing-library/react, enzyme is a big plus * Excellent in working within a team, with good communication skills * Knowledge in version control tools (git, mercurial) is a big plus * Knowledge in using Storybook is a big plus * Knowledge in using NextJS is a big plus **Additional Information** **What’s it like working at Bibit.id?** At Bibit.id, we are collaborative, innovative, open, balanced and adaptable. **Benefits and perks of working with us include:** **Compensation:** Competitive salaries **Lifestyle:** Casual dress code **Welfare:** Dental insurance, Health insurance **Our Spirit & Beliefs** **Teamwork & Collaboration** We believe more work can be accomplished through informal teams. Our organizational design encourages interactions and collaborations between founders and employees where we can easily communicate, hold meeting and tackle concerns in an efficient manner. **Transparency.** All employees understand the thinking, responsibilities and strategy of the company. We encourage sharing of ideas and feedback no matter who you are. **Work-Life Integration** We believe that having clear-thinking people will boost productivity. While working hard is important, we think it is important to avoid getting burnt out and value the need to have a fulfilling personal life.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer (26-07001)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Jadi bagian dari tim hebat dari perusahaan global.** ------------------------------------------------------ Bergabunglah dengan perusahaan global kami dan buka peluang tanpa batas dengan berkolaborasi bersama tim yang beragam dan berbakat. Bersama-sama, kami menciptakan kesuksesan, mendorong inovasi, dan menciptakan dunia dengan berbagai peluang yang tak terbatas. ### **Detail Pekerjaan** * Conduct research about website and app UI and UX based on target audience, needs, and behaviors. * Create wireframes (basic sketches) to outline the structure and layout of the website or app. * Develop interactive UI/UX prototypes to demonstrate how the product will function. * Design the look and feel of the product, including color schemes, typography, and iconography. * Ensure the design aligns with the brand identity and is visually appealing. * Work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to bring designs to life. * Create and maintain design systems or style guides to ensure consistency across the product. * Document design standards and best practices. ### **Persyaratan Keahlian** * Have minimum 3 years' experience as UI/UX Designer. * Must have experience with design tools like Adobe XD, Figma etc. * Must have experience in mobile and web design. * Understand design practical and user centered digital experience using modern design tools methodologies. * Can collaborate with team to improve UI/UX based expected output result. * Strong understanding of design principles, including layout, color theory, and typography. * Strong eye for detail in creating pixel-perfect designs. ### **Tingkat Pendidikan** * Bachelor Degree of Graphic Design, Interaction Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field. * Diploma 3 Diploma from any discipline.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: Bangkok, Thailand, Khon Kaen, Thailand Full-time Permanent employee **What We Need** ---------------- Oivan is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own the platform that runs our internal technology, including the AI agents we build and operate for ourselves. You will report directly to the CTO and shape how Oivan ships, runs and secures its own systems. This is an internal technology role, not a client delivery position. You will build and run the platform behind Oivan's own products and internal systems, the pipelines, clusters, cloud infrastructure and observability that everything else depends on. A large part of the work is deploying and operating AI agents. Oivan builds AI into its own operations, and you will be the engineer who takes those agents from a working prototype to something that runs reliably in production, with the model endpoints, orchestration, data stores, guardrails and monitoring that requires. You report directly to the CTO, which means you have a real say in platform direction, technology choices and build-versus-buy decisions. We are looking for someone who is comfortable owning a problem end to end rather than waiting for a ticket. We are offering relocation to **Khon Kaen** for people interested. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design, build and operate the CI/CD pipelines and deployment platform for Oivan's internal applications and services. * Deploy, run and monitor AI agents and LLM-backed services in production, model endpoints, orchestration layers, vector stores, evaluation and the guardrails around them. * Own our Kubernetes clusters end to end: provisioning, upgrades, autoscaling, networking, ingress, secrets and workload management. * Manage cloud infrastructure, with clear cost visibility and sensible guardrails. * Build observability that people actually use, metrics, logs, traces, alerting and dashboards. * Automate everything repeatable with Infrastructure as Code. * Harden the platform: identity and access, secrets management, network policy, patching and vulnerability management. * Support the internal front-ends and the services behind them through build, release and runtime. * Work with the CTO on platform roadmap, tooling decisions and where we build versus buy. * Act as the escalation point for internal platform incidents, and drive the follow-up that stops them recurring. **What You Have** ----------------- Must have * 5+ years in DevOps, platform engineering or SRE, operating at strong medior to senior level. * Hands-on Kubernetes in production, GKE, EKS or on-premise. Not just deploying to a managed cluster, but owning it * CI/CD ownership — designing and running pipelines, not only using them. * Infrastructure as Code — Terraform, Pulumi or equivalent. * Cloud platform experience at production scale. * Linux administration and scripting — Bash and Python. * Containers and registries — Docker, image hygiene, supply chain basics. * Observability — Prometheus, Grafana, centralized logging and alerting. * Secrets management and identity across services and environments. * Networking fundamentals — DNS, TLS, load balancing, firewalls. * Advanced English and strong communication. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **OWM Group** **Ltd** is a forward-thinking technology group comprising several innovative companies, including **OpenWeather Ltd** and **Ulla** **Technology Ltd**, all headquartered in the iconic Gherkin, one of London’s most recognised business centres. **OpenWeather** is a technologically innovative company that specialises in the development of intelligent environmental data products. The UK-based company has been operating on the market for a decade, adhering to its mission to provide high-quality data and analytical products that assist customers in transforming their businesses for the better. The organisation is proficient in the practical applications of artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and information technology (IT) in the context of environmental data. We are currently providing services to over 9 million consumers worldwide, with over 2 billion forecasts generated daily, and 5 PB of environmental data. **Ulla** **Technology Ltd**, our AI-powered assistant platform, is the latest addition to the group and is experiencing rapid growth. Ulla represents the future of AI-led business support, and we are just getting started. Both products run on infrastructure we build and operate ourselves, mostly on bare metal. That’s where you come in. We’re growing and looking for a DevOps Engineer who enjoys running real infrastructure on real hardware. You’ll have genuine ownership and a real say in how we work, and you’ll join a team that values automation over manual work. **What you’ll do** * Run the fleet: deploy, maintain and operate Linux servers, mostly bare-metal, with automation and security built in from the start. * Keep services up: own internal and external services from deployment through day-to-day uptime. * Share on-call: take part in a rotating on-call schedule. * Handle incidents: join incident response and lead root cause analysis. * Work across teams: partner with engineering teams to deliver infrastructure and keep services available. * Build what’s next: contribute to infrastructure and security projects. **What you bring** * 3+ years of Linux administration. * A solid understanding of network services (DNS, VPN, firewalls) and the TCP/IP stack. * Confidence with Docker / docker-compose, Ansible and GitLab CI. * An automation-first mindset and the scripting skills to back it up. **Nice to have experience** * Running Kubernetes in production. * Applying SRE practices. * Operating high-load systems. **Why Join OWM Group** **Ltd?** ● Be part of a global company providing weather services to millions of customers. ● Collaborate with a team of talented professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of weather prediction. ● Opportunities for professional growth and development. ● Flexible working schedule ● Annual performance bonus. ● 25 days of annual leave + 8 UK bank holidays. **OWM Group** **Ltd** is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **24Slides** is a leading presentation design company specializing in high-impact PowerPoint presentations. We are committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. We believe diversity drives innovation and success, and we strive to build an environment where every identity is valued. At 24Slides, we don't just celebrate differences—we make them central to our culture, ensuring everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. As our infrastructure and platform services expand, we are building operational coverage and infrastructure redundancy across global time zones. We are looking for a skilled DevOps Engineer based in our Malang office to join our Technology organization, working closely with your DevOps and Engineering colleagues in Europe. #### **About the Position** As a DevOps in 24Slides you will be part of a dynamic workplace, and engage with different stakeholders, across different offices, and participate in recurring tasks and ad-hoc projects across 24Slides. You will be working closely with 24Slides software engineers, our Data team and our QA team, and in collaboration optimize deployment pipelines, data pipelines and support increased levels of automation. We take pride in being curious, so we experiment with new technologies to help elevate our customers' experience, and being interested in new advancements within the DevOps/DevEx domain is a plus. #### **Responsibilities:** * Manage and maintain Kubernetes clusters across our primary hosting environment(s) * Apply Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools and containerization best practices to streamline resource management and ensure environment consistency. * Monitor cloud compute utilization and cost efficiency across production and non-production environments. * Maintain CI/CD build runners and automation pipelines * Conduct security patch updates. * Monitor system health, application metrics, and log pipelines * Participate in proactive troubleshooting, incident management, and post-incident root-cause analysis (RCA) * Conduct periodic Disaster Recovery (DR) drills to validate recovery objectives (RTO/RPO). #### **Requirements:** * Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in a DevOps, SRE, or Systems Engineering role supporting production applications. * Managing cloud infrastructure. Previous experience from DigitalOcean is a plus. * Building, maintaining and optimizing CI/CD pipelines * Experience with Infrastructure As Code (IaC) * Knowledge of Cloudflare, reverse proxies, and Linux system administration. * Familiarity with relational databases and Redis/Vkey caching engines. * Intermediate to advanced proficiency in English (both written and spoken) for cross-regional team collaboration. #### **A plus if you** * **Have experience operating under formal security compliance frameworks (SOC 2).** * **Are familiar with PHP/Laravel runtime environments and Node.js / React build systems.** * **Have experience with log management stacks.** #### **Benefits:** * **Salary & Insurances:** Enjoy a competitive salary with additional incentives, plus comprehensive health coverage, including BPJS and private insurance. * **Global & Flexible Work Culture:** Gain international experience in a multinational environment with a global team, a fun office vibe, casual attire, and a flexible hybrid working model. * **Continuous Growth & Development:** We invest in your future through professional training, clear career progression paths, and dedicated personal growth programs. * **Holistic Well-being:** We prioritize your happiness and mental health with access to psychological counseling, annual leave that increases with tenure, plus situational leave, and engaging "experience programs" (non-work activities). * **Operational Support:** Get the tools you need to succeed with the provided working devices. #### **Application & Recruitment Process:** Please submit your application as soon as possible. Our recruitment process is designed to be thorough and transparent, consisting of some stages: an initial screening, a online technical test to evaluate your skill, a online psychological test, an HR interview, a user interview, and a final interview with the user team. We look forward to reviewing your application and potentially welcoming you to the team!

jobs.descriptionHtml: **This role is open only to candidates currently based in Thailand or Indonesia, with a hybrid arrangement in Bangkok and a remote arrangement in Indonesia.** Cube is looking for a DevOps Engineer / Cloud Engineer who is keen to learn and help us maintain and operate the cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines behind our products. You will work closely with the Senior Infrastructure team, Software Engineering and Data Engineering teams to support secure, reliable, and cost-efficient infrastructure while helping our engineering teams deliver software, data pipelines smoothly and improve operational practices. Responsibilities * Support the setup, maintenance, and operation of cloud infrastructure and services. * Support the maintenance and improvement of CI/CD pipelines for reliable software delivery. * Support the deployment and maintain containerized workloads using Docker, Kubernetes, or similar platforms. * Support cloud networking, databases, monitoring, logging, alerting, backup, and disaster recovery operations. * Monitor infrastructure and applications, investigate alerts, troubleshoot issues, and escalate incidents when needed. * Assist with routine infrastructure maintenance, upgrades, and operational tasks. * Collaborate with the Software Engineering and Data Engineering teams to support their infrastructure and deployment needs. * Assist with infrastructure and modernization projects. **Requirements** * 1-2 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, System Administration, SRE, or a similar role. * Basic experience administering Linux servers and working with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS. * Basic experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based development workflows. * Basic understanding of basic cloud networking concepts. * Basic experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability tools. * Basic knowledge of commonly used databases, such as MySQL or PostgreSQL. * Basic knowledge to write basic Bash, Python, or similar scripts for automation and operational tasks. * Good to have hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) * Good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with a willingness to learn and work across engineering teams. * Cloud or Infrastructure certifications are a plus.

jobs.descriptionHtml: Deskripsi Pekerjaan **.custom\_\_ql-container a { text-decoration:** underline !important; } Kamu akan berperan sebagai Infrastructure Engineer yang bertanggung jawab atas keandalan (reliability), keamanan (security), dan otomatisasi (automation) infrastruktur serta pipeline pengembangan aplikasi. Kamu akan terlibat langsung dalam perencanaan arsitektur, implementasi CI/CD, pengelolaan infrastruktur cloud, serta penerapan security by design di seluruh lifecycle aplikasi. Selain itu, kamu akan melakukan monitoring, incident response, hardening sistem, serta memastikan compliance terhadap standar keamanan informasi. **.custom\_\_ql-container a { text-decoration:** underline !important; } Kualifikasi Minimal 3 tahun pengalaman di bidang DevOps, SRE, Infrastruktur, atau Security Engineer. Pengalaman hands-on dengan cloud AWS dan/atau GCP. Pengalaman membangun dan mengelola CI/CD pipeline (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, dsb). Menguasai konsep jaringan, firewall, IDS/IPS, VPN, dan protokol keamanan. Familiar dengan container dan orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). jobs.title: Dev Ops / Cloud Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Category:** Engineering Product **Job Type:** Full Time **Job Location:** Bandung **Job Status:** Priority Hiring Bandung, Indonesia · Full-Time **About the Role** ------------------ Solve Education! is hiring a DevOps / Cloud Engineer to build and own the cloud foundation behind our mission: helping young people everywhere reach their potential through accessible, AI-powered learning. This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants their work to keep a global learning platform reliable, secure, and cost-efficient. You'll design, operate, and improve our cloud environment (primarily AWS, with some GCP) across infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, security, reliability, and cost. You'll work with a high degree of autonomy and make sound calls without waiting for direction. **Our stack:** AWS (primary) and GCP · Pulumi/Terraform · GitLab CI · Python/Bash for automation. **Before You Apply** -------------------- This role carries real ownership of production systems learners depend on. You'll handle ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and weigh reliability, security, and cost in your decisions. Some of the near-term work is foundational — tightening how we manage access, credentials, and deployments. We look for engineers who stay composed under pressure, take full accountability, and hold a high bar without close supervision. If you want a role where infrastructure decisions have visible impact and your work directly supports a mission that matters, we'd love to hear from you. **Responsibilities** -------------------- **Infrastructure & IaC** * Design, build, and manage cloud infrastructure on AWS (and GCP where needed) using Pulumi/Terraform. * Keep infrastructure available, performant, and scalable as the platform grows. **CI/CD & Deployments** * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) for fast, safe, repeatable deployments. * Manage releases, rollbacks, and deployment safety to minimize disruption. **Security, Reliability & Monitoring** * Apply least-privilege access, sensible network configuration, and good secrets management. * Run monitoring, logging, and incident response; keep downtime low and detection useful. * Maintain backups and a workable disaster-recovery plan. **Cost & Collaboration** * Keep cloud spend visible and efficient with budgets and usage controls. * Work with the Product & Technology team so infrastructure supports what's being built, and keep documentation and operational standards up to date. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 3+ years in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, SRE, or platform engineering. * Hands-on experience with AWS (and GCP experience a plus). * Proficiency with Pulumi/Terraform and CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI or equivalent). * Solid cloud-security fundamentals: IAM, least-privilege, networking, and secrets management. * Experience with monitoring, logging, and incident response. * Scripting for automation (Python or Bash). * Pragmatic judgment about reliability vs. cost, with the ability to work independently and own outcomes. **Bonus Points If You Have** ---------------------------- * Containerized workloads (Cloud Run, ECS) and basic orchestration. * Experience moving from static credentials to federated identity (Workload Identity Federation, OIDC). * Exposure to data-platform infrastructure (BigQuery, Airflow). * A habit of using AI tools to speed up infrastructure and automation work. * Experience in mission-driven or non-profit organizations. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- You'll be joining a team with a bold mission to transform education. We don't expect perfection, but we do expect creativity, ownership, and a strong learning attitude. If you're looking for a conventional engineering role, this may not be the right fit. But if you're ready to lead with technology, build solutions that matter, and create real-world impact — we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Why Join Us** --------------- ### **Learn, Experiment, Repeat** Problem-solving culture with continuous learning in cloud and DevOps. ### **Open Culture, Smart Collaboration** We value transparency, knowledge-sharing, and thoughtful collaboration. ### **Shape Your Career Path** We provide mentorship to shape your path in IT and leadership. ### **DevOps Engineer** Engineering • Jakarta Apply Now We are currently looking for talent in the DevOps Engineer. If you are familiar with CI/CD pipeline, Public, and Private Cloud, read below for more requirements to qualify, and let's join us. #### **Job Description** * Understanding customer requirements and projects * Building and setting up DevSecOps tools * Design CI/CD Production-Ready Pipeline * Defining and setting development, test, release, update, and support processes for DevOps operations * Working with software developers and software engineers to ensure that development follows established processes and works as intended * Encouraging and building automated processes wherever possible * Mentoring and guiding the customer's team members regarding DevSecOps * Ensuring that systems are safe and secure against cybersecurity threats * Research on New DevSecOps Tools * Improving existing CI/CD Pipelines * Work alongside project management teams to successfully monitor progress and implementation of initiatives #### **Requirements** * Minimum of a Diploma (D3) in Informatics, Information Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * Proficient in Linux operating systems (Ubuntu, CentOS, RHEL). * Understanding of networking concepts: TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, Load Balancer, Firewall. * Experience managing on-premises servers and/or cloud infrastructure. * Experience using one or more cloud platforms: AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, CloudWatch) or GCP (Compute Engine, GKE) * Proficient in CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, Bamboo, or Bitbucket. * Experience using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) such as Ansible. * Proficient in Docker for containerization. * Experience using Kubernetes or OpenShift (deployment, scaling, monitoring). * Experience using monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus & Grafana, the ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), or cloud-native monitoring tools. * Ability to systematically troubleshoot and handle incidents. * Proficient in at least one scripting or programming language such as Bash, Python, or Go.

jobs.title: Frontend Android Developer (Native Kotlin)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Make an impact with NTT DATA Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive. Your day at NTT DATA The Software Development Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, tasked with participating in designing, developing, and testing software systems, modules, or applications for software enhancements and new products including cloud-based or internet-related tools. This role is accountable for participating in detailed design for certain modules/sub-systems, doing prototype for multi-vendor infrastructure, and showcasing it internally or externally to clients. This role designs and develops functionality in a micro-services environment working with APIs, telemetry data, and running ML/AI algorithms on it, working with both structured and unstructured data. **Key responsibilities:** * Designs and develops solutions and functionality that drives the growth of business. * Develop and maintain high-quality native Android applications using Kotlin. * Accountable for writing and testing code. * Accountable for execution of automated testing. * Contributes to software deployment. * Works across multiple teams to deliver software components while working in collaboration with the product team. * Contributes to the integration and building of solutions through automation and coding, using 3rd party software. * Creates, crafts and debugs large scale distributed systems. * Contributes to writing, updating and maintaining the technical program, end-user documentation, and operational procedures. * Accountable for refactoring code. * Works across multiple teams to review code written by other developers. * Performs any other related task as required. **To thrive in this role, you need to have:** * Experience: 3–4 years of professional experience in Android Native (Kotlin) development. * Architecture: In-depth understanding of MVVM, Clean Architecture, and Modular Architecture. * Networking Async: Proven experience handling data communication using Retrofit and OkHttp, as well as managing asynchronous tasks with Kotlin Coroutines. * Hands-on experience with DI frameworks such as Hilt or Dagger. * Experience in programming languages such as C/C, C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, Node.js, libraries and frameworks. * Seasoned expertise of data structures, algorithms, and software design with strong analytical and debugging skills. * Seasoned knowledge of micro services-based software architecture and experience with API product development. * Seasoned expertise in SQL and no-SQL data stores including Elasticsearch, MongoDB, Cassandra. * Seasoned understanding of container run time (Kubernetes, Docker, LXC/LXD). * Seasoned proficiency with agile, lean practices and believes in test-driven development. * Possess a can-do attitude and one that takes initiative. * Excellent ability to work well in a diverse team with different backgrounds and experience levels. * Excellent ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. * Seasoned proficiency with CI/CD concepts and tools. * Seasoned proficiency with cloud-based infrastructure and deployments. * Excellent attention to detail. **Academic qualifications and certifications:** * Bachelors degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. **Required experience:** * Experience: 3–4 years of professional experience in Android Native (Kotlin) development. * Architecture: In-depth understanding of MVVM, Clean Architecture, and Modular Architecture. * Networking Async: Proven experience handling data communication using Retrofit and OkHttp, as well as managing asynchronous tasks with Kotlin Coroutines. * Hands-on experience with DI frameworks such as Hilt or Dagger. * Experience in programming languages such as C/C, C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, Node.js, libraries and frameworks. * Seasoned experience with tools across full software delivery lifecycle, for example, IDE, source control, CI, test, mocking, work tracking, defect management. * Seasoned experience in Agile and Lean methodologies, Continuous Delivery / DevOps, Analytics / data-driven processes. * Seasoned proficiency in working with large data sets and ability to apply proper ML/AI algorithms. * Seasoned experience in developing micro-services and RESTful APIs. * Seasoned experience in software development. **Workplace type:** About NTT DATA NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD. Equal Opportunity Employer NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today. Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters—whether in writing or by phone—in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an nttdata.com email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please contact us.

jobs.title: IT Project Manager (Junior)
jobs.descriptionHtml: * Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait. * Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 1–2 tahun sebagai IT Project Manager (Junior) * Memimpin dan mengelola proyek pengembangan solusi Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Generative AI, dan Digital Transformation dari tahap perencanaan hingga implementasi. * Menyusun dan mengelola Project Charter, Project Plan, timeline, budget, resource plan, serta risk register untuk memastikan proyek berjalan sesuai target. * Berkolaborasi dengan Product Owner, Business Analyst, Data Scientist, AI Engineer, Data Engineer, Software Developer, dan stakeholder bisnis dalam menentukan kebutuhan serta prioritas proyek. * Memastikan seluruh hasil pekerjaan proyek memenuhi standar kualitas, keamanan, dan kepatuhan perusahaan. * Mengelola komunikasi dan hubungan dengan stakeholder internal maupun eksternal, termasuk vendor, partner teknologi, dan manajemen. * Menyusun laporan perkembangan proyek secara berkala kepada Steering Committee, Executive Management, dan stakeholder terkait. * Memastikan solusi AI yang dikembangkan sesuai dengan kebutuhan bisnis, regulasi perusahaan, dan prinsip Responsible AI Governance. * Melakukan evaluasi setelah implementasi proyek (Post Implementation Review) serta mengidentifikasi lesson learned untuk meningkatkan proses dan pelaksanaan proyek berikutnya. **Kualifikasi:** * Menguasai framework Agile seperti scrum, kanban, SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) dan Lean Agile Practices. * Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Scrum Master, Product Owner, atau Agile Project Manager menjadi nilai tambah. * Memahami siklus pengembangan perangkat lunak (SDLC) dan DevOps Lifecycle. * Berpengalaman menggunakan tools manajemen proyek Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project dan Trello / Asana. * Memahami konsep Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), dan Generative AI. * Memiliki pengalaman memimpin implementasi salah satu atau lebih teknologi seperti AI Chatbot, Large Language Models (LLM), Predictive Analytics, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP) dan Intelligent Automation. * Memahami proses AI Project Lifecycle seperti Data Collection, Data Preparation, Model Training, Model Validation, Deployment dan Monitoring & Continuous Improvement. * Memahami integrasi AI dengan platform cloud seperti Microsoft Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, AWS AI/ML Services dan Google Cloud AI. * Memiliki kemampuan dalam penyusunan seperti Project Charter, Business Requirement Document (BRD), Functional Specification, Project Plan, Risk Register dan Project Status Report. * Berpengalaman mengelola proyek dengan anggaran dan tim lintas fungsi (Cross Functional Team). * Memahami manajemen risiko, kualitas, perubahan (Change Management), serta tata kelola proyek IT. * Memiliki kemampuan stakeholder management dan executive reporting yang baik. * Memahami prinsip keamanan informasi, data privacy, dan AI Governance. Education: * S1 (Preferred) Experience: * Project Manager: 1 year (Preferred) Location: * Jakarta (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Spesifikasi Fisik** --------------------- Tinggi Min. 170 cm Berat Min. 50 kg **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** ----------------------- * Melakukan analisis terhadap data produksi untuk mengukur pencapaian target, produktivitas tim, dan efektivitas proses kerja, serta mengidentifikasi deviasi antara rencana dan realisasi sebagai dasar evaluasi operasional dapur produksi. * Menganalisis tingkat efisiensi proses produksi, termasuk penggunaan bahan baku, waktu proses, serta tingkat waste dan reject produk, guna mengidentifikasi potensi pemborosan dan peluang peningkatan efisiensi operasional. * Bekerja sama dengan Standardization Officer dan Kitchen Manager untuk membandingkan biaya aktual dengan standar resep dan merekomendasikan penyesuaian proses. * Menyusun laporan produksi harian, mingguan, dan bulanan yang mencakup output, efisiensi, waste, serta tren kinerja produksi untuk disampaikan kepada Kitchen Sentral Manager sebagai bahan pengambilan keputusan operasional dan strategis. * Memberikan dukungan data dan analisis untuk kebutuhan forecasting dan perencanaan produksi dengan mengolah histori permintaan outlet, tren penjualan, serta kapasitas produksi guna membantu manajemen dalam menentukan rencana produksi yang optimal. * Membantu analisis biaya produksi dan food cost melalui pengolahan data penggunaan bahan baku dan output produksi, serta mengidentifikasi faktor penyebab selisih biaya sebagai dasar rekomendasi pengendalian cost dapur produksi. * Menyusun rekomendasi perbaikan proses produksi berdasarkan hasil analisis data, termasuk usulan peningkatan efisiensi, pengurangan waste, dan optimalisasi alur kerja untuk mendukung continuous improvement Central Kitchen. **Persyaratan** --------------- * S1 Teknologi Pangan, Manajemen Industri, Teknologi Industri atau bidang relevant lainnya * Pengalaman minimal 2 - 3 tahun sebagai PPIC atau Kitchen Production Analyst * Soft Competency: Analytical Thinking, Attention to Detail, Problem Solving, Critical Thinking, Communication Skills * Technical Competency: Production Data Analysis, Operational Performance Monitoring, Reporting & Dashboard Preparation, Food Cost & Waste Analysis, Production Planning Support **Ringkasan lowongan** ---------------------- Kategori FULLTIME Departemen KITCHEN PRODUCTION DEPARTMENT Outlet SENTRAL PAMULANG Kebutuhan 1 Orang · Pria

jobs.title: SPORT ANALYST INTERNATIONAL
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Analis Sepak Bola lnternasional** Bertanggung jawab menyajikan analisis pertandingan dan kompetisi berbasis data serta sumber tepercaya sebagai bahan editorial untuk preview, prediksi, dan liputan sepak bola. Deskripsi Pekerjaan * Menganalisis performa terkini tim dan pemain dengan mempertimbangkan hasil, konsistensi, produktivitas, serta konteks pertandingan. * Mengkaji pendekatan taktik, kekuatan dan kelemahan, kemungkinan susunan pemain, absensi, kondisi kandang/tandang, serta faktor teknis lain yang relevan. * Menganalisis rekor pertemuan, jadwal, kondisi kompetisi, dan data pendukung lain tanpa mengabaikan keterbatasan atau konteks datanya. * Menyusun preview dan prediksi pertandingan, termasuk alasan yang mendasari prediksi; membedakan fakta, interpretasi, dan opini dengan jelas. * Membuat brief analisis yang ringkas, akurat, mudah dipahami, dan dapat digunakan Editor sebagai bahan pengembangan artikel. * Memantau berita dan perkembangan yang berdampak pada analisis, serta memperbarui brief bila terdapat perubahan penting. * Mencantumkan sumber untuk data dan klaim, memeriksa keandalan sumber, dan tidak menyajikan spekulasi sebagai fakta. * Berkolaborasi dengan Editor untuk memastikan sudut analisis sesuai kebutuhan pembaca dan rencana editorial. **Kualifikasi** * Memiliki pengetahuan mendalam tentang sepak bola Indonesia, Vietnam, dan internasional serta kompetisi, klub, pemain, dan taktik. * Mampu menganalisis performa, taktik, rekor pertemuan, dan faktor teknis; mampu menjelaskan kesimpulan secara logis dan terstruktur. * Terampil melakukan riset dari beberapa sumber tepercaya dan memeriksa konsistensi data sebelum digunakan. * Mampu menulis dalam bahasa Indonesia dengan jelas; mampu membaca sumber berbahasa Inggris menjadi nilai tambah. * Teliti, kritis, memenuhi tenggat, dan terbuka terhadap evaluasi hasil prediksi maupun kualitas analisis. * Nilai tambah: pengalaman membuat preview/prediksi, menggunakan data statistik sepak bola, atau bekerja dengan media olahraga. * Perlu dicatat, khususnya, bahwa para editor tidak diperbolehkan menggunakan kecerdasan buatan (AI) untuk menulis artikel. Work Location: Hybrid remote in Jakarta Raya

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Requirements :** * Pendidikan minimal S1 jurusan Teknik informatika dan bidang terkait lainnya * Minimal 2 tahun di bidang Data Engineering / Database Developer * Mampu memahami kebutuhan bisnis & mentranslasikannya ke kebutuhan data * Terbiasa bekerja dengan dataset besar dan kompleks * Paham konsep data quality, data validation, dan error handling * Pernah menangani **end-to-end ETL** (dari extract di source → transform → load ke DW) * Detail-oriented, disiplin dokumentasi (ETL job, data lineage) * Problem solving & troubleshooting database **Responsibility :** * Pengalaman query kompleks & optimasi (Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL). *Familiar dengan indexing, partitioning, dan performance tuning.* * Membangun pipeline *ETL/ELT* untuk memindahkan data antar database. * Familiar dengan tools ETL/ELT (Apache Airflow, Talend, Pentaho, dbt, SSIS). * Paham konsep *CDC (Change Data Capture), batch vs streaming.* * *Python (wajib, untuk scripting ETL & integrasi).* * Pengalaman desain data warehouse berbasis *PostgreSQL.* * Paham konsep OLTP vs OLAP. Paham data modeling *(star schema, snowflake schema).* * Familiar dengan koneksi antar *DB (ODBC, JDBC).* * Pengalaman dengan API / message queue (Kafka, RabbitMQ) nilai plus. * Pengalaman dengan *cloud platform (AWS RDS/Redshift, GCP BigQuery, Azure Synapse).* * CI/CD pipeline untuk data (Git, Jenkins/GitLab CI). * *Docker / Kubernetes untuk deployment data pipeline.* **Output :** * Pipeline data otomatis (scheduler) * Konsolidasi data dari Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server ke PostgreSQL * Dokumentasi lengkap (job list, mapping source → target * Monitoring & alerting untuk job ETL * Data warehouse siap dipakai tim BI / Data Analyst. Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu, Kontrak Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

jobs.title: Technical Specialist - Mechanical
jobs.descriptionHtml: JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally. Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally. Monitoring and controlling critical infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance, energy efficiency, and 24/7 operational reliability. **Responsibilities:** **Environmental Control:** Manages precise temperature and humidity levels throughout server rooms, cold aisles, and hot aisles. Controls HVAC systems, chillers, air handlers, and cooling distribution to maintain optimal operating conditions for IT equipment. Monitors airflow patterns and adjusts cooling strategies based on real-time heat loads. **Power Management:** Monitors electrical distribution from utility feeds through UPS systems, generators, and power distribution units (PDUs). Tracks power consumption, load balancing, and power usage effectiveness (PUE). Manages automatic transfer switches and generator start sequences during power events. **Fire and Safety Systems:** Integrates fire detection, suppression systems, and emergency response protocols. Manages pre-action sprinkler systems, gas suppression zones, and smoke detection throughout the facility. Coordinates with security systems for access control and emergency evacuation procedures. **Monitoring and Alarming:** Provides real-time monitoring of thousands of data points including temperature sensors, power meters, flow rates, and equipment status. Generates automated alerts for threshold violations, equipment failures, or environmental deviations. Maintains historical data for trend analysis and predictive maintenance. **Energy Optimization:** Implements intelligent control strategies for cooling optimization, free cooling utilization, and load management. Analyzes operational data to identify efficiency opportunities and reduce operational costs while maintaining service level agreements. **Qualifications :** Minimum D3 in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, controls engineering, or related technical field. Experience with server hardware, networking equipment, and critical facility systems. Minimum 3-5 years’ experience with building automation systems in critical facilities. Data center or mission-critical environment experience strongly preferred. If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table! Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth: JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. About JLL – We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities. Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally. Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

jobs.title: Operational Excellence Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml: Kenvue is currently recruiting for a: Operational Excellence Lead **What we do** At Kenvue, we realize the extraordinary power of everyday care. Built on over a century of heritage and rooted in science, we’re the house of iconic brands - including NEUTROGENA®, AVEENO®, TYLENOL®, LISTERINE®, JOHNSON’S® and BAND-AID® that you already know and love. Science is our passion; care is our talent. **Who We Are** Our global team is ~ 22,000 brilliant people with a workplace culture where every voice matters, and every contribution is appreciated. We are passionate about insights, innovation and committed to delivering the best products to our customers. With expertise and empathy, being a Kenvuer means having the power to impact millions of people every day. We put people first, care fiercely, earn trust with science and solve with courage – and have brilliant opportunities waiting for you! Join us in shaping our future–and yours. **Role reports to:** Selfcare E2E Ecosystem Improvement Lead **Location:** Asia Pacific, Indonesia, Jawa, Jakarta Raya **Work Location:** Fully Onsite **What you will do** The **Operational Excellence Lead** spearheads the site Operational Excellence and transformation agenda, driving sustainable improvements in manufacturing performance, productivity, and organizational capability. The role combines Operational Excellence, New Product Development (NPD)/New Product Improvement (NPI) and product transfer leadership, project management, and digital transformation, working cross-functionally to translate business priorities into strong execution and measurable impact. This role is based at the Integrated Healthcare Indonesia (IHI) site in Jakarta-Bogor, Indonesia. **Key Responsibilities** **Operational Excellence & Transformation** * Lead the site Operational Excellence strategy, transformation agenda, and improvement roadmap. * Drive LEAN, Kaizen, OEE improvement, productivity, loss elimination, and structured problem-solving initiatives. * Identify and prioritize improvement opportunities based on operational performance, business needs, and value creation. * Establish a strong continuous improvement culture with clear ownership and sustainable results. **NPD / NPI & Manufacturing Readiness** * Lead and coordinate NPD/NPI, product transfers, process changes, and manufacturing readiness activities. * Drive cross-functional execution from project initiation through implementation, ensuring manufacturing requirements and risks are addressed. * Partner with R&D, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, Planning, Procurement, Regulatory, and Manufacturing to enable successful project delivery. **Project & Program Management** * Lead complex cross-functional projects across initiation, planning, execution, risk management, implementation, and stabilization. * Establish robust project governance, milestone tracking, risk mitigation, escalation, and stakeholder alignment. * Ensure priorities, dependencies, accountabilities, and deliverables are clearly defined across project teams. * Translate project information into clear recommendations and updates for key stakeholders and leadership. **Digitalization & Automation** * Identify and accelerate digitalization, automation, and process optimization opportunities across site operations. * Leverage operational data and digital solutions to simplify processes, improve decision-making, eliminate non-value-added activities, and enhance performance. * Connect digital initiatives with the broader Operational Excellence roadmap to ensure technology delivers tangible business value. **Capability Building** * Build organizational capability in continuous improvement, structured problem solving, Lean methodologies, and project management. * Coach and facilitate cross-functional teams in identifying opportunities and converting ideas into sustainable improvements. * Strengthen data-driven decision-making and ownership of operational performance across the organization. **What We Are Looking For** =========================== * **Minimum 5 years of proven experience in a managerial or leadership position**, ideally within Manufacturing, Operational Excellence, Engineering, NPD/NPI, or Project Management * Demonstrated track record in leading **Operational Excellence and business transformation**, delivering measurable improvements in productivity, efficiency, and operational performance * Proven experience leading **NPD/NPI, product introduction, product transfer, and complex cross-functional manufacturing projects** * Strong command of **Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, OEE, Six Sigma, loss elimination, and structured problem solving** * Strong **end-to-end project management capability**, including governance, scope, timeline, resource, risk, and stakeholder management * Experience operating within a **GMP-regulated manufacturing environment**, with a strong understanding of quality and compliance requirements * Strong ability to **translate strategy into execution**, prioritize opportunities, and drive sustainable business results * Excellent **leadership, communication, influencing, and stakeholder management** capabilities across functions and organizational levels * A strong balance of **strategic thinking, people leadership, and hands-on execution**, with the ability to challenge the status quo and lead change **What’s In It For You** ======================== * Competitive Benefit Package * Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation & More! * Learning & Development Opportunities * Employee Resource Groups *Kenvue is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.* If you are an individual with a disability, please check our Disability Assistance page for information on how to request an accommodation.

jobs.title: Head of Business & Growth - GoPay Later
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the Role** As Head of Business & Growth for GoPay Later, you’ll own the growth of product by combining business understanding, data, and customer insights to find where the next wave of growth and opportunity will come from. You’ll turn those opportunities into go-to-market plans across product and marketing and drive them from strategy through execution and measurement, with clear accountability. Lead the team, set clear direction, and develop people to deliver aspirational goals. ### **What You Will Do** * Own GoPay Later’s growth strategy and targets for users, transactions, and GTV, and translate them into a clear strategy of prioritized initiatives. * Identify new growth opportunities through data analysis, customer research, and market understanding, including new user segments, use cases, merchants, and ecosystem touchpoints. * Develop go-to-market plans for new and existing initiatives, marketing campaigns, and partnership levers. * Develop the product roadmap, leveraging customer insights and data to decide which features and improvements to build and in the right order of priority. * Drive cross-functional execution with Marketing, Product, Risk, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, aligning priorities and removing blockers to get initiatives live. * Work with the credit risk team to balance growth with credit quality, ensuring initiatives grow the portfolio responsibly. * Lead and develop a high-performing team. ### **What You Will Need** * 8+ years of experience in business growth, strategy, or product/business management roles in the BNPL or consumer lending industry. * Proven track record of driving measurable growth in user, transaction, or revenue metrics for a consumer product. * Solid understanding of credit products and the trade-off between growth and risk. * Strong data analytical skills; comfortable working hands-on with data to find insights, size opportunities, and evaluate impact. * Experience taking initiatives end to end, from opportunity identification and GTM planning to execution and post-launch measurement. * Ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority, including with senior stakeholders. **About the Team** You’ll be part of the GoPayLater team, which builds and grows BNPL products within the GoTo ecosystem. Our mission is to make flexible, responsible credit accessible to millions of Indonesians, many of whom are underserved by traditional financial institutions. We are a tight-knit group who are bonded by two things: our genuine desire to add value to the lives of our consumers and the growth mindset and passion to make an impact. Our team enjoys what we do since we get to see the impact of our work reflected in our consumer's everyday lives. Come join our family to see what we mean! **About GoTo Group** GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy. The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago. **About Gojek** Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market. **About GoTo Financial** GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last. *GoTo and its business units, including Gojek and GoToFinancial ("GoTo") only post job opportunities on our official channels on our respective company websites and on LinkedIn. GoTo is not liable for any job postings or job offers that did not originate from us. You should conduct your own due diligence to prevent being victims of any fake job scams, if they did not originate from GoTo's official recruitment channels.* *#LI-ONSITE* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

We are a tight-knit group who are bonded by two things: our genuine desire to add value to the lives of our consumers and the growth mindset and passion to make an impact. Our team enjoys what we do since we get to see the impact of our work reflected in our consumer's everyday lives. Come join our family to see what we mean! **About GoTo Group** GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy. The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago. **About Gojek** Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market. **About GoTo Financial** GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last. *GoTo and its business units, including Gojek and GoToFinancial ("GoTo") only post job opportunities on our official channels on our respective company websites and on LinkedIn. GoTo is not liable for any job postings or job offers that did not originate from us. You should conduct your own due diligence to prevent being victims of any fake job scams, if they did not originate from GoTo's official recruitment channels.* *#LI-ONSITE* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. jobs.title: P&G Indonesia Management Internship - PRODUCT SUPPLY
jobs.descriptionHtml: Location KARAWANG JAWA BARAT, Indonesia Category Supply Chain and Logistics Job Id R000162231 Job Type Full time Internships **Job Location** JAKARTA PLANT **Job Description** **Job Description** Did you know that at P&G we consider Product Supply (PS) as the engine that accelerates value creation? Getting thousands of different products onto the shelves in our customer's stores in the right quantities with precise quality in a timely manner really does present meaningful work every single day. **Description of the Role** You will be working with line engineers and multi-functional teams within the department to drive operation results and loss elimination for the site. You will discover our leading technologies which are world renowned. All these missions require strong multi-functional work, which means that you'll work with other functions both internally and externally and you will be responsible for ensuring we have the right product at the right place at the right cost. **What We Offer** * You will have business responsibilities from Day 1 – You will work on at least one or two big projects. * You will receive continuous coaching & mentorship– We are passionate about our work. We will make sure you receive both formal training and regular mentorship from your manager and others. * You will join our dynamic and respectful Sales teams and work closely with colleagues from other functions – We live our Purpose, Values, and Principles daily. We value every individual and encourage initiatives promoting agility and work/life balance. * You will focus in outcome-based project. **Internship Information** Our interns are considered the best pipeline of talent for our Permanent positions. Based on your performance, you may get full-time job offer from P&G. **Job Qualifications** * You are **3rd year or last year students in all engineering majors** and/or science-related fields of study. * You are still university students **(haven't graduated yet) as of 18 January 2027** * **Committed to do a full-time internship for 3-month/12-week (18 January 2027 - 30 April 2027).** * Have basic analytical thinking for insights-based decision-making and learning to use various data-centric and digital technologies. * Born leaders who are passionate about making things happen. * Have an external focus and a real passion for product supply. * Like to bring creativity & innovation to their work. * Have strong analytical thinking and skills. * Collaborate well with diverse groups of people. * Willing to be relocated. **About Us** We produce globally recognized brands and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide. Visit http://www.pg.com to know more. Our consumers are diverse and our talents - internally - mirror this diversity to best serve it. That is why we’re committed to building a winning culture based on Inclusion and our ideal candidate is passionate about the same principle: you will join our daily effort of being “in touch” so we craft brands and products to improve the lives of the world’s consumers now and in the future. We want you to inspire us with your unrivaled ideas. We are committed to providing equal opportunities in employment. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, veteran status, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor. P&G is improving everyday life as a Force for Growth and a Force for Good — for you, for the world, and for generations to come. **Job Schedule** Full time **Job Number** R000162231 **Job Segmentation** Internships
