jobs.title: Production Assistant
jobs.descriptionHtml: Would you like to join a global, growing company that innovates for a more sustainable tomorrow? UPM could be the team for you. We are frontrunners in developing renewable alternatives to fossil-based materials. Besides enabling both businesses and consumers make more sustainable choices, we strive to create a positive UPM experience for all our employees around the world. We live by our values – trust and be trusted, achieve together, renew with courage. Together we can renew the everyday, for a future beyond fossils! Learn more about us as a workplace upm.com/careers We are now looking for a **Production Assistant** . This position is located in **Cikarang, Bekasi, Indonesia.** **What you will do** * Assist in managing terminal operation. To be second in charge of Terminal Operation Manager and assist with the assigned project. Manage stock preparation of indirect materials, spare part, tools and equipment for the production lines. Manage preventive maintenance plan of whole terminal * Arrange production planning and overtime management, monitor staff performance and provide guidance, coaching and training onboarding of new employees. Assist in preparing daily production schedules, work plan, and activities report * Help ensure that company policies, procedures, and operational standards are followed. Communicate important information and operational issues to the Terminal Manager. Respond quickly and effectively to operational issues or emergencies. Assist the management team in achieving sales, productivity, and customer satisfaction targets * Coordinate with the relevant departments-Engineering team, BSS, IT, Sales and customer service to ensure production requirements are met. Understand and apply operational knowledge of the daily procedures, safety standards, inventory / stock and company policies * Communicate production updates and instructions to relevant team members. Assist with coordination between departments, suppliers, and service providers. Respond to routine inquiries and escalate issues to the appropriate manager. Attend production meetings and record key information and action items. Help maintain an organized, clean, and safe production work area * Maintain accurate and up-to-date production information, standard operating procedures (SOP’s), follow company policies and workplace safety requirements. Manage PO/PR related documents to ensure sufficient stock of indirect materials and spare parts, including finding supplier, RFQ and 3rd party contractor. Prepare, organize and maintain production documents, forms, reports and records. Completed the others task assigned by Terminal Manager. Prepare daily, weekly, or monthly production reports as required. Track outstanding tasks and follow up with relevant personnel * Assist in checking the availability of materials, tools, and equipment. Coordinate the delivery, collection, and distribution of production supplies. Report damage, missing, or insufficient materials and equipment. Maintain proper housekeeping and organization in the production area Implement the UPM safety rules and standard with regard to the JA terminal operations. Lead environmental training, safety and 5S activities. Support corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives as directed **Who you are** * You hold a Diploma or Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Mechanical Engineering or Industrial Engineering. You have additional training in business, which is an advantage. You may also be considered if you have a different academic background considered supported by type and duration of relevant work experience * You have at least 2-4 years of experience in a similar position, or in a supervisory, team lead, or other relevant role. You have previous experience in production, administration, operations, or coordination; however, it is preferred rather than required. You are fluent in both written and spoken English, with other languages being an advantage * You are proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word and Power Point), and knowledge with SAP, email, data entry and other applications will be an advantage * You have positive attitude and ability to collaborate across the boundaries in a cross functional team. You have strong leadership and communication skills at all levels and good foundation of interpersonal skills * You have strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, organizational and time management skills, team management capabilities and willingness to learn. You are reliable, responsible, and able to work independently and under pressure * You are flexible and willing to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays when required. You can prioritize your workload and manage multiple tasks. You have safety awareness You are good at documentation and record-keeping. You can work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines **This is what we offer to you** * **A meaningful job:** We have an inspiring purpose “We renew the everyday for a future beyond fossils”. Our work is impactful and transformative. * **A caring community:** Our community is built on great team spirit and shared commitment. We care about each other and the well-being of our colleagues. We support the work-life balance of all our employees. * **Development opportunities:** We offer you great opportunities to learn and grow throughout your career. We are an international, multi-business organization offering plenty of avenues for personal growth. * **Responsible employer:** Sustainability is at the core of everything we do. We are committed to ambitious, science-based sustainability targets in all areas, from climate change mitigation to enhancing biodiversity. We foster diversity and inclusivity, offering a work environment in which everyone can be themselves. Learn about our Rewarding and our Ways of working > **Additional information about the position** --------------------------------------------- For support with submitting your application, please contact the HR Service Center at careers@upm.com . #LI-DNP

jobs.title: Product Lead - Flight Product Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Posting Date2026.11.04 Job TypeRegular TeamProduct Management Location BSD City, Indonesia About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region. **Job Description** =================== *Job ID: MJ000437* **About the Role** Traveloka is looking for a Product Manager Lead to drive flight supply operational performance across all markets and lead a team of Product Operations. You will combine product thinking, flight supply expertise and people leadership to improve inventory quality, fare competitiveness, price accuracy and booking reliability. Ideally, you bring product management experience in flight supply or an equivalent domain, alongside a strong understanding of product operations. **Key Responsibilities** * Own operational results across flight markets, translating business objectives into clear plans and measurable outcomes while balancing customer impact, commercial value, technical feasibility and risk. * Demonstrate product thinking to recurring operational challenges, including defining quantified problems, evaluating trade-offs, shaping requirements and measuring outcomes. * Lead investigations and improvements across inventory availability, pricing, supplier integrations, booking and ticket issuance, using data, API logs and transaction evidence to guide decisions. * Align Business, Product, Integration, Supply Platform, Engineering and suppliers on priorities, ownership and delivery commitments, maintaining accountability through to verified outcomes. * Lead and develop five Product Operations ICs through clear expectations, delegation, coaching, performance management, workload planning and cross-training. * Oversee operational incidents, configuration changes and launches, ensuring appropriate approvals, testing, recovery plans and post-change validation. * Drive consistent playbooks, process improvements and validated AI or automation adoption, partnering with the separately led Operational Excellence function and measuring sustained benefits. **Requirements** * Minimum 10+ years of relevant experience across product management, flight supply, airline distribution, travel technology, product operations or related domains. * Product management experience in flight supply or an equivalent domain is strongly preferred, with demonstrated problem framing, prioritization and delivery of measurable outcomes. * Strong expertise in flight distribution and integrations, including GDS, NDC, airline-direct and third-party supply, alongside a practical understanding of product operations. * Proven people leadership, including setting direction, delegating, coaching, managing performance and delivering results through others. * Strong analytical, commercial and stakeholder management skills, including practical SQL proficiency, the ability to interpret API logs and transaction behavior, and experience securing cross-functional commitments.

jobs.title: A&A - Analyst - IT Controls, AI, Data & Data Analytics
jobs.descriptionHtml: » * Start apply with LinkedIn * Apply Now * Start * **Please wait...** **A&A - Analyst - IT Controls, AI, Data & Data Analytics** ========================================================== Date: 4 Nov 2026 Service Line / Portfolios: Assurance Location: Jakarta, ID **Title:** Service Line (based in Jakarta) – Associate, Analyst, Consultant **Are you ready to unleash your potential?** At Deloitte, our purpose is to make an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and the communities we serve. We believe we have a responsibility to be a force for good, and WorldImpact is our portfolio of initiatives focused on making a tangible impact on society’s biggest challenges and creating a better future. We strive to advise clients on how to deliver purpose-led growth and embed more equitable, inclusive as well as sustainable business practices. Hence, we seek talented individuals driven to excel and innovate, working together to achieve our shared goals. We are committed to creating positive work experiences that foster a culture of respect and inclusion, where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and everyone is recognised for their contributions. Ready to unleash your potential with us? Join the winning team now! **Work you’ll do** * Analyze & formulate IT and Business cases into practical analytics solutions * Work as a specialist team under IT, Data, and Analytics team (ITDA) for both IT Audit Support and IT Assurance/Advisory engagements * Provide Data Analytics & Visualization services to support Financial Audit team or Clients directly in order to meet their requirements. * Develop analytics models and solutions by using predictive analytics, statistics, optimization, machine learning, optimal sampling, experimental design and other techniques * Deliver clear and actionable recommendations to all stakeholders, esp for Data-related * Perform any other tasks or assignments related to Data Analytics & Visualization and others IT Audit services **Your role as a leader** At Deloitte, we believe in the importance of empowering our people to be leaders at all levels. We connect our purpose and shared values to identify issues as well as to make an impact that matters to our clients, people and the communities. Additionally, Associates / Analysts / Consultants across our Firm are expected to: * Demonstrate a strong commitment to personal learning and development. * Understand how our daily work contributes to the priorities of the team and business. * Understand the set expectations and demonstrate accountability in keeping personal performance on track. * Actively focus on developing effective communications and relationship-building skills with stakeholders, clients and team. * Demonstrate an appreciation for working with others. * Understand what is fundamental to Deloitte’s success as a business. * Demonstrate integrity and an awareness of strengths, differences, and personal impact. * Develop their understanding of Deloitte and offer a fresh perspective. **Requirements** * Bachelor's Degree or above in quantitative fields such as Data Science/Analytics, AI, Engineering, Computer Science/Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or related fields * Experiences in IT Audit & Advisory or IT Audit / Risk Management / Compliance in other corporate companies (e.g., Financial Service, Telecommunication, Consumer Products) would be advantage. * Knowledge of IT Governance, Risk, and Compliance. * Hands-on experiences in using Data Analytic & Visualization tools (e.g., R, Python, Tableau, PowerBI, SQL, etc) is a must. * Analytical thinking, able to process and interpret business questions into technical data analysis for answers, and vice versa * Good analytical, problem-solving, communication and presentation skills * Can work under pressure both independently and a part of team * Willingness to continuously learn and improve, grow along with work experience, “always coachable” * “Can do” and professional "get it done" attitudes, and fast moving * Ability to come up with complex business analysis conclusion for communication with management is a very advanced requirement for year 0 or 2 delivery team member (analyst or even consultant) – more fitting for Senior Consultant. But it is a plus. * Understanding of audit concept, framework, regulatory stipulations, including its technical specifications, standards are quite rarity for analytics practitioners. Also “a plus”. **Due to volume of applications, we regret only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Candidates will only be contacted by authorized Deloitte Recruiters via firm’s business contact number or business email address.** Requisition ID: 117112 In Indonesia, the services are provided by Imelda & Rekan and other related entities in Indonesia ("Deloitte in Indonesia"), which are affiliates of Deloitte Southeast Asia Ltd. Deloitte Southeast Asia Ltd is a member firm of Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Limited. Deloitte in Indonesia, which is within the Deloitte Network, is the entity that is providing this Website. » * Start apply with LinkedIn * Apply Now * Start * **Please wait...** Find similar jobs: View all Job, Experienced, Audit & Assurance

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (SDR)
jobs.descriptionHtml: The Sales Development Representative is the starting point of AMODA's outbound engine. You will find and qualify companies that need fast, modular buildings (offices, outlets, clinics, sales galleries, site facilities), book meetings for our Business Development team, and make sure every meeting you hand over is genuinely worth a BD's time. You will work from target lists prepared with Marketing, and your success is measured by meetings that BDs accept and that move forward into design. Responsibilities * Plan and build contact lists in target segments (manufacturing, retail, corporate, healthcare, property) from target lists, LinkedIn, databases, and partner networks. * Run multi-channel outreach (phone, WhatsApp, email, LinkedIn) following AMODA's cadence and scripts. * Reach a consistent daily activity level and log every activity in Bigin. * Qualify prospects against AMODA's criteria: real need, project location, timeline within 6 months, reaction to indicative pricing, decision maker access, and minimum deal size. * Book first meetings for the Mid-size BD team and hand over complete lead information in Bigin. * Nurture leads that are not ready yet and re-engage them when timing fits. * Share weekly insights on objections, segment response, and message performance with BD and Marketing. * Help refine target lists, scripts, and qualification criteria based on what converts. **Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in any field (Business, Marketing, Communication, Architecture or Engineering is a plus). * 1–3 years of experience in outbound sales, telesales, SDR/BDR, or business development, preferably B2B. * Comfortable making many calls and messages per day and handling rejection. * Good written and spoken Bahasa Indonesia; working English. * B2B prospecting in construction, property, building materials, interior, or industrial products. * Experience using a CRM (Bigin, Zoho, HubSpot, Pipedrive) and LinkedIn for prospecting. * Track record of hitting meeting or lead targets. * High energy, fast pace, and persistence in follow-up. * Curious and good at asking questions to uncover real needs. * Disciplined and organized; keeps data clean. * Coachable and open to feedback.

jobs.title: Process Electrician Superintendent
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Job Overview:** The Process Electrician Superintendent role requires an in-depth understanding of project execution strategies, workforce management theories, and Process Electrician principles, with a basic knowledge of related disciplines. The Process Electrician Superintendent must be able to apply industry insights to enhance on-site productivity, provide leadership, and influence processes and policies for effective workforce governance, as well as identify and resolve technical, operational, and organizational problems that impact project outcomes. The Process Electrician Superintendent’s decisions are pivotal in ensuring that the team meets its objectives with efficiency and adherence to safety standards. These decisions should be guided by established policies, resource allocations, budget considerations, and the overarching project plan. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably. For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries. **Key Tasks and Responsibilities:** * Supervise all process electrical activities in the fabrication department, ensuring that installation, maintenance, and repair work is performed in accordance with project specifications and safety standards * Enforce adherence to electrical safety regulations and best practices, conducting regular safety meetings and training to maintain a zero-incident workplace * Collaborate with project managers and other superintendents to coordinate electrical tasks with the overall project schedule, ensuring timely completion and integration with other trades * Oversee the selection, installation, testing, and commissioning of electrical systems, including power distribution, control systems, and instrumentation * Manage a team of process electricians, providing leadership, guidance, and support to achieve high-quality electrical work and adherence to industry standards * Monitor the use of materials and equipment, maintaining inventory control and ensuring the availability of necessary resources for project execution * Perform quality control inspections of electrical work, verifying that installations are up to code and meet operational requirements * Communicate effectively with clients, contractors, and team members to provide updates, resolve issues, and ensure project objectives are met * Own and lead the implementation, enforcement, and verification of compliance with all McDermott policies and procedures * Ensure employees understand their responsibility and authority to effectively implement the requirements of all McDermott policies and procedures * Ensure the timely completion of all mandatory training by themselves and their teams **Essential Qualifications and Education:** * Technical diploma or certification in Electrical Technology, Industrial Electricity, or a related field, with a strong background in process electrical work within a fabrication setting * Proven experience as a process electrician with a history of progression to supervisory roles, demonstrating the ability to manage teams and projects * Knowledge of electrical codes, standards, and practices, with a focus on safety and quality in electrical installations and maintenance * Experience in implementing and maintaining electrical safety protocols, with a commitment to creating a safe working environment * Leadership and team management skills, with the ability to mentor and motivate electricians to perform at their best * Organizational and planning skills, capable of managing multiple tasks and prioritizing effectively to meet project deadlines * Strong communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with a diverse range of stakeholders and convey technical information clearly * Flexibility to adapt to different project requirements and work environments, including the availability to work overtime or on shifts as needed #LI-DL1

The Civil Engineer understands key business drivers and applies this knowledge to solve problems in straightforward situations by analyzing possible solutions using technical experience, judgment, and precedents. jobs.title: Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer (Fullstack) - 2 Job Title Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform Job Description About the Role We’re hiring for a Full-stack Engineer for Flip's newly created AI Platform team. You will be working with the technology that will support and empower our various product offerings, including but not limited to payments & transfers, lifestyle products, gaming, payment gateway, and many others. You’ll be working across both front-end and back-end components — turning ideas into impactful features that enhance user experience and business efficiency. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, fellow engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to design, develop, and optimize solutions that align with our technical and business goals. You’ll also have the opportunity to continuously improve our codebase, share best practices, and explore new technologies that keep our systems robust and future ready. About Flip Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After ten years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **What you will be doing:** * **Ship End-to-End:** Own features from design to release—spot UX gaps early, ship core value first, log tech debt deliberately, and clean it up later. * **Partner with Product:** Analyze technical feasibility, document requirements, estimate timelines, and build work plans alongside product managers. * **Empower the Team:** Unblock peers through prompt PR reviews, pair programming, and hands-on coaching. * **Work Smarter with AI:** Leverage AI tools for routine tasks (unit tests, docs, clarifications) to maximize time spent on core logic. * **Lead & Architect:** Formulate web frontend architecture, drive tech stack decisions, and uphold engineering best practices. ### **What we need from you:** * **Experience:** **Minimum 3 years** of software engineering experience building Web Frontend applications (**ReactJS**). * **Technical Core:** Strong grasp of web frontend architecture, OOP, and software design patterns. * **Product Mindset:** A strong sense of ownership—treating what you ship as your own codebase is a must. * **Pragmatic Learner:** Drive to learn new technologies and apply them practically to solve business problems. * **Collaborative Spirit:** Outstanding problem-solving skills, open-mindedness to learn from peers, and a desire to elevate your team. **Nice-to-Haves:** * Full-stack versatility and readiness to tackle new frameworks across the stack. * Experience deploying software on scalable cloud platforms (e.g., AWS).

jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: We are seeking a creative, detail-oriented Graphic Designer to join our marketing team. In this role, you will develop visual concepts, create engaging graphics across digital and print media, and ensure our brand identity remains strong and consistent. You will collaborate closely with copywriters, marketers, and product managers to translate strategic goals into high-impact visual stories. **Key Responsibilities** * **Visual Asset Creation:** Design compelling graphics for digital channels (social media, website banners, email templates, digital ads) and print materials (brochures, flyers, packaging, event collateral). * **Brand Management:** Maintain and evolve brand guidelines, ensuring consistent visual identity across all marketing touchpoints. * **Collaboration & Concepting:** Brainstorm visual concepts with cross-functional teams and translate creative briefs into clear design solutions. * **Production & Pre-Press:** Prepare final production-ready files for web (optimized formats) and print (color proofing, bleed, typography adjustments). * **Project Management:** Prioritize multiple design requests, meet tight deadlines, and incorporate stakeholder feedback efficiently. **Qualifications & Requirements** * **Education & Experience:** Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Fine Arts, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience with a strong portfolio). * **Portfolio:** A diverse portfolio showcasing expertise in typography, layout, color theory, and visual story-telling across digital and print formats. * **Technical Proficiency:**⚬ Advanced skills in **Adobe Creative Cloud** (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign).⚬ Hands-on experience with modern design/prototyping tools like **Figma** or **Sketch**. * **Design Fundamentals:** Deep understanding of composition, grid systems, image editing, and digital media formats. * **Soft Skills:** Strong communication skills, openness to constructive feedback, and the ability to manage time independently in a fast-paced environment. **Preferred Qualifications** * Basic knowledge of motion graphics/video editing (**Adobe After Effects** or **Premiere Pro**). * Experience with HTML/CSS or email marketing builders (e.g., Mailchimp, Figma-to-code plugins). * Familiarity with UI/UX principles and digital accessibility (WCAG) standards. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Overview** In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a **Critical Environment Electrical Engineer.** Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Electrical Engineer, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. **Responsibilities** **Responsibilities**: ***Design*** * Develop basic knowledge of industry trends, competitors' products, customer experience, and advances in various engineering fields. Consult with other engineers to help understand and apply advanced concepts. * Assist in the creation and execution of robust, scalable, secure, and extensible designs and/or verification plans for the electrical engineering aspects of a well-defined feature or product extension (e.g., a product refresh, or line extension). * Participate in creating intellectual property. May file patents within personal area of scope and complete necessary patent documentation. * Implement known solutions to common technical and/or design challenges, with some guidance from other engineers. * Read device specification sheets and interpret common details required to design and test various hardware features. * Develop design documentation which could include drawings, specifications, schematics, or diagrams for features of well-defined products with guidance and direction from a manager or other engineers. * Review supplier or partner technical sheets for available parts and choose appropriate parts needed to support product development. ***Testing and Verification*** * Ensure that test requirements are included in documentation and specifications for a feature or product. * Determine the appropriate test equipment (e.g., oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, logic analyzers) for measuring a feature of a product according to existing verification plans, with minimal supervision from other engineers. * Write design verification test cases using standard templates and test methodologies. * Develop, review, and execute test plans and/or infrastructure for standard features or products. * Assist in developing automated testing solutions and independently conduct automated testing on standard feature areas or products. * Gather data for external testing supplier or partner selection options. * Assist in setting up and breaking down testing environments with guidance and supervision from other engineers. Follow safety guidelines. * Participate in the development of dashboards or reports for testing and quality metrics that can be utilized to characterize hardware and hardware performance. * Analyze and interpret results of data and statistical analyses to identify common problems or flaws that may affect a feature or product design change and bring them to the attention of other engineers or team leads. * Assist in the development of basic test fixtures for use in testing or validation of new product features under guidance from other engineers. ***Technical Project Implementation*** * Follow project implementation schedules to deliver the hardware engineering aspects of a well-defined feature or product. Escalate issues to management as necessary. * Implement and track product plans, under guidance from other engineers. * Highlight potential issues that may affect downstream execution of projects (e.g., performance vs. reliability and manufacturing concerns). * Research new tools, technologies, or processes for project implementation and provide reports to project team members. * Assist in implementing risk assessments (e.g., supplier or partner delays, incomplete specs, or tool issues) into project plans. * Communicate project progress/status within the project team and escalate issues as necessary. ***Reporting and Documentation*** * Follow established procedures to participate in creating detailed reports and functional specifications for a well-defined product feature or extension, based on audits and information from product development and verification processes. * Document essential details about materials, components, and/or assemblies for a device via accepted release processes. Accurately record and track changes to designs following established processes with some guidance from other engineers. ***Other*** * Embody the Microsoft One culture and values. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** * 4+ years of technical engineering experience + OR Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field **Background Check Requirements:** Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: * Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter. While not required, we also look for the following **Preferred Qualifications****:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field AND 1+ year(s) of technical engineering experience + OR Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About WegoPro** ----------------- WegoPro is the business travel platform built for modern companies. We help organisations simplify and control corporate travel by bringing together booking, approvals, policy, payments, and reporting into one intelligent platform. As part of the Wego Group, we're combining deep travel expertise with AI-first product development to redefine how businesses travel. **The Role** ------------ We're looking for a Senior Frontend Engineer to help build the frontend platform that powers WegoPro. You'll work on a sophisticated, data-rich product used every day by travel managers, finance teams, and business travellers around the world. This is a hands-on senior engineering role with significant technical ownership. You'll shape our frontend architecture, establish engineering standards, mentor other developers, and build AI-powered experiences that make complex workflows feel intuitive. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own the architecture and evolution of our frontend platform, including our design system, application state, routing, build tooling, and performance. * Build scalable frontend systems on top of a microservices architecture, designing resilient API integrations, caching strategies, and graceful fallbacks when services fail. * Develop AI-powered product experiences, including conversational booking, agentic workflows, and streaming interfaces that make AI interactions feel reliable and trustworthy. * Drive adoption of AI-assisted software development, helping define best practices for using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex across the engineering team. * Lead technical design discussions, perform thoughtful code reviews, and mentor engineers to raise the quality of the team's work. * Take ownership of software quality from development through production, including automated testing, observability, CI/CD, and operational excellence on AWS. * Partner closely with Product, Design, and Backend Engineering to deliver intuitive, performant user experiences. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Significant experience building modern web applications, with deep expertise developing complex, stateful single-page applications. * Expert knowledge of Vue 3, including the Composition API, Pinia, Nuxt, and a strong understanding of Vue's reactivity model. * Strong TypeScript skills and experience with modern frontend tooling, including Vite, code splitting, performance optimisation, and Core Web Vitals. * Excellent frontend engineering fundamentals, with a passion for building polished, accessible, responsive user interfaces. * Daily experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex, with sound judgement about where they accelerate development and where they don't. * Familiarity with modern AI application development, including MCP, agent frameworks, context engineering, evaluation frameworks, and shipping user-facing AI features. * Practical experience with AWS services including S3, CloudFront, Lambda, ECS, CI/CD pipelines, and feature flagging. * Strong communication skills, a collaborative mindset, and a bias for ownership, delivery, and continuous improvement. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience building products in business travel, fintech, or B2B SaaS. * Experience with micro-frontend architectures. * Experience building or maintaining design systems. * Contributions to open-source projects in the Vue or AI tooling ecosystem. **Why Join WegoPro?** jobs.descriptionHtml: Department Product Management LevelExperienced (Individual Contributor) LocationJakarta The Product Management team at Shopee is the key focal point between the business, engineering and design teams. The team is responsible for implementing strategy, road maps and features, while adhering to business goals. It covers all functions including but not limited to Financial Services, Supply Chain, Search, Recommendation, Advertising, Order, Promotion, User, Anti-Fraud, Seller Service. jobs.title: UI-UX Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Company Description** PT Adira Dinamika Multi Finance Tbk or Adira Finance was established in 1990 and started its operation in 1991. Since the beginning, Adira Finance committed to be the best and foremost finance company in Indonesia. Adira Finance presents to serve various financing as of vehicles, both new or used ones. Recognize the potential, Adira Finance began to conduct initial public offering for its shares in 2004 and Bank Danamon became the majority shareholder with 75% ownership. Through some corporate actions, currently Bank Danamon owns 92.07% of Adira Finance’s shares. Adira Finance is becoming part of Temasek Holding, an investment company owned by the Government of Singapore. In 2012, Adira Finance has augmented its business activities with sharia financing. In order to provide maximum financing service, the Company begin to provide durables financing for its customers. Until 2015, Adira Finance operated 558 business networks throughout Indonesia and supported by more than 21 thousand employees, to serve 3 million customers with more than Rp40 trillion of managed receivables. Adira Finance continuously contributes to the nation and the country of Indonesia. Through its brand identity and commitment, namely “Sahabat Setia Selamanya”, Adira Finance committed to impose its mission which ends with the increment of the welfare of the Indonesian society. It is performed through the providing of various products and services according to the customers’ life cycle as well as providing beneficial experiences to the customers. **Job Description** Are you a highly skilled UI/UX Designer? Do you thrive in a collaborative team environment where you can exchange creative ideas and concepts? Your role at Adira Finance will be strategic, conceptual, and executional—leveraging design as a way of articulating possibilities, solutions and vision We are looking for a highly creative individual to join our team as a Creative Designer! As a UI/UX Designer, your responsibilities are: * Provide real innovative on-line experience and design prototypes * Illustrate design ideas using storyboards, process flows and sitemaps * Design graphic user interface elements, like menus, tabs and widgets * Collaborate with product/project manager and engineers to define and implement innovative solutions for the product direction, visuals and experience * Prepare and present rough drafts to internal teams and key stakeholders * Incorporate design into existing/developed applications * Establish and promote design guidelines, best practices and standards * Work in an Agile team where there is close collaboration with the front-end and back-end developers and in an iterative manner. * Identify and troubleshoot UX problems (e.g. responsiveness) * Conduct layout adjustments based on user feedback **Qualifications** **Who is right for the job?** * Candidate must possess at least a Bachelor's Degree, Art/Design/Creative Multimedia, Computer Science/Information Technology, or equivalent. * At least 1 year(s) of working experience in the related field is **required** for this position. * Exceptional design skills, and attention to detail * Knowledge of wireframe tools (e.g. Wireframe.cc and InVision) Up-to-date knowledge of design software like Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop * Keep up-to-date with current design trends * Good knowledge of the UI/ UX methodology * Passion for creating experiences in online environments * Understanding of Agile software development * Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills **Additional Information** Note : To be considered, all applicants must submit a link to a portfolio site to https://bit.ly/2G0w9Fi

jobs.title: UX/UI Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: We are looking for a UX/UI Designer who is passionate about creating intuitive, engaging, and business-driven digital experiences. In this role, you will help shape user journeys for growth-focused, gamification, and affiliate features, translating complex financial and reward structures into simple, compelling interfaces that drive user action. You will work closely with Product, Business, and Engineering teams to design polished, production-ready solutions that balance engagement, clarity, trust, and regulatory requirements. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Design engaging user experiences that support growth and optimize the conversion funnel. * Translate financial, reward, gamification, and affiliate mechanisms into simple, high-impact UI and interaction designs. * Create experiences that encourage users to share, refer, gift, and engage with products within their network. * Use qualitative and quantitative insights, including analytics and user feedback, to inform design decisions and improve product performance. * Collaborate with Product, Business, and Engineering teams to define user flows, gather requirements, and deliver well-executed designs. * Contribute to and maintain design systems to support consistency and scalability across products. * Present design ideas clearly with structured thinking and a strong user-centered approach. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Design, Information Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, or equivalent. * 2-5 years of professional UX/UI design experience, preferably in a tech environment. * Strong portfolio showcasing real-world projects with business impact, clear problem-solving process, and user-centered thinking. * Strong visual and interaction design skills, with the ability to create intuitive and compelling user experiences. * Proficiency in design and prototyping tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud softwares. * Deep understanding in building, contributing to, or maintaining design systems. * Practical ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate design iteration. * Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally and working in a fast-paced environment. * Native-level fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and professional-level English, both written and spoken. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience designing for regulated industries such as payments, insurance, or banking. * Experience in fintech or other tech-driven industries. * Familiarity with gamification and affiliate product experiences is a plus.

You will work closely with Product, Business, and Engineering teams to design polished, production-ready solutions that balance engagement, clarity, trust, and regulatory requirements. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Design engaging user experiences that support growth and optimize the conversion funnel. * Translate financial, reward, gamification, and affiliate mechanisms into simple, high-impact UI and interaction designs. * Create experiences that encourage users to share, refer, gift, and engage with products within their network. * Use qualitative and quantitative insights, including analytics and user feedback, to inform design decisions and improve product performance. * Collaborate with Product, Business, and Engineering teams to define user flows, gather requirements, and deliver well-executed designs. * Contribute to and maintain design systems to support consistency and scalability across products. * Present design ideas clearly with structured thinking and a strong user-centered approach. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Design, Information Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, or equivalent. * 2-5 years of professional UX/UI design experience, preferably in a tech environment. * Strong portfolio showcasing real-world projects with business impact, clear problem-solving process, and user-centered thinking. * Strong visual and interaction design skills, with the ability to create intuitive and compelling user experiences. * Proficiency in design and prototyping tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud softwares. * Deep understanding in building, contributing to, or maintaining design systems. * Practical ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate design iteration. * Comfortable collaborating cross-functionally and working in a fast-paced environment. * Native-level fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and professional-level English, both written and spoken. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience designing for regulated industries such as payments, insurance, or banking. * Experience in fintech or other tech-driven industries. * Familiarity with gamification and affiliate product experiences is a plus.

jobs.title: UI/UX Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Jenis:** Full Time **Lokasi:** On-Site (Semarang) Kami sedang mencari UI/UX Designer yang kreatif dan berbakat untuk bergabung dengan Techarea. Sebagai UI/UX Designer, Anda akan memainkan peran penting dalam mengubah ide-ide dan konsep menjadi antarmuka pengguna yang menarik dan fungsional. **Tugas dan Kewajiban:** ------------------------ * Menyiapkan *storyboards*, alur proses, atau *sitemap* untuk memberikan pandangan holistik tentang desain. * Merancang *wireframe* yang akan menjadi dasar untuk pengembangan antarmuka pengguna. * Merancang antarmuka pengguna yang konsisten, fungsional, mudah dikembangkan, dan memikat secara visual. * Membuat *mockup* dan prototipe yang mencerminkan fungsionalitas desain. * Melakukan iterasi desain hingga mencapai desain yang optimal. * Bekerja sama secara erat dengan tim developer untuk mengoordinasikan proses *handoff* desain. **Kualifikasi:** ---------------- * Memahami prinsip-prinsip desain dan praktik terbaik desain UI. * Memahami prinsip-prinsip UX dan dapat membuat desain UI untuk berbagai perangkat. * Memahami istilah-istilah dalam bahasa Inggris terkait desain UI/UX. * Memiliki pengetahuan mendalam dan kemampuan menggunakan aplikasi desain UI/UX. * Kemampuan bekerja secara mandiri dan berkolaborasi dalam tim. * Proaktif dan responsif dalam berkomunikasi dengan tim, serta mampu memberikan dan menerima umpan balik dengan konstruktif. * Pendidikan minimal SMK bidang Teknologi dan Rekayasa, Teknologi Informasi, atau bidang terkait, dengan pengalaman minimal 1 tahun sebagai UI/UX Designer.

jobs.title: Business Development Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Business Development Associate – AI Visibility Services** Job Type: Full-Time | Fully Remote Compensation: IDR 3,000,000 monthly base salary + commission **Job Overview** UK Creative Ventures is looking for a motivated Business Development Associate to help introduce our AI Visibility services to small and medium-sized businesses across the UK, USA, Europe, New Zealand and Australia. As more people use ChatGPT, Google AI Overviews and other AI-powered platforms to find businesses and services, online visibility is changing. Our AI Visibility service helps businesses understand how they appear in AI search results and identify opportunities to improve their online presence. This role involves finding potential clients, starting conversations, presenting our services and developing business relationships. It is ideal for someone who is confident with outreach, enjoys communicating with business owners and can work independently. **Key Responsibilities** - Research and identify potential SME clients across the UK, USA, Europe, New Zealand, Australia and international markets. - Generate new business opportunities through LinkedIn, email and other relevant channels. - Contact business owners and decision-makers to introduce our services. - Explain the benefits of the AI Visibility Snapshot and convert prospects into paying clients. - Follow up with potential clients and maintain an organised sales pipeline. - Identify opportunities to introduce clients to our Growth & AI Audit and wider marketing, recruitment and education services. - Build and maintain professional relationships with prospective and existing clients. - Share market feedback and prospect insights to help improve our sales approach. - Prospect lists, messaging frameworks and service guidance will be provided. **Requirements** - Previous experience in sales, business development, lead generation or client acquisition. - Confidence communicating with business owners and decision-makers. - Experience with LinkedIn outreach, cold emailing or telephone prospecting. - Good written and verbal communication skills. - Ability to explain services clearly, particularly to people unfamiliar with AI search. - Strong organisation, follow-up and time-management skills. - Self-motivated, target-driven and comfortable working remotely. - Experience in digital marketing, recruitment, SaaS or B2B services is an advantage. You do not need to be an AI expert. Training and guidance on our AI Visibility services will be provided. **Compensation and Benefits** Base salary: IDR 3,000,000 per month. 20% commission on AI Visibility service sales. 20% commission on Marketing, Recruitment and Education service sales. - Uncapped earning potential through additional commissions. - Fully remote working arrangement. - Opportunity to develop within a growing service line and contribute to the company's business development. - Commission is earned in addition to the monthly base salary, subject to the company's commission and payment terms. **About UK Creative Ventures** UK Creative Ventures is a UK-based business growth agency supporting startups, SMEs and established businesses across the UK and internationally. Our services include digital marketing, recruitment, education consultancy and AI search visibility. We help businesses strengthen their online presence, attract customers, find talent and identify opportunities for growth. We're expanding our AI Visibility services to help businesses adapt to changes in how customers discover and research companies online. To apply: click on the apply link or send a short message with your sales background and why this excites you to ***Lina@ukcreativeventures.co.uk*** Application Question(s): * Are you comfortable with the starting salary mentioned above? Experience: * Sales: 1 year (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Welcome to IHG Hotels & Resorts** =================================== We are one of the world’s leading hospitality organisations, with a global portfolio of over 6,600 hotels and more than 375,000 colleagues. Whether your passion lies in driving commercial success, building powerful brands, creating meaningful customer connections, or delivering exceptional guest experiences, there is **Room for You at IHG**. We are looking for a **Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing** to join our leadership team at Hotel Indigo Bintan and Holiday Inn Resort Bintan. As Cluster Director of Sales & Marketing, you will provide strategic leadership and direction for the overall commercial performance of both properties. You will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to maximise revenue, increase market share, strengthen brand positioning, and achieve business objectives. This role requires strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and proven leadership capabilities, with the ability to identify market opportunities, build long-term business relationships, and drive sustainable revenue growth. You will lead the Sales & Marketing team, oversee key account management, develop effective marketing initiatives, and work closely with Revenue Management and Operations teams to ensure alignment with the overall business strategy. **Your Day-to-Day** * Develop and implement comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to achieve revenue targets, maximise market share, and strengthen the positioning of both properties. * Lead, coach, and develop the Sales & Marketing team to deliver strong commercial results and achieve individual and departmental objectives. * Drive business development across key market segments, including corporate, leisure, MICE, wholesale, travel trade, and other revenue-generating opportunities. * Establish and maintain strategic relationships with key accounts, corporate clients, travel agents, tour operators, media, and business partners. * Oversee the development and execution of integrated marketing, digital marketing, public relations, and promotional campaigns to enhance brand awareness and generate business. * Monitor market intelligence, industry trends, competitor activities, and customer insights to identify new opportunities and maintain a competitive advantage. * Work closely with Revenue Management to develop pricing strategies, optimise business mix, and maximise overall revenue performance. * Oversee sales forecasts, budgets, marketing expenditures, and departmental performance, ensuring effective resource allocation and return on investment. * Drive cross-property commercial initiatives and ensure consistency in sales and marketing strategies while respecting each brand's positioning and identity. * Collaborate with General Managers, Revenue Management, and Operations teams to align commercial strategies with overall business priorities. * Monitor commercial performance through regular reviews, reporting, and strategic action plans to ensure business objectives are achieved. * Ensure all sales and marketing activities comply with IHG brand standards, corporate guidelines, and relevant policies. **What We Need From You** * Proven experience in hotel sales and marketing, preferably in a Director of Sales & Marketing or senior commercial leadership position. * Strong understanding of the hospitality industry, including corporate, leisure, MICE, wholesale, travel trade, and digital marketing You will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive sales and marketing strategies to maximise revenue, increase market share, strengthen brand positioning, and achieve business objectives. This role requires strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and proven leadership capabilities, with the ability to identify market opportunities, build long-term business relationships, and drive sustainable revenue growth. development across key market segments, including corporate, leisure, MICE, wholesale, travel trade, and other revenue-generating opportunities. * Establish and maintain strategic relationships with key accounts, corporate clients, travel agents, tour operators, media, and business partners. * Oversee the development and execution of integrated marketing, digital marketing, public relations, and overall business priorities. * Monitor commercial performance through regular reviews, reporting, and strategic action plans to ensure business objectives are achieved. * Ensure all sales and marketing activities comply with IHG brand standards, corporate guidelines, and relevant policies. **What We Need From You** * Proven experience in hotel sales and marketing, preferably in a Director of Sales & Marketing or senior commercial leadership position. * Strong understanding of the hospitality industry, including corporate, leisure, MICE, wholesale, travel trade, and digital marketing jobs.title: ASEA E-Commerce Head
jobs.descriptionHtml: * **Position: ASEA E-Commerce Head** * **Reporting to: General Manager Opella ASEA - CHC AMEA Region** * **Primary Location: Indonesia** * **Alternate locations: Singapore or Philippines** **Locations: Indonesia, Philippines, Singapore. The appointment is intended to be locally based rather than an international relocation.** *Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.* *Our mission: to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be for over half a billion consumers worldwide.* *At the core of this mission is our 100+ loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and four specialized science and innovation development centers.* *Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan. B Corp certified in multiple markets, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet.* *Find out more about our mission to bring health in your hands at* *www.opella.com.* **Role Purpose** The ASEA E-Commerce Head will lead Opella’s e-commerce strategy and business across SEA, accelerating sustainable and profitable growth across marketplaces, e-retailers, social commerce, D2C and omnichannel channels. This role will be operated as a business leader and mini-GM for e-commerce business, bringing together strategy, commercial execution, platform and customer partnerships, P&L thinking, digital capability and team leadership. The role will work closely with Country GMs, Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Media and cross-functional teams to embed e-commerce into Opella’s overall growth strategy. **Key Responsibilities** **1. E-Commerce Strategy & Business Growth** * Define and lead the ASEA e-commerce strategy, translating regional priorities into differentiated market plans. * Own the e-commerce growth agenda across key ASEA markets. * Identify new growth opportunities across marketplaces, e-retail, quick commerce, social commerce and D2C. * Build clear Scale / Optimize / Stop choices across platforms, brands and markets. * Ensure e-commerce is fully integrated into country commercial and brand strategies. **2. Commercial & P&L Leadership** * Drive sustainable Net Sales, GMV, market share, margin and profitability across e-commerce. * Lead channel economics includes pricing, promotion, investment, assortment and trade spend. * Establish rigorous commercial performance management across markets and platforms. * Balance top-line acceleration with sustainable profitability and investment effectiveness. **3. Marketplace & Customer Leadership** * Develop strategic partnerships with key e-commerce platforms, e-retailers, customers and distributors. * Lead senior engagement and Joint Business Planning with platforms and e-retail partners. * Strengthening Opella’s capabilities across Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop and other priority platforms. * Develop platform-specific strategies covering assortment, pricing, promotions, media, content and conversion. **4. Omnichannel & Consumer Experience** * Connect e-commerce with broader pharmacy, modern trade and omnichannel strategies. * Build seamless consumer journeys from awareness and consideration through conversion and repeat purchase. * Partner with Brand and Media teams to connect retail media, performance marketing and commerce. * Drive excellence in digital shelf, content, search, ratings and reviews, and conversion. **5. Data, Insights & Performance** * Build a strong performance culture using consumer, customer and platform data. * Establish common ASEA KPIs and dashboards covering Net Sales, GMV, market share, traffic, conversion, ROAS, basket size, repeat purchase and profitability. * Translate data into clear commercial actions and resource allocation decisions. * Strengthening Opella’s test & learn capability across markets. **6. Social Commerce & Emerging Channels** * Shape the ASEA social commerce strategy, including TikTok Shop, livestream, creators and affiliates. * Identify emerging consumer and commerce trends and translate them into scalable opportunities. * Accelerate successful market pilots across ASEA. **7. Leadership & Capability Building** * Lead, coach and develop e-commerce teams across ASEA. * Build e-commerce capabilities across Commercial, Brand and local market teams. * Create common ways of working, governance and best-practice sharing across markets. * Attract and develop high-performing digital commerce talent. * Foster an entrepreneurial culture with strong accountability for outcomes. **Experience & Knowledge** **Essential** * Proven experience in e-commerce, digital commerce, commercial or omnichannel leadership, ideally within FMCG, Consumer Healthcare, Beauty, Personal Care or another consumer-led business. * Experience leading a sizeable B2C e-commerce business. * Strong commercial and P&L orientation with demonstrated accountability for growth and profitability. * Deep understanding of marketplace and e-retail business models. * Experience working with platforms such as Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop and/or other major e-commerce ecosystems. * Strong understanding of pricing, promotions, digital shelf, retail media and conversion. * Proven ability to operate across functions and influence senior stakeholders. * Strong people leadership and capability-building experience. **Preferred** * Regional or multi-country Southeast Asia experience. * Experience across both developed and high-growth e-commerce markets. * Consumer healthcare, FMCG or similarly regulated consumer-category experience. * Experience building or transforming an e-commerce organization rather than only managing an established channel. * Exposure to D2C, social commerce, CRM and consumer data strategies. **Leadership Profile** * **Commercial & Finance acumen:** Treats e-commerce as a business, not simply a digital channel. * **Entrepreneurial:** Comfortable building and scaling new growth models. * **Outcome-obsessed:** Converts strategy into measurable business results. * **Consumer-led:** Understands how consumers discover, evaluate and purchase healthcare products online. * **Data-driven:** Uses insights to challenge assumptions and make faster decisions. * **Enterprise-minded:** Balances market priorities with the wider ASEA and Opella agenda. * **Influential:** Aligns senior stakeholders without relying solely on formal authority. * **Talent-focused:** Builds strong teams and develops e-commerce capability across the organization. ***Why us?*** At Opella, you will enjoy doing challenging, purposeful work, empowered to develop consumer brands with passion and creativity. This is your chance to grow new skills and be part of a bold, collaborative, and inclusive culture where people can thrive and be at their best every day. **We Are Challengers.** We are dedicated to making self-care as simple as it should be. That starts with our culture. We are challengers by nature, and this is how we do things: **All In Together:** We keep each other honest and have each other's backs. **Courageous:** We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity. **Outcome-Obsessed:** We are personally accountable, driving sustainable impact and results with integrity. **Radically Simple:** We strive to make things simple for us and simple for consumers, as it should be. Join us on our mission. Health. In your hands. www.opella.com/en/careers

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml: Grounded in a talent-centric mindset, Maker Lab is a marketing agency designed to build decentralised technology-led agency teams, rooted in collaboration with clients from the ground up. Maker Lab’s cross-functional teams of multidisciplinary specialists are embedded into client teams across digital marketing competencies — from measurement & analytics to content production. **Role Summary:** As a Marketing Specialist in ID, you'll drive user adoption of Search and AI features by bridging global innovation and local needs. Combining analytics and storytelling, you'll own campaigns, research user behaviour, and collaborate cross-functionally to optimise engagement in a fast-paced environment. Role: * Develop an insight-led Search marketing plan for the Indonesian market, identifying and prioritising key growth opportunities and feature rollouts for Search, Assistant, and AI-enabled search experiences. * Lead the launch and execution of targeted Search feature campaigns from inception to completion, ensuring all initiatives drive core user adoption and engagement metrics. * Conduct deep research into Search user behaviour, query intent trends, and competitive dynamics to inform strategic product and marketing decisions. * Apply advanced Search analytics, statistical analysis, and experimentation (A/B testing) to evaluate search feature performance, user retention, and campaign impact. * Use SQL to analyse large search datasets and user interaction patterns, translating complex data into clear, actionable insights for product and marketing partners. * Collaborate closely with product, comms, regional, and in-country teams to ensure seamless execution and alignment across all initiatives. * Demonstrate strong problem-solving capabilities by developing creative and non-traditional solutions for complex, undefined problems. You: * BA/BS degree or equivalent experience * 3+ years of experience in marketing, consulting, or communications, with a proven track record of exceptional performance and high productivity. * Deep expertise in Search products, digital marketing, and performance marketing for high-growth tech products. * Demonstrated problem-solving and analytical capabilities, combined with solid project management skills and the ability to lead projects independently. * Proven track record in Search analytics, statistical analysis, user funnel analysis, and controlled experimentation (A/B testing). * Proficiency in SQL to query large search interaction datasets and uncover key insights into Search user behavior. * Exceptional adaptability, strong teamwork skills, dedication, and a positive attitude. * Able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven, technology work environment and navigate ambiguity in a complex matrix organisation. * Exceptional verbal and written English, and fluent in Bahasa Indonesia, with strong communication and presentation skills Please note: due to the high volume of applications, only successful candidates will be contacted with a follow-up introduction email. If you do not receive an email from Maker Lab, your application has been unsuccessful this time around. Look out for future roles! By submitting your application, you consent to the collection, use and disclosure of your data by the Maker Lab team for the purposes of your application. Where your application contains personal data of third parties, you confirm that you have obtained all necessary consents to provide the Maker Lab team with such personal data and that we may collect, use and/or disclose such data in accordance with the Personal Data Protection Act 2012.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager| 100% Remote EU
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.** At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them. If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us. **THE ROLE** ------------ We’re on the hunt for a Marketing Manager who can think big, move fast, and actually make things happen. This is not a “just run ads and wait” role. You will coordinate all the marketing initiatives, create new marketing angles, offers, and landing pages, manage the creative department, and brief Facebook ads. This is a full-stack marketing playground where you own projects from the first spark of an idea to seeing real sales roll in. You’ll be the glue between marketing, design, and development - turning customer insights into landing pages, funnels, and campaigns that people *actually want to click, read, and buy from*. If you love: * mixing strategy with execution * testing ideas * improving funnels * and making pretty things convert …and you’ve played with AI tools to move faster, build smarter, or test better ideas, you might be our person **WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING** ------------------------ ### **Strategy & Growth Stuff** * Build and run marketing strategies that support real business goals (not just vibes). * Dig into customer research and market trends to find new growth opportunities. * Analyze what’s working (and what’s not) and turn data into smart next steps. * Come up with fresh ideas to scale our funnels and campaigns. * Manage marketing projects from idea launch improvement. ### **Creative & Content Magic** * Write copy for ads, landing pages, and funnels that sounds human and sells. * Review design work and give feedback so it looks on-brand *and* converts. * Guide the creation and optimization of ad creatives with our design team. ### **Landing Pages & Website Optimization** * QA landing pages like a detective: checking UX, flow, and functionality. * Run A/B tests to improve conversion rates. * Work closely with developers to roll out website updates and improvements. ### **Team Glue (Cross-Functional Hero)** * Be the bridge between marketing, design, and development. * Create clear briefs so everyone knows what to build and why. * Track project progress and keep stakeholders in the loop. ### **Customer Research & Insights** * Collect and analyze customer feedback and data. * Identify pain points and opportunities for improvement. * Use insights to scale sales and improve acquisition. ### **AI Tools & Smarter Execution** * Bring AI into our workflow as a competitive edge. Use GPT, image/video generators, and automation platforms to compress timelines, run more experiments, and beat our own ideas. **WHAT YOU BRING** ------------------ You’re probably someone who: * Has experience as a Marketing Manager or full-stack marketer in e-commerce. * Have hands-on experience building with AI tools - vibe coding, workflow automations, etc. * Understands digital marketing and performance marketing deeply. * Can write clear, persuasive, not-boring copy. * Knows CRO and website optimization. * Loves looking at data and asking: “What actually sells?” * Is organized and good at managing projects. * Has worked with designers and developers before. * Can manage your own time and work remotely. * Cares about customers and research. * Gets excited about e-commerce growth. **BONUS POINTS IF YOU:** ------------------------ * Have used marketing automation tools. * Know your way around heatmaps, ad managers, and analytics tools. * Enjoy experimenting, testing, and improving things nonstop. **WHY FOXELLI?** ---------------- We’re not into boring corporate marketing. We like: * smart ideas * quirky personality * strong execution * and people who take ownership You’ll have space to think, test, build, and grow with us - and actually see the impact of your work. **THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS** --------------------------- Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world. Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space. Interview -A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together. **FIXED SERVICE FEE** **€2,000 - €2,800** after taxes, depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience. Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement. **PERKS & BENEFITS** * Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting, while Hubstaff ensures transparency and fairness. * Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and to keep your physical well-being in check. * A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep growing continuously. * Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested. * A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like. * Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrate you. **ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS** This role is 100% remote. * Our tribe works primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET — UTC+2/UTC+3). We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported. * For full-time roles, we ask that you’re available for at least 5 hours during typical EET working hours — it keeps collaboration smooth and communication easy. (This doesn’t apply to part-time roles.) Currently, **we are hiring in** Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Greece, Georgia, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Malta, Slovenia, Serbia, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Hungary, Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and South Africa.
