jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

jobs.title: Tech Lead Full-Stack Rails Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mitre Media

Mitre Media is redefining FinTech with AI-driven tools that empower millions of investors. Our portfolio, including Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com, leverages LLMs to deliver novel data insights and visually rich user experiences. For over a decade, we’ve served individual investors, financial advisors, and top asset managers like BlackRock and Vanguard through our premium data, tools, and advertising solutions. Join our lean, entrepreneurial team to shape the future of AI-powered investing from your location ±3 hours from Eastern Time.

Our users are deeply engaged, spending over 5 minutes per visit with a bounce rate below 10%, researching investments across hundreds of different categories. With 40 million brokerage accounts in the U.S., we take pride in building tools that make a real impact, fostering a culture of trust, innovation, and dynamism. If you’re passionate about financial technology and AI, we’d love to connect!

About the Role

As a Full-Stack Rails Tech Lead, you’ll architect and implement LLM-powered web applications within our microservices-based Rails 8 platform. Reporting directly to our CTO, you’ll collaborate with a small, high-impact team to deliver user experiences across Dividend.com, MutualFunds.com and other brands within our portfolio. This role combines expert Ruby on Rails skills with AI integration expertise, requiring you to leverage LLMs in your development workflow, state management and user interactions.

You’ll work in a remote-first hybrid environment, which encourages in person collaboration, using ShapeUp to manage projects that trade-off on-time delivery for de-scoped outcomes. As a technical leader, you'll have a seat at the table shaping system architecture, implementing core features all while embracing an entrepreneurial mindset and a “get things done” mentality.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain Rails applications (Rails 8)

  • Integrate LLMs into our microservices architecture for state management and real-time user experiences.

  • Enhance front-end experiences with Hotwire, StimulusJS, or React, ensuring seamless AI-driven interactions.

  • Optimize LLM inference for low latency and cost, using caching and asynchronous processing.

Required Technical Skills

Back-End

  • Ruby (5+ years, expert-level)

  • Ruby on Rails (Rails 6-8 preferred)

  • PostgreSQL (or MySQL)

  • Elasticsearch

  • Redis

  • Docker

Front-End

  • StimulusJS or JavaScript ES6

  • Tailwind CSS

  • HTML

  • HTTP

AI Integration

  • Experience integrating AI/ML models (e.g., LLMs, NLP) with web applications

  • Familiarity with LLM frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Hugging Face) or APIs (e.g., xAI, Anthropic)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills

  • Kubernetes for microservices orchestration

  • React for advanced front-end components

  • Graph databases for complex financial data

  • Contributions to open-source RoR or AI projects

Required Soft Skills

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for AI and FinTech

  • Natural leader who mentors and inspires teammates

  • Problem-solver with a “get things done” mentality

  • Excellent communication, thriving in remote and cross-team collaboration

  • Attention to detail, ensuring clean, maintainable code

  • Team player comfortable as an individual contributor

Why Join Us?

  • Impactful Work: Build AI-powered tools that help millions of investors make informed decisions from data-driven insights.

  • Cutting-Edge Tech: Work with Rails 8, LLMs, and modern tools like Hotwire, Databricks, and xAI’s API in a microservices architecture.

  • Autonomy and Influence: Collaborate directly with our CEO and CTO to shape our AI-driven platform, with freedom to innovate.

  • Competitive Compensation: $160,000–$200,000 CAD/USD (based on experience) and benefits.

  • Remote Flexibility: Remote-first (±3 hours from ET) with hybrid in office collaboration in Toronto or NYC

  • Growth Opportunities: Budget for AI and Rails conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, RailsConf), plus access to cutting-edge AI tools for experimentation.

  • Dynamic Culture: Join a small, no-ego team passionate about trust, innovation, and making a difference in FinTech.

About Mitre Media’s AI-Driven Platform

Mitre Media powers premium financial brands like Dividend.com and MutualFunds.com with the Mitre Platform. This platform integrates traditional content management, financial data, first-party data, ad revenue, and subscription tools, all enhanced by LLMs for rich, user-focused experiences. Our data-derived insights delight users, while our advertising solutions deliver unmatched performance for partners like BlackRock and Vanguard, leveraging advanced targeting and first-party data.

How to Apply

 

Submit your resume, GitHub profile, and a brief note on why you’re excited about building AI-driven FinTech to jobs@mitremedia.com.

jobs.title: Inside Sales Contractor
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

  • Home office or a quiet place to work.

  • Strong internet connection.

  • Desktop or laptop

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

Scheduling

Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST.

*The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training.

Post Training:

We are currently seeking representatives to work on the following schedule:

Monday - Friday

Shift hours to be discussed with our hiring manager based on our company's needs at the time of hire. Shifts are as follows:

  • 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM EST

  • 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM EST

  • 9:00 AM - 5:00 AM EST

  • 9:30 AM - 5:30 PM EST

  • 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST

  • 10:30 AM - 6:30 PM EST

  • 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM EST

  • 11:30 AM - 7:30 PM EST

  • 12:30 PM - 8:30 PM EST

  • 1:30 PM - 9:30 PM EST

  • 2:30 PM - 10:30 PM EST

  • 3:00 PM - 11:00 PM EST

Job Type: Contract

Shift:

  • 8 hour shift

  • Day shift

  • Evening shift

  • Morning shift

  • Night shift

Supplemental Pay:

  • Bonus opportunities

  • Commission pay

Experience:

  • Sales: 1 year (Required)

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.title: Freelance Writer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our organization is seeking content writers to create articles and blog posts on a variety of topics.

 

The rate of pay is $20 per 100 words (this comes out to approximately $100 per article or $50 per hour).

 

Some topics you may be asked to write about include the following (you can always turn down a topic if you do not feel comfortable writing about it, however if you have experience or expertise in a specific area, please let us know):

 

  • Health & beauty
  • Fitness
  • Home Decor
  • Fashion
  • Sports
  • Do it yourself
  • Finance
  • Legal
  • Medical
  • Family/Parenting
  • Relationships
  • Real Estate
  • Restaurants
  • Contracting (plumbing, pool building, remodeling, etc.)

 

These are just some of the more general industries and topics that we cover.

 

Requirements:

  • We ask that all work be completed using a word processor such as Microsoft Word or Open Office
  • A reliable internet connection and the ability to meet deadlines
  • Good communication skills and respond in a timely manner to editorial staff when they ask for updates on tasks, etc
  • Work well as a team member with the rest of our content management and editorial staff



Note: Applicants to this job signaled that accessing some writing tasks may require payment.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) – B2B Kundenbetreuung
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ProviPanda GmbH · Hamburg / Remote · Freelance oder Festanstellung · 30 Std./Woche · Start: sofort

Über ProviPanda GmbH

ProviPanda ist ein wachsendes HR-Tech-Startup aus dem Bereich Technology, Information and Internet und die größte Sales-Job-Plattform im DACH-Raum. Unser Team aus 15 Mitarbeitenden arbeitet daran, den Sales-HR-Markt zu revolutionieren und neu zu denken.

Deine Rolle

Du unterstützt unsere Customer Success Managerin und bist im Alltag die Person, die Kunden anruft, ihre Anliegen klärt und dafür sorgt, dass sie zufrieden sind und Erfolg mit ProviPanda haben. Du arbeitest eigenständig, trittst professionell auf und telefonierst gern.

Deine Aufgaben

Check-ins & Kundenbetreuung

  • Du terminierst Check-in-Calls mit unseren Kunden und hältst den Überblick über anstehende Termine

  • Du führst Check-ins selbst durch und rufst Kunden aktiv an

  • Du klärst Kundenanliegen schnell und lösungsorientiert, von Support-Fragen bis zu Success-Themen

Onboarding

  • Du übernimmst Kunden-Onboardings Schritt für Schritt und begleitest neue Kunden beim Start

  • Du berätst Kunden zur Nutzung der Plattform und dazu, wie sie das Beste aus ProviPanda herausholen

Zusammenarbeit & Prozesse

  • Du entlastest die Customer Success Managerin und springst ein, wenn Kapazität gebraucht wird

  • Du dokumentierst Kundenkontakte sauber und gibst Feedback ans Team weiter

  • Du nutzt AI-Tools, um deine Arbeit effizienter zu machen, zum Beispiel für Vorbereitung, Zusammenfassungen und Kommunikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Eine sehr gute, professionelle Kommunikation und Tonalität, am Telefon und in Google Meets

  • Ein ordentliches, souveränes Auftreten, eine gute Ausstrahlung und eine freundliche, lösungsorientierte Art

  • Keine Scheu vorm Telefonieren, du rufst gern Kunden an

  • Täglicher Umgang mit AI-Tools wie Claude, ChatGPT & Co. und generell technisches Verständnis

  • Eine hohe Auffassungsgabe, Leistungsstärke und richtig Lust auf die Aufgabe

  • Erfahrung im Customer Success ist top, aber kein Muss, den Rest bringen wir dir bei

  • Von Vorteil: Erfahrung aus HR oder Vertrieb, denn wer selbst im Sales war, weiß, wie man Kunden berät

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, gutes Englisch ist ein Plus

Das bieten wir dir

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

  • StartUp mit starkem Wachstum und ambitionierter Vision mit einem dynamischen Team

  • Flexibles Modell: Freelance oder Festanstellung, jeweils mit 30 Std-40Std./Woche

  • Gründliche Einarbeitung und direktes Feedback

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, ein motiviertes Team und echte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Start ab sofort

Interesse?

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätze dazu, warum du genau die richtige Person bist. Gib bitte auch an, ob du als Freelancerin oder in Festanstellung starten möchtest und ab wann du verfügbar bist.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer, Web3
jobs.descriptionText: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Who we are&nbsp;</strong></h4> <p>We simplify wealth creation. Founded in 2014 in Vienna, Austria by Eric Demuth, Paul Klanschek and Christian Trummer, we’re here to help people trust themselves enough to build their financial freedom — for now and the future. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. Our global team works across different cultures and time zones, bringing our products to more than 7 million customers, making us one of Europe’s safest and most secure platforms that powers modern investing.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Headquartered in Austria but operating across Europe, our products are built by fast-moving, talented, “roll-up-your-sleeves-and-make-it-happen” kind of people. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Your mission&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Product Designer on Bitpanda’s Web3 team, you will architect the user experiences that power our next-generation crypto ecosystem, from asset-backed loans in the Bitpanda app to tokenised structured products in the Vision Wallet. You will transform complex, data-heavy financial workflows into seamless interfaces, navigating the unique challenges of a fast-moving, highly regulated space. Partnering tightly with engineering, product, and compliance teams, your designs will directly drive customer engagement, retention, and trust. You'll shape Bitpanda's newest business lines, using AI to go from idea to working prototypes in hours and to testing them with real customers within days.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and develop end-to-end trading, investment, and Web3 interfaces across both mobile and web platforms</li> <li>Simplify highly complex financial products (such as tokenized financial derivatives) into intuitive, low-friction user experiences</li> <li>Conduct comprehensive user research, usability testing, and behavioral analysis to optimize funnel conversion, engagement, and drop-off rates</li> <li>Apply and continuously contribute to scalable design systems, ensuring consistency and performance across data-heavy interfaces</li> <li>Use AI to prototype, test and ship jobs.title: People Operations Working Student (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we're on a mission to make every company a wellness company. We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you'll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

 

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a People Operations Working Student for a 6-month contract to our People Operations team in Berlin, Germany!

This role is to join our People Operations team, dedicated to delivering an exceptional employee experience across Europe. In this role, you will contribute to meaningful People initiatives and gain valuable exposure to key HR topics(e.g. employment law and payroll). You will also gain valuable exposure to driving efficient operations at scale. You will have the opportunity to learn and apply analytical problem-solving, a process-oriented mindset, stakeholder management and AI automation to elevate our HR systems (e.g., Personio) and workflows… all within a dynamic, international environment. Whilst you will be based in Germany, you will be working on operations across European markets.


YOUR IMPACT

  • Employee Care: Respond thoughtfully to employee queries, ensuring quick, effective resolutions and an exceptional day-to-day experience for our team.
  • Process Mindset & Execution: Ensure high accuracy and operational efficiency in core HR processes (e.g. maintaining Personio data, payroll) by following clear procedures.
  • Solution-Oriented Problem Solving: Challenge the status quo by focusing on solutions rather than getting bogged down in problems. Use data and a process mindset to proactively identify ways to optimize workflows and leverage automation to better serve our employees at scale.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life wellness.

 

WHO YOU ARE

  • You are currently enrolled in a university, your specific degree subject matter does not matter but an interest in HR, Finance and operations is a plus
  • You are available at least 15h/week (max. 20 hours)
  • A fluent communicator with C1+ level proficiency in both written and spoken German and English.
  • A Berlin-based candidate who can work on-site from our Head Office 2–3 times per week.
  • A discreet professional with a proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with high integrity.
  • A self-driven, adaptable, and collaborative team player with excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • A proactive learner passionate about employee experience, eager to develop skills in data-driven problem solving, project management, stakeholder management, and operations across Europe.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that current university enrollment and fluency in German and English (C1+) are mandatory requirements.

 

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

FLEXIBLE WORK: As a Flexible First company, we offer hybrid and remote options to give you the freedom to work in a way that suits you. The model for this specific role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS
  • Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably
  • Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms 
  • Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability
  • Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives 

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain 

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments 
  • Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflowsStrong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainabilityExperience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutionsDeep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling. 

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional:

  • Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure
  • Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.
  • Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services
  • Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka) 
  • Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) 
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.
  • In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT? 

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious,  intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. 
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.  
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve.  There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! 

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

jobs.title: Tacto Labs: Fast-Track Builder Program
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why this role exists

Manufacturing is Europe’s backbone, and it’s under pressure. More than half of manufacturing cost is decided in procurement, yet the function still runs on Excel.

Tacto's sales-led motion in DACH works: more than 300 industrial companies run on Tacto. Tacto Labs is where we build what comes nest: new products and wedges that don't scale linearly with headcount. Each bet starts on a whiteboard and either becomes a real business inside Tacto or gets killed fast.

 

What you'll do

  • Take a bet from idea to first paying users, working directly with our founders

  • Build it yourself with AI: prototype, landing pages, agents, outreach, whatever proves or kills the idea fastest

  • Talk to customers and suppliers until you know. more about the problem than anyone else in the company

  • Find the next compounding loop and scale what works

 

How it fits

Everybody in Tacto Labs is a Builder: same role, same bar, pointed at earlier stage problems. We believe in building over strategizing.

 

Who we're looking for

  • You've built something from zero: as a founder, early at a startup, or during a side project.

  • You want to found something someday. We're looking for people we'd back if they did.

  • You don't come from engineering? Great, as long as you build. If you've shipped something with with AI tools, you're technical enough to start and get better.

  • Extreme ownership, no ego.

  • Fluent in German; English is a strong plus.

 

How the process works

  1. Say Hello (20 min): get to know each other and the role

  2. Hiring Manager Interview (45 min)

  3. On-site day: a case with three Builders and Pool Leads (1 hour), Meet the Team (30 min)

How we work

We’re in our Munich office four days a week, with 100+ people building together every day. We measure outcomes. Trust is high and feedback is direct. We offer competitive salary and meaningful equity.

Our Background

Tacto is building the intelligence layer that connects AI to the physical world of manufacturing, starting with procurement. AI is transforming every industry, but it stops at the factory gate. The knowledge that holds manufacturing together - part costs, suppliers, materials - is scattered across systems and people. Over 50% of a product's cost originates from suppliers, making procurement the single largest cost lever in manufacturing and the missing connection between the digital and the physical world. Yet it still runs on Excel and legacy systems. We're changing that with our Procurement Intelligence Platform, trusted by hundreds of companies running billions of Euros of material.

Based in Munich, we are 100+ passionate builders who are in-office, with high expectations, fast growth, and a lot of fun. We are supported by >€50m from Sequoia, Index, and Europe's leading tech entrepreneurs and industry veterans.

Why It Matters

Manufacturing forms Europe's economic backbone, driving a fourth of Europe's GDP and providing over 30% of jobs. These hidden champions and global market leaders manufacture the physical world around us, from the machines that build our cities to the medical devices that save lives.

But the world is changing. The US dominates the digital world of bits. China is scaling the world of atoms, manufacturing at unprecedented speed and scale. Geopolitics are more uncertain than ever. Europe's strength lies in its deep industrial knowledge through generations of engineering. Manufacturing worldwide runs on European machines and software. But that heritage is only an advantage if we leverage it in the age of AI.

Tacto builds the AI that connects Atoms and Bits, empowering our Industrial Base to Stay Stronger and building a lighthouse for European tech.

What We Offer

The people at Tacto are passionate about building the organization, growing themselves, and our product while having fun and being real. We have high expectations, great talent density, and a culture where your ambition, performance, and agency are what count - not where you come from or how big your ego is. You'll grow at the forefront of AI, have real ownership and impact, and be surrounded by the best people in their field who challenge you and make you better every day. That is demanding and rewarding, but that's where we thrive. Besides that you have:

  • Money: Competitive salary & equity in the company with real upside, so you are invested in our success

  • Workplace: A vibrant in-office culture (> 4 days/week) in a beautiful office in central Munich

  • Development: A development budget and regular exposure to exceptional people, e.g., Lunch & Learns, peer mentoring, external speakers

  • Time off: 26 + 4 vacation days per year (4 fixed “company rest days”) as well as regular off-sites and team events

  • Health: Wellpass membership, of course, a fruit basket (!), and access to Jobrad, for your health

  • Family & Social Security: Voluntary pension contribution, voluntary KITA subsidy for your children

Tacto is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your Impact

Procurement is over 50% of revenue for industrial companies and their biggest lever for profitability. The hard part isn't the software. Every customer's reality is different: a different ERP, a different data model, decades of undocumented process. Generic platforms stall exactly there, and that's where most enterprise AI value quietly dies.

At Tacto, the people who close that gap are Builders who work at the customer edge. You sit inside the customer's environment, build in their production data, and turn what you learn there into product. More than 300 industrial companies already run on Tacto, and every new one teaches us something the platform should do on its own.

 

Your Tasks

  • Prove it with their data. Show a prospect or customer what Tacto finds in their own spend, suppliers and parts, fast enough that the value is obvious.

  • Build in customer environments. Data pipelines, agents and custom logic on top of the Tacto platform, in real production data, until the procurement team can actually work with the result.

  • Be in the room, on site. Run workshops with buyers and key users, debug alongside their IT, and see how a company really buys instead of how the process documentation says it buys.

  • Turn the edge into product. When you solve something twice, ship it into the platform so nobody has to solve it a third time. You're done when it drives revenue, not when the deployment is live.

  • Automate your own job. If a step can be done by an agent, you build the agent and prove it works.

 

Your Profile

  • You've built something people relied on: software, automations, agents, or a technical project that real users used.

  • You build with AI every day. Cursor, Claude, Codex and agents are your default, and you've built with LLMs against real, messy data.

  • You're hands-on with data. SQL and Python at working level, or the drive to get there fast with AI as leverage.

  • You thrive in messy environments. Incomplete requirements, undocumented data and conflicting stakeholders don't stop you.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Join a team building software for industrial R&D and laboratory workflows. You will serve as the technical partner in pre-sales, helping prospects see how modern data tools can improve research and product development.

What You'll Do

  • Lead technical pre-sales engagements, from initial demonstrations through value cases, technical evaluations, and pilot execution.

  • Build tailored demonstrations, workshops, and pilots around prospective customers' R&D workflows.

  • Partner with sales colleagues and customer stakeholders to communicate business value and support new customer growth.

  • Present technical evaluations and explain how digital R&D data management can support research and innovation.

  • Mentor junior team members supporting technical evaluations.

  • Write scripts and configure platform integrations for customer engagements as needed.

  • Travel 25% to 50% for prospect meetings, presentations, and workshops.

What We're Looking For

  • Four to seven years of experience, including at least four years in digitalization, change management, or leadership in R&D.

  • An advanced degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, or materials science, ideally with a focus on machine learning or computational methods.

  • Strong chemistry or materials science expertise and familiarity with enterprise R&D workflows and laboratory informatics.

  • Experience building and demonstrating technical platforms for enterprise customers, with a value-based pre-sales approach.

  • Experience in R&D leadership at a large chemical or materials organization is preferred.

  • Python scripting skills are helpful, as is experience in technical management consulting.

  • Fluent English and advanced proficiency in the relevant local language for European-based candidates.

  • Ability and willingness to travel regularly, and work authorization in the US, UK, or Germany.

Compensation & Benefits

Annual salary range: $120,000 to $150,000 USD. Visa sponsorship is not available.

Location

Hybrid role based in Munich, Germany. London, UK, or New York, NY, may also be considered.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer II
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Please submit your application in English

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing.

You’ll work closely with our engineering team based in Manchester as we look to expand our engineering and operations in Germany and across Europe. Together, the team takes an integration project from the very early information stage, designs how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turns that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset.

The Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware & Software) and other connectivity technologies with their protocol engineering are owned by our UK-based team, who will support you in becoming configuration literate. Over time you will carry out configuration, deployments and testing for sites yourself, and feed back what you learn about hardware, connectivity and grid operator requirements for European countries so the wider team can build on it.

Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing, they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing ones.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches for German sites, mainly BESS (grid-scale and C&I) and RES (Wind and Solar). When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives in German and English through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members.

  • Market access & prequalification support: Support the technical work needed for assets to enter ancillary-service markets (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) and to meet Redispatch 3.0 requirements. With guidance from senior engineers, help prepare the telemetry and control evidence for prequalification (Präqualifikation) with the relevant TSO. (Grid-code and plant-compliance obligations such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120 remain with the plant/PPC; our focus is enabling market access, telemetry and dispatch.)

  • Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team.

  • Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include German grid connection rules and TSO-specific requirements, ancillary services, Redispatch 3.0, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on.

  • Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the Gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get Gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time.

  • Hardware and software deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing of sites with guidance from the senior engineers.

  • Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team.

  • Hardware handling & dispatch: Berlin is planned as our stock base for our hardware going out to sites across Europe, so the role includes some hands-on work. This covers preparing units before they ship, such as flashing and configuring our industrial PCs and running pre-shipment tests, and helping to prepare and coordinate shipments.

  • Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning, initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand in Germany and other parts of Europe grows. Hardware is deployed remotely in most cases via O&Ms and third parties, but occasional hands-on support in Germany may be needed before or after a deployment.

  • Incidents & support: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in German and English, needed for technical documentation and for working with customers, grid operators and our UK-based team.

  • Understanding of the German connection landscape: Working knowledge of the TSO/DSO hierarchy, the connection/integration process, and the technical connection rules (such as VDE-AR-N 4110/4120) a grid-connected asset must meet before it can participate in the energy markets.

  • Understanding of the German energy markets: Working understanding of the German ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR), what prequalification involves, and the Redispatch 3.0 framework.

  • Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution.

  • Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation.

  • Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control.

  • Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation.

  • Hardware and networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Customer

 

What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry.

 

Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now.

 

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

 

We’re looking for a brilliant senior Data & Analytics Client Delivery Lead to help clients fully leverage Kraken data and transform their data team and capabilities. You should bring extensive experience doing analytics on a strong, modern data team (e.g., data analytics, business intelligence, or related field -- analytics manager, lead data analyst, analytics or data consultant or similar); a love of working with clients; and a passion for driving the clean energy transition – energy sector experience is a plus!

 

The role

 

You’ll work directly with Kraken clients to help them develop modern, transformative data and analytics capabilities as part of their broader Kraken transformation. You’ll train them on Kraken data and support them in building critical reporting & insightful analytics, sometimes getting hands-on with query writing or demo analytics. 

 

You’ll also leverage your experience leading strong analytics teams to advise senior client data leadership on how to build a high-performing, business-centric data organization and leverage data as a strategic asset to unlock ambitious business and clean energy goals.

 

We are a flat and agile organisation and plan to remain this way. We are looking for a hands-on Data & Analytics Client Delivery Lead that can support both directly and indirectly - sometimes jumping in and writing queries or solving data challenges and other times advising or upskilling both clients and colleagues. 

 

You will play a critical role in ensuring the clients’ reporting and analytics transition to Kraken goes smoothly - and ensuring that clients build the transformative data capabilities needed to get full value from Kraken data and power aspirational business goals.

🚀 What you'll own:

  • Guide clients in redefining critical reporting and analytics to use new Kraken data and concepts, through hands-on query writing, working sessions, and trainings

  • Advise clients, including senior leadership, on topics like how to develop a high-performing data organization, how to build a modern tech stack, and how to pursue a data strategy and priorities that drive their core business objectives.

  • Strategically define and prioritize client data needs to influence the data product roadmap, ensuring product understands the core, shared client needs and that solutions achieve clients’ desired business outcomes

  • Partner with engineering to deliver new data features and requirements aligned to client use cases

  • Train Kraken’s broader client delivery team on how to help their respective business domains ask effective data questions and leverage data directly to drive business impact

🧠 What you’ll bring to the party:

  • Degree qualified equivalent, with strong client delivery and/or product ownership experience

  • Several years of experience as a data analytics, business intelligence, or related field -- analytics manager, lead data analyst, analytics or data consultant or similar

  • Strong familiarity with modern data practices and tools

  • Strong facility with SQL and modern BI toolsFamiliar with agile product development practices and experience collaborating with engineering

  • Excellent communications, collaboration and presentation skills

  • Strong influencing skills and ability to challenge traditional ways of thinking

  • Patience – our clients are undergoing huge transformations that take time and require our understanding

  • Experience in the energy sector a plus

jobs.title: Werkstudent Grafikdesign – Meta Ads & Canva (m/w/d) | Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über BeginnerBudget

Wir sind ein junges Startup aus Hamburg und suchen kreative Unterstützung bei der Gestaltung unserer Werbeanzeigen für Instagram und Facebook. Du hast ein gutes Auge für Design, arbeitest gerne mit Canva und nutzt KI als kreatives Werkzeug? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.
Die Stelle umfasst 20–30 Stunden pro Monat und ist 100 % remote.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du erstellst statische Bildgrafiken für unsere Meta Ads auf Instagram und Facebook.

  • Du entwickelst unterschiedliche Gestaltungsvarianten, damit wir verschiedene Motive und Botschaften testen können.

  • Du arbeitest mit Canva und nutzt ChatGPT sowie weitere KI-Tools für Ideen und die Umsetzung.

  • Du bringst eigene Gestaltungsideen ein und denkst mit: Was fällt auf, vermittelt die Botschaft klar und spricht unsere Zielgruppe an?

  • Du setzt Feedback um und entwickelst bestehende Grafiken weiter.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du studierst Grafikdesign, Kommunikationsdesign, Mediendesign oder einen vergleichbaren Studiengang.

  • Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen mit Social-Media-Grafiken gesammelt, idealerweise auch mit Werbeanzeigen.

  • Du kannst sicher mit Canva umgehen und hast Erfahrung mit ChatGPT oder anderen KI-Tools.

  • Du hast ein gutes Gespür für Layout, Typografie und Bildsprache sowie ein erstes Verständnis dafür, worauf es bei Meta Ads ankommt.

  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig und selbstständig, stellst Fragen und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben.

  • Du bringst Eigeninitiative mit und teilst deine Ideen.

Das bieten wir dir

  • 100 % Homeoffice arbeiten.

  • Einen überschaubaren Umfang von 20–30 Stunden pro Monat, gut neben dem Studium.

  • Raum für eigene Ideen und die Möglichkeit, unsere Werbegrafiken mitzugestalten.

  • Praktische Erfahrung im Grafikdesign für digitale Werbung und im Einsatz von KI-Tools.

  • Vergütung zum jeweils geltenden gesetzlichen Mindestlohn.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten

Vergütung

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über das Sachverständigenbüro Limpert GmbH

Das Sachverständigenbüro Limpert GmbH ist ein spezialisiertes Unternehmen in den Bereichen Schadensregulierung und versicherungsmathematische Dienstleistungen in Reckendorf. In unserem kleinen Team arbeiten wir eng zusammen, um präzise und zuverlässige Ergebnisse für unsere Kunden zu erzielen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Schnittstelle zwischen Projekten und IT: Sie analysieren bestehende Projektabläufe und gestalten deren Integration in innovative IT-Systeme

  • KI-Integration: Sie identifizieren und implementieren KI-Lösungen zur Prozesserleichterung und Automatisierung

  • Betreuung und Ausbau bestehender Systeme:

  • CAS CRM

  • Microsoft SharePoint

  • AutoiXpert

  • BookStack

  • Microsoft Office 365

  • Serverlandschaft & Infrastruktur: Wartung und Störungsbehebung von

  • Terminalserver

  • NAS

  • Ubiquiti-Netzwerkumgebung

  • Telefonanlage (Innovaphone)

  • Client-Management: Verwaltung und Support der Hardware-Clients unserer Nutzer:innen

  • Überwachung und Umsetzung von IT-Sicherheit

Ihr Profil

  • Abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung (z. B. Fachinformatiker:in Systemintegration, Informatikstudium o. Ä.)

  • Berufserfahrung im Umgang mit den o. g. bzw. vergleichbaren Systemen

  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von KI-Lösungen in Geschäftsprozessen von Vorteil

  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise und Kommunikationsstärke

  • Serviceorientierung und Freude an der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachabteilungen

Ihre Vorteile

  • Profitieren Sie von einer privaten Krankenzusatzversicherung, einer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sowie regelmäßigen Gutscheinen und Mitarbeiterrabatten.

  • Nutzen Sie flexible Arbeitszeiten, die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice und Remote-Arbeiten sowie eine vollständige Home-Office-Ausstattung.

  • Freuen Sie sich auf 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr sowie zusätzliche Urlaubstage und bezahlte Freistellungen zur Angehörigenpflege.

  • Wir unterstützen Ihre berufliche Bildung.

  • Der Arbeitsplatz ist barrierefrei zugänglich.

  • Sie erhalten ein Firmenhandy und einen Firmenlaptop für Ihre tägliche Arbeit.

  • Erleben Sie eine lockere Kleiderordnung und regelmäßige Teamevents sowie Firmenfeiern.

In den ersten Monaten lernen Sie unsere IT-Infrastruktur im Detail kennen und übernehmen schrittweise die Betreuung der Systeme. Sie arbeiten sich in unsere internen Abläufe ein und unterstützen das Team bei ersten technischen Projekten.

jobs.title: Product Engineer (Frontend) (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Hi, we are Particula, the prime rating provider for digital assets! Our mission? To make the market for digital assets more accessible, secure and transparent for institutional investors. We support issuers, trading facilities, banks and asset managers to create trust, minimize risks and allocate capital effectively. Join our team and shape the future of the financial world with us!

👋 About the Role

We are looking for a product engineer to own our user-facing applications end to end. We operate without dedicated designers or product managers. You will work directly with internal and external stakeholders as well as backend & AI engineers to turn high-level goals into shipped, well-measured features.

This is not a ticket-closing role. You spot user friction, propose a fix, build it, measure the outcome and iterate quickly.

You will also help shape how we build software with AI agents, translating requirements into working code and establishing the guardrails, automated tests and review habits that keep quality high when code is AI-assisted. You remain responsible for every line you ship, whether you or an agent wrote it.

What you will do

  • Ship features end to end: Take concepts from conversation to production, covering UX design, frontend implementation, API integration and deployment.

  • Act as a product builder: Spot friction points yourself, pitch improvements and make sure every feature solves a real user need.

  • Make decisions with data: Implement analytics, track feature adoption and iterate on the numbers.

  • Work directly with users: Talk to internal teams as well as external stakeholders, and turn unstructured feedback into clear technical plans.

  • Own AI-assisted delivery: Use and orchestrate coding agents daily. Write the specs and plans, choose the patterns and approach, and review generated code before you push it.

  • Review your peers' work: Be one of the main reviewers of frontend pull requests, and keep a balance between delivering working functionality and keeping the review workload manageable.

  • Own the design system: Maintain and extend the shared component library and UI guidelines so the product stays consistent. An external design agency will help set the visual language.

  • Own quality and testing: Propose and set up the QA and testing strategy for your area, using automated E2E and component tests to ensure reliability, performance and security.

How we work

These are fixed parts of the job, and we ask candidates to read them as requirements.

  • Delivery process: Work follows a defined delivery process. Inside it, you own the open decisions in your area, including solution design and implementation approach.

  • Decision rights: Architecture, API contracts and design system direction are set centrally because they are shared across teams. You change them through a written proposal. Once a decision is made, everyone follows it. Backend engineers own the security and performance of services.

  • Team rhythm: A daily stand-up and a biweekly Friday demo. Attendance is expected.

  • Speed: We ship small and often and iterate on the interface quickly. Quality comes from tests and reviews, not from polishing before release.

Requirements

Must have

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering, with evidence of owned product work: features you took from problem to production and measured. Experience in a fast-paced startup is a plus.

  • Strong frontend expertise: Deep proficiency in TypeScript and a modern component framework (Vue 3 / Nuxt preferred).

  • Product and UX sense: A track record of designing clean, functional interfaces and delivering features without dedicated PMs or designers.

  • Data-driven mindset: Hands-on experience setting up and using analytics tools (PostHog, Amplitude, Mixpanel or similar).

  • Daily use of AI coding agents: Active experience with agentic tools (Claude Code, Copilot), a clear method for guiding them, and a clear method for checking what they produce.

  • Testing and review habits: Experience with automated E2E and UI testing (Playwright, Cypress, Vitest), the ability to define a testing strategy, and the discipline to review code, yours and others', before it merges.

  • Clear communication: Fluent written and spoken English, comfortable presenting ideas to non-technical stakeholders and working through written proposals.

Strong plus

  • Domain background: Prior experience in fintech, Web3 / digital assets or data-driven products.

  • Design systems: Experience building or maintaining a component library.

  • Backend / BFF capability: Experience building APIs and BFF layers, ideally with PHP / Laravel.

  • Cloud and DevOps: Practical experience with AWS environments, deployments and observability.

  • AI tooling workflow: Experience creating agent skills or CI guardrails for AI-assisted development.

Our stack

TypeScript · Vue 3 · Nuxt · PHP · Laravel · AWS · AI-assisted development workflows

Benefits

  • Offsites with the team in exciting locations

  • Flexible working hours in a company that relies on remote work

  • Exciting product in a very dynamic market environment as well as founding-level ownership of a key growth function.

  • Values-based start-up culture

  • Many opportunities to develop further and network with committed people

  • Flat hierarchy

We're a hybrid company building our core development team in Europe around Central European Time. The goal is to establish a hub around Munich, Germany.

Let’s build the next layer of trust for digital assets - together!

jobs.title: Bauleitung / Objektüberwachung HLS (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über die TeGA-PLAN Heidemann GmbH

Die TeGA-PLAN Heidemann GmbH ist ein unabhängiges Ingenieurbüro für Technische Gebäudeausrüstung mit Sitz in Kiel. Mit rund 30 Kolleginnen und Kollegen planen und begleiten wir spannende und anspruchsvolle Bauprojekte – von der ersten Idee bis zur fertigen Umsetzung.

Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen in der Heizungs-, Lüftungs-, Sanitär- und Elektrotechnik sowie der Gebäudeautomation. Dabei sind unsere Projekte so vielfältig wie unser Team: Ob Forschungs- und Laborgebäude, Gesundheitseinrichtungen, Wohnungsbau, Büro- und Verwaltungsgebäude oder komplexe Industrieanlagen – wir entwickeln technische Lösungen für unterschiedlichste Anforderungen.

Was uns antreibt? Technik sinnvoll einsetzen, statt sie unnötig kompliziert zu machen. Wir legen Wert auf durchdachte, wirtschaftliche und energieeffiziente Lösungen und verfolgen dabei einen klaren Grundsatz: So viel Technik wie nötig, so wenig wie möglich.

Als unabhängiges Ingenieurbüro setzen wir auf fachliche Kompetenz, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein kollegiales Miteinander. Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was wir gemeinsam erreichen, sondern ganz besonders auch, wie wir miteinander arbeiten!

Deine Aufgaben - hier gestaltest du mit:

  • Du bringst unsere Planungen in die Praxis: Als Bauleiter (m/w/d) begleitest du anspruchsvolle Projekte der Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Sanitärtechnik und sorgst dafür, dass aus guten Konzepten funktionierende Anlagen werden.

  • Du hältst auf der Baustelle die Fäden zusammen: Du koordinierst die beteiligten Gewerke, stimmst dich direkt mit Bauherren, Architekten und ausführenden Unternehmen ab und findest gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen für die Herausforderungen im Baualltag.

  • Du behältst den Überblick: Qualität, Termine und Kosten hast du im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte fachgerecht und erfolgreich umgesetzt werden.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du weißt, wovon du sprichst: Ob Ingenieur, Techniker oder Meister – du hast eine passende Qualifikation im Bereich der Technischen Gebäudeausrüstung und kennst dich mit Heizungs-, Lüftungs- und Sanitärtechnik aus.

  • Du kennst das Baustellenleben: Du bringst Erfahrung in der Bauleitung oder Objektüberwachung mit, weißt, worauf es bei der Umsetzung ankommt, und findest auch dann Lösungen, wenn es mal nicht nach Plan läuft.

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung: Du arbeitest eigenständig, triffst Entscheidungen und vertrittst deine Standpunkte mit fachlicher Kompetenz und einem sicheren Auftreten – ohne dabei das partnerschaftliche Miteinander aus den Augen zu verlieren.

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

Wir finden, dass gute Arbeit auch ein gutes Arbeitsumfeld verdient. Deshalb setzen wir auf Vertrauen, Flexibilität und ein Miteinander, bei dem sich alle wohlfühlen können.

  • Arbeiten, wie es zu deinem Leben passt: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice geben dir den Freiraum, den du brauchst.

  • Gut ausgestattet und mobil: Firmenwagen, Smartphone und Laptop gehören ebenso dazu wie die Möglichkeit zum Bike-Leasing und Zuschüsse für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel.

  • Gemeinsam wachsen: Wir unterstützen deine fachliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung durch Fortbildungen, gegenseitigen Wissensaustausch und die Erfahrung deiner Kolleginnen und Kollegen.

  • Wohlfühlen statt Kleiderordnung: Bei uns zählt, was du kannst, nicht was du trägst. Dich erwarten ein barrierefreies Büro, kostenlose Getränke und Snacks. Auch vierbeinige Begleiter sind willkommen.

  • Mehr als nur ein Arbeitsplatz: Mit Fitnessangeboten, Mitarbeitervorteilen und gemeinsamen Teamevents sorgen wir dafür, dass auch abseits der Projekte etwas geboten wird.

  • Ein Team, das zusammenhält: Kurze Wege, offene Türen, ein unkomplizierter Umgang miteinander und Kolleginnen und Kollegen, die sich gegenseitig unterstützen, gehören bei uns einfach dazu.

Deine Erfahrung ist uns etwas wert!

Bei uns erwartet dich ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 60.000 und 85.000 € brutto – abhängig von deiner Qualifikation, deiner Erfahrung und der Verantwortung, die du übernimmst. Was du mitbringst, zählt – und das soll sich auch in deinem Gehalt widerspiegeln.

Dein Start bei uns – gemeinsam von Anfang an!

Wir lassen dich nicht ins kalte Wasser springen. Du lernst unser Team, unsere Arbeitsweise und unsere spannenden Projekte in Kiel und Umgebung kennen. Dabei stehen dir erfahrene Kolleginnen und Kollegen zur Seite, die dich bei deinem Einstieg unterstützen.

Schritt für Schritt übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine eigenen Baustellen und wirst Teil eines Teams, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt und gemeinsam Lösungen findet.

Du erfüllst nicht jede Anforderung? Kein Problem! Für uns zählen nicht nur Zeugnisse und Lebensläufe, sondern vor allem deine Erfahrung, deine Persönlichkeit und die Lust, gemeinsam mit uns etwas zu bewegen. Wenn du glaubst, dass du zu uns passt, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!
