jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionText: <p><strong>Mission Brief</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>You are the guardian and the challenger of our security posture. At Isar Aerospace, the systems that build our rockets and the ground systems that launch them are mission critical, and protecting them takes more than good design. It takes someone who will attack their own work to be sure it holds.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are looking for a deeply hands-on Senior Security Engineer. You live in the consoles, the rule sets and the code. You own our secure access and network security controls, our endpoint and identity security stack, and our detection content, and you operate them yourself rather than directing from the sidelines. You wear two hats: the Builder who implements and runs the controls that keep us safe, and the Adversary who keeps testing whether those controls and detections actually fire.&nbsp;</p> <p>This is a senior engineering role with the spirit of an architect. You are expected to design what you operate, not just configure it: pick the pattern, write it down, and make it hold at fleet scale. A versatile engineer with real depth, comfortable switching from a firewall rule set to a detection query to a directory hardening sprint in the same week, and a technical anchor others lean on.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Your Role in Our Space Mission</strong>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>SASE and Network Security</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own and operate our SASE platform</strong>, including revamping Internet Security policies and redefining Private Access policies.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Drive firewall security with the network team: </strong>own network security engineering and segmentation strategy, analyze rule sets, identify gaps, and see remediation through together with network engineering, who own the devices.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Coordinate firewall-adjacent controls: </strong>IPS, AV, sandboxing and DDoS protection.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Manage our DNS security and WAF solutions</strong>, including our edge and CDN-based protection services.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Security Posture and Hardening</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Apply CIS Benchmarks </strong>to raise posture across firewalls, endpoints, our cloud identity platform and our cloud productivity suite.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Lead the clean-up and hardening of our on-premises and cloud identity directories </strong>together with the infrastructure team, then keep both hardened on an ongoing basis.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Drive our phishing-resistant MFA and privileged access programme, </strong>including just-in-time elevation and the remediation of the attack paths we find.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Own certificate lifecycle and PKI operations: </strong>key ceremonies, automated renewal, and input to our post-quantum migration plan.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Detection and Visibility</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Manage and tune our IPS/IDS platforms; </strong>write and maintain custom IDS signatures, and operate network sensors for NTA appliances.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Build and maintain detections in our SIEM </strong>and apply MITRE ATT&amp;CK to detection engineering and use-case design in support of the SOC.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Extend visibility into OT </strong>with purpose-built OT monitoring tooling.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Act as an L3 incident responder </strong>for escalated security events, and turn every finding into a fix, a new detection or a hardened configuration.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Security Stack and Automation</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own our endpoint detection and response, data protection and CASB platforms</strong> as their technical owner.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Script and build internal tooling </strong>in PowerShell and Python, so controls and checks run themselves.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Design and Engineering Partnership</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Design what you operate: </strong>run threat modeling and attack-path analysis on the systems you own, choose the pattern, and document standards others can execute against.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Evaluate tooling and support vendor selection </strong>and renewal decisions in your domain, with a clear view of what each control costs us and what it buys.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Embed security with engineering: </strong>partner with IT, infrastructure, manufacturing and mission teams to implement and validate controls in their environments across both IT and OT, respecting launch-window and change-freeze constraints and producing the evidence our audits depend on.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualification Checklist</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience: </strong>10+ years in security engineering, with real ownership of production security tooling, not policy or advisory work.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Architect Spirit: </strong>you can step back from the console, design the target state, write the pattern down, and then go build it yourself.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>SASE: </strong>hands-on experience administering an enterprise SASE platform end to end, not just consuming it.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Hardening: </strong>experience applying CIS Benchmarks to firewalls, endpoints, cloud identity and cloud productivity platforms in production, plus experience rolling out phishing-resistant MFA or privileged access management.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Networking and Firewalls: </strong>solid fundamentals, enough to own segmentation strategy and to drive rule set analysis and gap remediation with a network team that owns the devices. Experience with CDN-based WAF and edge protection services.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Security Stack Depth: </strong>strong background across endpoint detection and response, data protection, SIEM and detection query languages, cloud identity and on-premises directory hardening, certificate lifecycle and PKI operations, ideally including a large-scale directory clean-up or remediation effort.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Detection Engineering: </strong>practical MITRE ATT&amp;CK-driven detection work, and experience writing custom IDS/IPS signatures.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Operational Depth: </strong>strong capability in detection, incident response and vulnerability management, with time spent on escalated incidents.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Automation: </strong>scripting ability in PowerShell and Python, plus infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code experience.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>IT and OT: </strong>comfortable working across both. Working knowledge of OT protocols such as EtherNet/IP, OPC UA and Modbus, and familiarity with OT network monitoring, is a strong plus.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Autonomy: </strong>operates with very high autonomy as an internal expert, taking full ownership of their work and guiding others.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Mentoring: </strong>mentors engineers and analysts on the team, and acts as technical lead in cross-functional projects.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Communication: </strong>clear communication and collaboration skills, able to translate technical risk for a range of audiences and to work controls through other teams.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li><strong>Education: </strong>Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or the equivalent through relevant certifications and hands-on experience.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Skills</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Experience in aerospace, defense, energy, manufacturing or other OT-heavy, safety-critical environments.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Prior SOC or incident response team experience.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Cloud security depth in a major public cloud and its native security services.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Familiarity with industry standards such as ISO 27001 and NIST.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Relevant certifications, defensive or engineering (e.g., Security+, GCIA) and offensive (e.g., OSCP or equivalent), are both valued.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Real Ownership: the security tooling that protects a premier European space company is yours to run, rebuild and prove.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Impact: the opportunity to directly protect the future of spaceflight as we approach our first orbital launch.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Collaboration: work hand-in-hand with brilliant engineers and IT professionals on genuinely hard problems.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong><span lang="EN-US">Benefits&nbsp;</span></strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Employee Participation Program: </strong>Share in our success through our virtual company share program</li> <li><strong>6 weeks of vacation:</strong> Enjoy the days off to relax and recharge</li> <li><strong>Subsidised lunch:</strong> Stay energised with delicious, subsidised lunches every day</li> <li><strong>Relocation support:</strong> Benefit from our relocation bonus with deductible expenses up to an agreed amount</li> <li><strong>Wellness allowance:</strong> Stay healthy and fit with our yearly allowance for wellness activities (e.g., Gym, Massages)</li> <li><strong>Individual learning allowance:</strong> Grow your skills with an individual learning budget granted after the family</li> <li><strong>And Much More!</strong> Discover additional perks and benefits when you join our team. &nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><span lang="EN-US">Who we are</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span lang="EN-US"><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/jW2V5vsMb_k" width="560" height="314"></iframe></span></strong></p> <p><span lang="EN-US">We are Isar Aerospace and we are at jobs.title: Senior Manager - Global Product Ops Excellence (All Genders)
jobs.descriptionText: <h2><strong>The role</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;">From day one you’ll enable international coordination and implementation of strategic product priorities by creating, standardising and optimising processes across central and local physical product teams and other stakeholders. The role will require a mix of process improvement, change management, technical understanding, project management and stakeholder management skills. Not only will you be an ambassador of Product Operations Excellence, but also champion the value of process automation and optimization, to set a solid basis for growth.</p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Above all, we are looking for people who will <strong>make HelloFresh</strong> <strong>better.</strong> We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.</span></p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Shape the operating model:</strong> Diagnose end-to-end processes across central and local Product teams and adjacent functions (Procurement, FSQA, Production).&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Design and scale standards:</strong> Own process frameworks, SOPs and rollout "golden standards" that teams across markets adopt. Challenge and iterate existing policies and guidelines when they no longer fit the business.</li> <li><strong>Lead cross-market change:</strong> Drive organizational change across markets and functions, balancing central consistency with local needs. Build alignment with senior stakeholders, resolve conflicts, and ensure a constant flow of information.</li> <li><strong>Lead programs and automation:</strong> Own complex automation and tooling initiatives from a commercial perspective. Sign off on tooling designs and business cases, guide Tech teams on scope, edge cases and interdependencies, and take part in Steering Committees. On top of that, identify where AI can reshape Product Operations processes, build the business cases and prototypes, and deploy the successful tools across markets and teams.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Lead under uncertainty:</strong> Scope and drive short- and long-term programs from broadly defined outcomes. Develop plan Bs and alternative solutions when priorities shift, and turn ambiguous problems into manageable, measurable workstreams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>5+ years minimum experience in Product Operations or Operational/Process Excellence; passion for food or experience within Food/FMCG industry or consultancy is a plus</li> <li>Recognized expertise in process excellence, change management and program delivery, with advanced knowledge of methodologies, current best practices and industry trends. You continuously challenge the status quo and bring new ideas to life.</li> <li>Highly numerate and commercially minded, able to build rigorous, objective business cases and to judge technical designs with confidence.</li> <li>A strong stakeholder leader who manages global and local stakeholders at all levels, aligns teams across markets, and communicates clearly to different audiences.</li> <li>Autonomous and outcome-driven: you manage scope and timelines independently, prioritize relentlessly, and are comfortable being challenged on the soundness of your work.</li> <li>Thrives in a fast-paced, demanding and data-driven environment.&nbsp;</li> <li>Curious about AI and automation: you actively explore how AI can reshape processes, assess its impact rigorously, and lead teams to adopt it where it creates measurable value.</li> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree from a top-tier university, preferably in business, management, operations or a related field. Six Sigma Belt or PMP certification is a big plus.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <p>Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.</p> <ul> <li>2 years contract.</li> <li>Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.</li> <li>Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.</li> <li>Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.</li> <li>Invest in your growth with an annual learning &amp; development budget, German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.</li> <li>Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!</li> </ul> <h2 style="text-align: justify;"><strong>About HelloFresh</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">HelloFresh is on a mission to change the way people eat, forever!</span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Since our 2011 founding in Europe’s vibrant tech hub, Berlin, we’ve become the world's leading meal kit provider, delivering to over 4.2 million households worldwide in 15 countries across 3 continents.&nbsp;</span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Our more than 15,000 employees from over 70+ nationalities are the heart and soul of our diverse, fast-paced and dynamic environment where innovation and smart, fast action is encouraged.&nbsp;</span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">We will encourage you to make an immediate impact in your area of work as well as empower you to grow your career with us.</span></p> <h2><strong>Are you up for the challenge?</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please submit your complete application below including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.</span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within 5 business days.&nbsp;</span></p> <h2><strong>We are HelloFresh</strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">At HelloFresh we embrace and welcome diversity and we currently employ over 15,000 individuals globally who contribute to this. We employ individuals based on their ability to perform a job rather than on the basis of their: race, national origin, color, caste, social origin or position, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, political opinion, marital status or any other characteristic. We encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunity employer – everyone is welcome at our table.</span></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Operations Technology (All Genders)
jobs.descriptionText: <h2>About the role: What's in the Box</h2> <p>The Logistics Tribe builds the systems powering end-to-end delivery across North America, Europe and Australia/New Zealand: getting fresh ingredients into our facilities, giving customers the best delivery options the network can support, and tracking every box to the customer's door. Today it is a single engineering team - two staff engineers, a data engineer and seven mid-to-senior engineers - led by the Director of Engineering, owning that software and keeping it running in production. You will join as an Engineering Manager and take line management of the seven.</p> <p>The work is operations-heavy and business-critical, spread across different subdomains. You won't own a fixed backlog in one corner of the domain; the team's scope follows where the business pressure is. That is reflected in how we work: rather than one fixed squad, the team organises into small, project-focused pods that form and dissolve as projects start and finish. In a typical sprint, your engineers might be spread across three projects with three different product managers.</p> <p>Strategy and technical direction are things we shape together - staff engineers, product managers and you all contributing, nobody working from a script handed down. You own the people and the delivery of your engineers.</p> <p>The role reports to the Director of Engineering for Logistics Tech; your team is spread across two geographies.</p> <h2>What you'll do: The Recipe</h2> <ul> <li>Lead and grow a team of mid-to-senior engineers: set clear expectations, give regular and honest feedback, and own their development - including building the case when someone is ready for the next level.</li> <li>Own the people and stay technical. This role carries real hands-on expectations - you still deliver code yourself, not management at a distance.</li> <li>Keep raising the team's AI bar: role-model it in your own work, and push the workflows where AI genuinely changes how fast we deliver.</li> <li>Make our project-based way of working work for people. You lead project staffing with the Director of Engineering and the product managers, putting engineers where the work and their growth both fit. You limit how many projects anyone carries, and you keep handovers clean so nobody becomes a single point of failure.</li> <li>Own the delivery health of your team's work together with the product managers and the engineers leading each project: realistic plans, sound quality, and systems that stay reliable once shipped.</li> <li>Hire and onboard well - you'll be building the team's balance of skills as projects and domains shift under you.</li> <li>Champion the engineering practices we care about: behaviour-driven tests for every business use case, and small iterations.</li> <li>Help shape tribe culture as part of the leadership team, in a setup that is deliberately flat and collaborative.</li> </ul> <h2>What you'll bring: The Ingredients</h2> <ul> <li>At least 2 years leading mid-to-senior engineers in an agile environment, backed by 6+ years of total engineering experience - you've run development and growth conversations and seen people through to promotion.</li> <li>Comfort leading people through changing project boundaries - this is a team that reforms around projects, not one that sits still.</li> <li>A backend-leaning technical grounding - event-driven microservices, Kubernetes, Kafka, relational databases, CI/CD - with real BDD/TDD habits that make large refactorings safe. You don't need to be the deepest engineer in the room, but you need to earn the team's respect.</li> <li>Daily, practical experience building with AI tooling: you've shipped real work with it, you know where it fails, and you learn as readily from others as they learn from you.</li> <li>A product-oriented mindset: you can reason about the business problem, prioritise for customer impact, and push back on low-value scope.</li> <li>Genuine interest in physical-world and supply-chain problems. You want to understand how the operation actually works; logistics or carrier integration experience is a plus.</li> </ul> <p>Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don't "tick all the boxes" but think you'd thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.</p> <h2><strong>What we offer</strong></h2> <p>Elevate your lifestyle! Join one of Europe's fastest-growing tech powerhouses in a dynamic phase of expansion.</p> <ul> <li>Immerse yourself in a diverse global community of 90+ nationalities.</li> <li>Enjoy a competitive compensation package that goes beyond the norm, with perks like a HelloFresh- subsidized Pension Scheme, Berlin relocation support, and a Hybrid working model.</li> <li>Elevate your lifestyle with exclusive discounts on your weekly HelloFresh box and office meals.</li> <li>Invest in your growth with a German language learning budget, and access to the HelloFresh Academy.</li> <li>Plus, we've got your well-being covered with mental health support, transportation perks, and working-parent-friendly benefits. From our 24/7 gym access,wellbeing platforms like Headspace and Spill, to sabbatical leave options, HelloFresh is not just a workplace; it's a lifestyle of perks and possibilities!</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Director of Engineering, Communications
jobs.descriptionText: <h2 id="the-communications-tribe">The Communications Tribe</h2> <p>The Communications Tribe is part of HelloFresh's Growth Alliance. Our mission is to enable a highly personalised, automated CRM communication ecosystem that prioritises user-centric engagement across our owned channels: email, push, SMS, in-app and embedded.</p> <p>The problems we are solving:</p> <ul> <li>How anyone with a good reason to speak to customers can do it safely and in minutes.</li> <li>How we make sure every customer gets the right message, at the right moment, through the right channel, so that our communication is truly personal.</li> <li>How we move to an autonomous, self-optimising system that continuously learns from every past interaction and gets better with each send.</li> <li>How we make sure we can reach our customers in their preferred channels.</li> </ul> <p>Our vision is to decentralise how HelloFresh talks to people across the whole relationship with us: prospects, subscribers and those who have left. Setting up and steering communications stops being the job of a small group of specialists and becomes something teams across the business can do safely, on top of tools and an intelligence layer that we build and that learn from every send. That loop reaches beyond CRM, so the customer experience is coherent from the first ad someone sees to the communication that converts and retains them.</p> <p>As Director of Engineering, Communications, you will lead the engineering organisation that makes this real. You will set technical direction, hold the bar for reliability and operational excellence, and partner with Product, Marketing and CRM teams to turn the vision into working systems.</p> <h2 id="what-youll-do">What you'll do</h2> <ul> <li>Lead the Communications engineering organisation through a layer of Engineering Leads and Staff Engineers, across Berlin and Warsaw.</li> <li>Own the technical strategy for an autonomous, self-optimising communication system that learns from every interaction, and turn it into reality together with Product, Marketing and CRM teams.</li> <li>Drive the move to true personalisation, so that every person we talk to gets the right message, at the right moment, through the right channel.</li> <li>Build platforms that let teams across the business create and steer communications safely and on their own, inside clear guardrails.</li> <li>Own the reliability and operational excellence of every system we run: SLOs, monitoring and alerting, incident management and on-call maturity, so that problems are caught before anyone downstream notices.</li> <li>Expand our reach into new channels, from early experiments to scaled solutions, based on how people actually want to hear from us.</li> <li>Lead our transformation into a GenAI-native engineering organisation, from AI-assisted development to agentic workflows embedded in everyday operations.</li> <li>Manage, coach and develop Engineering Leads and Staff Engineers, holding them accountable for team health, delivery and engineering standards.</li> <li>Navigate organisational change with maturity, keeping teams focused and motivated as priorities evolve.</li> </ul> <h2 id="what-youll-bring">What you'll bring</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Proven leadership at scale.</strong> 10+ years in software engineering, with 4+ years managing Engineering Managers or Leads. You have led teams across multiple offices and built trust without daily co-location.</li> <li><strong>Deep technical credibility.</strong> You can set direction for large-scale backend, data and event-driven systems, and you understand how applied machine learning and automated decisioning behave in production.</li> <li><strong>Platform thinking.</strong> A track record of building self-service platforms that enable non-engineers to work safely and quickly, including the governance and guardrails that make that possible.</li> <li><strong>AI-native leadership.</strong> You have built or scaled AI-native engineering practices and AI-driven products, not just adopted AI tools.</li> <li><strong>Operational excellence mindset.</strong> Strong grounding in SRE practices: SLOs and SLIs, observability, incident management and on-call culture for systems that directly touch customers.</li> <li><strong>Customer communication or personalisation domain fluency</strong>, or a strong aptitude to build it quickly. Experience with CRM, messaging, customer data or personalisation systems, and with measuring impact through experimentation, is a strong plus.</li> <li><strong>Cross-functional collaboration.</strong> You work comfortably with Product, Marketing and CRM teams, and translate business outcomes into engineering priorities and back.</li> <li><strong>Clear communication across disciplines</strong>, from engineers to senior business stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Low ego, high ownership, and a bias toward clarity over complexity.</strong></li> </ul> <h2 id="nice-to-have">Nice to have</h2> <ul> <li>Experience taking a newly modernised platform from rollout to stable, self-service operation at scale.</li> <li>Experience building or scaling AI agents that make customer-facing decisions, with impact measured against a control group.</li> <li>Familiarity with consent, privacy and deliverability requirements for customer communication across multiple countries.</li> <li>A background in subscription, e-commerce or consumer businesses operating in many markets.</li> <li>Experience introducing new messaging channels, including conversational ones.<br><br></li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li>Enjoy a discount on HelloFresh meal kits, delivered straight to your door.</li> <li>Build for the long-term with our company pension scheme (not available for interns/working students).</li> <li>Benefit from discounted memberships with Urban Sports Club and John Reed, yoga classes, and access to Headspace and Spill.</li> <li>Balance your work and life with flexible hours, Work From Home/Abroad options, and a home office setup budget.</li> <li>Receive childcare support (not available for interns/working students).</li> <li>Get a monthly allowance for the Deutschlandticket to support sustainable commuting.</li> <li>Embrace "Learning Never Stops" with access to internal trainings and a central L&amp;D budget (remove for interns).</li> <li>Work from a modern, comfortable office in Berlin-Kreuzberg and enjoy social events like team outings, Friday beers, and company runs.</li> </ul> <div data-ldoc-pending="" data-intent="What we offer and how we jobs.descriptionText: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners &nbsp;with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.</span><br><br></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">WHY JOIN US</span></strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&amp;D backing.</span></li> </ul></div><p><strong>ABOUT THE TEAM</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer (All Genders) to serve as the technical face of Minerva Frontline to our internal hardware teams, pilot customers, and program partners. In this role, you will bring Frontline into new internal and customer projects, take ownership of technical integration, and build trust through technical excellence rather than project management. We support each other as a team and work closely across disciplines to achieve our mission.</p> <p>When something fails in the field, you will be on-site to diagnose and resolve the issue under time pressure, working directly alongside the customer.</p> <p><strong>YOUR MISSION</strong></p> <p>You will work at the intersection of software, hardware, and operational reality: setting up the C++ backend that orchestrates UAV swarms, integrating new platforms into live systems, and ensuring command-and-control processes function seamlessly in isolated, bandwidth-constrained tactical environments.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK</strong></p> <ul> <li>Install, configure, and commission Minerva Frontline in customer operational environments, working with edge hardware, restricted networks, and tactical infrastructure.</li> <li>Integrate new UAV platforms and features into the Frontline platform, serving as the technical on-site lead for complex system issues.</li> <li>Analyze and resolve real-time problems including swarm telemetry degradation, gRPC connectivity issues, and MAVLink command translation errors.</li> <li>Translate feedback from operators, pilots, and customers into concrete technical requirements, collaborating closely with engineering teams to implement improvements and platform integrations.</li> <li>Participate in flight tests and trial campaigns to validate that software commands are reliably and accurately executed by physical drones under field conditions.</li> <li>Develop custom tooling, scripts, diagnostic tools, and test environments to make deployments reproducible, efficient, and robust.</li> <li>Work directly with hardware engineers, drone platforms, and test equipment on regular deployments to customer sites and test grounds.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION</strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Systems Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>Strong proficiency in modern C++ (C++17/20/23) with proven experience reading, debugging, and customizing production C++ codebases.</li> <li>Hands-on experience building, deploying, and operating complex real-time distributed systems using technologies such as gRPC, Flatbuffers, WebSockets, MAVLink, or MAVSDK.</li> <li>Demonstrated track record of deploying software solutions to external customers and collaborating with hardware teams during flight tests and platform integrations.</li> <li>Willingness to travel regularly within Germany (up to 40%).</li> </ul> <p><strong>NICE TO HAVE</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with ROS / ROS 2, PX4, ArduPilot, or autonomous robotics systems.</li> <li>Previous experience in the defence sector, aerospace, or with military unmanned systems.</li> <li>Proficiency with containerization and CI/CD tools tailored for edge devices (Docker, Podman, Yocto, embedded Linux, systemd).</li> <li>Familiarity with tactical mesh networking, RF communications, or bandwidth-constrained radio link protocols.</li> <li>Active German / NATO security clearance or prior experience working in security-cleared environments.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your <strong>CV in English</strong>. We're looking forward to meeting you!</span></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>SECURITY CLEARANCE</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>EQUAL OPPORTUNITY</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>DATA PRIVACY STATEMENT</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This data privacy statement, which refers exclusively to data collected as part of the online application process, is to inform you about how your personal data that is collected as part of the online application process is handled at our end.</span></p> <p><strong>The controller</strong></p> <p>The controller under data protection law is:</p> <p>SKD SE</p> <p><strong>Französische Strasse 12, 10117 Berlin</strong></p> <p>Commercial register entry number: <strong>HRB 260878</strong></p> <p>Registration Court: Amtsgericht Charlottenburg</p> <p><strong>Data Protection officer:</strong> heyData GmbH, Schützenstraße 5, 10117 Berlin,<a href="http://www.heydata.eu"> www.heydata.eu</a>, ----- <p><em><strong>Personal data collected as part of the application process</strong></em></p> <p>Personal data means any information concerning the personal or material circumstances of an identified or identifiable individual. This includes information such as, for example, your name, address, telephone number and date of birth, but also data relating to your specific career etc. by reference to which a specific individual can be identified with reasonable effort. In this context, you transmit personal data, which we will use and store exclusively for the purpose of your job search / application process.</p> <p>In particular, the following data is collected during this process:</p> <ul> <li>name (first and last names)</li> <li>e-mail address</li> <li>phone number</li> <li>LinkedIn profile (optional)</li> <li>channel through which you found us</li> </ul> <p>Furthermore, you can choose to upload expressive documents such as a cover letter, your CV and reference letters. These may contain additional personal data such as date of birth, address etc.</p> <p>Only authorized HR staff and/or staff involved in the application process have access to your data.</p> <p>The personal data is stored, as a rule, exclusively for the purpose of filling the vacancy for which you have applied.</p> <p>Your data will be stored for a period of 180 days after the application process has been concluded. This is usually done to fulfill legal requirements and/or defending ourselves against any claims arising from legal provisions. After this period, we are obligated to delete or anonymize your data. In case of anonymization, the data will only be available to us in the form of so-called metadata, without any direct personal reference, for statistical analysis (for example, share of male and/or female applicants, number of applications per specified period of time etc.).</p> <p>Furthermore, we reserve the right to store your data for 180 days after the application process has been concluded for the purpose of adding it to our Talent Pool in order to identify any other vacancies that may be of interest to you. This includes, for example, applications for apprenticeships or internships. By accepting the data privacy statement, you consent to any further storage of your data as well as its inclusion in our Talent Pool.</p> <p>Should you be offered and accept a position with us during the application process, we will store the personal data collected as part of the application process for at least the duration of your employment.</p> <p><strong>Disclosure of data to third parties</strong></p> <p>Data transmitted as part of your application will be transferred using TLS encryption and stored in a database. This database is operated by Greenhouse, which offers a human resource and applicant management software solution (https://www.greenhouse.com/data-processing-addendum). In this context, Greenhouse is our processor under article 28 of the GDPR. In this case, the processing is based on an agreement for the processing of orders between us as the controller and Greenhouse.</p> <p><strong>Rights of data subjects</strong></p> <p>If we as the controller process personal data, you as the data subject have certain rights under Chapter III of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), depending on the legal basis and the purpose of the processing, in particular the right of access (article 15 of the GDPR) and the rights to rectification (article 16 of the GDPR), erasure (article 17 of the GDPR), restriction of processing (article 18 of the GDPR), and data portability (article 20 of the GDPR), as well as the right to object (article 21 of the GDPR). If the personal data is processed with your consent, you have the right to withdraw this consent under article 7 III of the GDPR.</p> <p>To assert your rights as a data subject in relation to the data processed during this online application process, please refer to our Data Protection Officer (see item 2).</p> <p><strong>Concluding provisions</strong></p> <p>We reserve the right to adjust this data privacy statement at any point in time to ensure that it is in line with the current legal requirements at all times, or in order to accommodate changes in the application process or other processes. In this case, the new data privacy statement applies to any later visit of this recruitment website or any later job application.<br><br></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>LEGAL NOTICE</strong></span></p> <h3>1. Information according to § 5 DDG</h3> <p>SKD SE<br>Französische Str. 12<br>10117 Berlin</p> <p><br>Internet: <a href="https://stark-defence.com/en/">www.stark-defence.com<br></a>E-Mail: ----- <p>SKD SE, Berlin (registered office of the company), is a Societas Europaea (legal form for joint stock companies), registered at the district court of Berlin (Charlottenburg) under the register number: HRB 260878 B, represented by the Executive Board: Uwe Horstmann, Dr. André Schneider, Johannes Schaback, Jan-Patrick Helmsen, Martin Rost.</p> <p>Chairman of the Supervisory Board is Mr. Robert Maier.</p> <p>VAT ID No.: DE369778559</p> <h3>2. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>DATA PRIVACY STATEMENT</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This data privacy statement, which refers exclusively to data collected as part of the online application process, is to inform you about how your personal data that is collected as part of the online application process is handled at our end.</span></p> <p><strong>The controller</strong></p> <p>The controller under data protection law is:</p> <p>SKD SE</p> <p><strong>Französische Strasse 12, 10117 Berlin</strong></p> <p>Commercial register entry number: <strong>HRB 260878</strong></p> <p>Registration Court: Amtsgericht Charlottenburg</p> <p><strong>Data Protection officer:</strong> heyData GmbH, Schützenstraße 5, 10117 Berlin,<a href="http://www.heydata.eu"> www.heydata.eu</a>, ----- <p><em><strong>Personal data collected as part of the application process</strong></em></p> <p>Personal data means any information concerning the personal or material circumstances of an identified or identifiable individual. jobs.descriptionHtml: <h3> </h3> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>The role of an Accountant at Canonical:</strong></h3> <p>If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and advance your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas and truly contribute to a highly productive team. </p> <p>We are looking for an exceptional Accountant with IFRS experience to help us ready the business for public market scrutiny through our planned IPO.  The right candidate will have domain expertise and a passion for IFRS.  </p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This role may be office based in London, or Remote in EMEA Time Zones. </p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Assist in the month end reporting process to deliver timely and accurate information</li> <li>Have full responsibility for a part of the ledger processes relevant to your strengths</li> <li>Assist with the year end audit process and statutory reporting</li> <li>Support the finance team's wider plans to prepare for an IPO</li> <li>Improve the efficiency of financial processes and procedures and monitor compliance</li> <li>Share knowledge between team members to ensure cover is available when needed</li> <li>Actively develop your own skills to ensure current knowledge of applicable standards and regulations</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with key colleagues outside the wider finance team</li> </ul> <h3>What we are looking for in you</h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record and subsequent career performance</li> <li>Bachelor's degree in Accounting or equivalent</li> <li>Qualified accountant (ACCA, ACA, ACMA, CPA, etc.)</li> <li>Experience at a large public accounting firm, or public multinational corporate accounting department preferred</li> <li>NetSuite or similar enterprise grade systems experience</li> <li>Willingness to travel up to four times per year</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <h3> </h3> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p> <h3> </h3>

jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>The role of an Accounts Payable Clerk at Canonical</strong></p> <p>We have an exciting opportunity for an Accounts Payable Clerk to join our growing team. If you are passionate about the technology industry and want to work for a company that aligns with your interests, we might be the place for you! Canonical, and our world class Ubuntu product, attracts some of the leading talent from around the world. Come and work with exceptional people and kick start your career in Finance! </p> <p>Our Finance team is growing and it's a really exciting time to join the team. We are looking for bright, truly motivated people who have a passion for making a difference. You will be seeking an opportunity to drive process improvements and change, input your ideas, grow your career and truly contribute to the team. </p> <p>Your role will include ensuring accuracy of the A/P ledgers, process supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, prepare supplier payments, deal with queries effectively and efficiently and maintain compliance with processes and procedures. You will learn the fundamentals of how finance works in an organisation.</p> <p>In return we will provide you with ample opportunity for career development including offering you with support for continuing education and the pursuit of professional Accounting certifications. You will report directly to our Global Controller who will help you develop into the role and guide you through your learnings.</p> <h3><strong>A day in the life of an Accounts Payable Clerk</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Maintain accuracy of our A/P ledgers and reconciliation of accounts</li> <li>Manage our vendor data (names, addresses, etc.), validate and gain approval for new accounts, and maintain our audit record of vendor data changes and approvals</li> <li>Process our supplier invoices in a timely and accurate manner, including entry of invoices into accounting systems and maintain our files in a tidy and organised manner</li> <li>Prepare our supplier payments in line with the payments timetable and presented for approval in a clear and organised format</li> <li>Identify payments properly withheld, monitored and released when approval given</li> <li>Help with our month end processes: prepayments, accruals, bank reconciliations and balance sheet reconciliations</li> <li>Resolve questions/issues, escalating when appropriate in a timely manner</li> <li>Maintain compliance with processes and procedures, recommend corrective action when identified and maintain suitable records to demonstrate compliance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you will bring to the role</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional education achievements in an Accounting or Finance subject</li> <li>Excellent spreadsheet skills, including pivots, look ups etc.</li> <li>Excellent attention to detail, with great organisation skills and the ability to meet deadlines</li> <li>Great communication skills that you will use when connecting directly with our customers</li> <li>A passion for the world of Finance with ambition to progress your career</li> <li>Experience using an exterprise level accounting system </li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer you</strong></h2> <p>Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits below, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.  </p> <p>In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.</p> <ul> <li>Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Parental Leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h2>About Canonical</h2> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <h2>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h2> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote </p>

In these roles, you will lead, build or scale one or more strategic partner motions for Canonical, either by managing a team or by directly driving high-impact partner initiatives. Depending on your experience and Canonical’s business priorities, your focus may include Channels, GSI, ISV, IHV/OEM, Silicon, Cloud or cross-ecosystem partnerships.</p> <p>Our Alliances and Channels teams build trusted relationships with partners at executive level, increase Canonical market share and attach rate, evangelise the partnership, and lead business interactions from engineers to CxO level. partners, sales, product management, product marketing and engineering teams</li> <li>Develop partner capability through sales engagement, technical enablement, joint marketing and disciplined business planning</li> <li>Guide our offering from product management, to product marketing, and scale it through the support of our global sales organisation</li> <li>Establish operating cadence, pipeline governance and data-driven accountability across complex partner relationships</li> </ul> <p>What we are looking for in you:</p> <ul> <li>10+ years of experience in alliance, channel, partner, ecosystem or indirect sales management roles</li> <li>Experience in one or more of GSIs, VARs, distributors, ISVs, IHVs/OEMs, silicon, public cloud, marketplaces or strategic technology alliances</li> <li>Deep commercial experience encompassing revenue, margins, pipeline, forecasting and partner economics</li> <li>Proven leadership and presentation skills, with the ability to engage confidently from engineer to CxO level</li> <li>Ability to build trusted executive relationships while aligning product, sales, marketing, engineering and operations teams</li> <li>Insight into open source, Ubuntu, enterprise infrastructure, cloud, AI, security and Canonical’s competition and opportunities</li> <li>Track record of data-driven decision-making and disciplined execution across complex, global relationships</li> <li>An autonomous, disciplined, hands-on, get-it-done mentality</li> <li>An exceptional academic track record from high school and university.</li> <li>Business level written and spoken English.</li> <li>Sincere personal motivation aligned with our mission.</li> <li>International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long.</li> </ul> <p>In addition we expect that you will match our values, by being:</p> <ul> <li>Precise, taking care to deliver correctness and clarity.</li> <li>Reliable, delivering high quality work that builds trust and confidence.</li> <li>Accessible, collaborating to build products and systems that are usable.</li> <li>Adroit, blending enthusiasm, knowledge, adaptability, style and character.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.<br></a></p>

jobs.title: Alliances Field Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring an <strong>Alliances Field Engineer</strong> to help our biggest partners (companies like Intel, Nvidia, Google, Dell, HP, Accenture, Tata and the like) understand and embrace our open source platform for themselves and their customers.</p> <p>Our worldwide field engineering team apply expert insights to real-world customer problems, enabling the enterprise adoption of Ubuntu, OpenStack, Kubernetes, AI/MLOps and a wide range of associated technologies. We are experts in the whole open source stack, from kernel to desktop, from cloud to the edge. Our team is also interested in business problems - building things reliably, efficiently and cost-effectively, and we have to learn to speak the language of our customers and their industries.</p> <p>We help global companies embrace public and private cloud infrastructure, cloud native operations, and open source applications. For this team we are looking for several Alliances Engineers to support OEM (hardware manufacturers), GSI (global system integrators), ISV (independent software vendors), Channel partners and Public Cloud alliance partners. You will support various alliances and partners of Canonical to adopt our products and technologies, help business leaders to define joint go-to-market programs with partners from the technical standpoint.</p> <p>We often say that our field engineers have 'the hardest job at Canonical' because customers can ask about any aspect of our solutions and products and expect a thoughtful, well-informed answer. We always want to do the best thing for our partners and customers, regardless of our company interests, and field engineers are the people we trust to ensure that is true.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: This is a home-based role, we are hiring worldwide.</p> <h3>What your day will look like</h3> <ul> <li>Understand Ubuntu, Linux, networking and services in real-world environments</li> <li>Architect cloud infrastructure solutions like Kubernetes, Kubeflow, OpenStack, Ceph, and Spark either On-Premises or in Public Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud)</li> <li>Architect and integrate popular open source software such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Kafka, Cassandra and NGINX</li> <li>Help partners to offer and architect joint solutions utilizing Canonical’s technologies on top of the public clouds and in the data center</li> <li>Design and publish joint Reference Architectures and perform technical validations with various partners</li> <li>Prepare and run onboarding sessions/workshops with various partners’ teams to promote Canonical products and solutions</li> </ul> <p>If you have a passion for the latest open source technologies, cloud-native development, data center technologies such as Kubernetes and computer networking, you will love the Alliances Engineer role at Canonical.</p> <h3>What we are looking for in you </h3> <ul> <li>Extensive experience with Linux (Ubuntu preferred), Kubernetes, Ceph, software automation</li> <li>Experience designing and implementing solutions on top of public or private clouds</li> <li>Python and bash understanding, troubleshooting skills</li> <li>Fluent written and spoken English</li> <li>Excellent communication and presentation skills</li> <li>High motivation, ability to multi-task and follow-up reliably on commitments</li> <li>Interest in customer-facing engagement, including pitching, demonstrating and understanding customer environment and needs</li> <li>Interest in new technologies like LXD, Juju and Snaps</li> <li>Ability to travel globally up to 30% of the time</li> <li>Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related technical field experience</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others</li> <li>Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.</p> <p>Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-Remote</p> <p> </p>

jobs.title: Associate Linux Support Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder led, profitable and growing.</p> <p>We are hiring an <strong>Associate Support Engineer</strong> to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. This role is an opportunity for a hands-on engineer with eagerness to learn, a passion for Linux and open source technologies to work with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.</p> <p>We regularly solve interesting, technical problems. From triaging complex cloud environments, desktop and server issues, Linux kernel crashes we’ve never seen before to OS configuration issues and root cause analysis, we provide an expert level of support and satisfaction to our peer groups and  customers. You will be accountable for delivering an outstanding technical support experience on the full technical stack at Canonical, across cloud, desktop and IoT. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers. This is a globally remote role.</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>This is a globally remote role.</p> <h3><strong>The role entails</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Working from your remote home office to provide technical support for employees.</li> <li>Being available to take ownership of new cases via telephone, email and web</li> <li>Acting as an internal customer advocate keeping them updated in a timely manner</li> <li>Ensuring that each support case owned by you is handled according to our Service Level Agreement (SLA) with the highest possible customer satisfaction by setting the right expectations and fulfilling your commitments.</li> <li>Contributing new knowledge base articles and maintaining existing articles, ensuring shared knowledge and lessons learned are available to customers.</li> <li>Drafting and distributing technical notices for internal and external communication.</li> <li>Prioritising your work in order to accomplish the most important and urgent tasks first</li> <li>Keeping on learning as our products and services grow and evolve</li> <li>Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix</li> <li>Maintaining regular communication and information exchange with the rest of the team, locally and remotely</li> <li>Identifying and suggesting any opportunities to provide a better service</li> <li>Participating in a regular weekend working rotation</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university</li> <li>Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path. Preferable majors: Computer Science, MIS, Electrical Engineering, etc.</li> <li>Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation</li> <li>Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results</li> <li>Experience with Linux troubleshooting (collecting logs and stack traces, fine-tuning by editing configuration files)</li> <li>Knowledge or basic hands-on experience on 2 or more of:</li> <ul> <li>Linux server administration</li> <li>Programming fundamentals in any language (bash, Perl, Ruby, Javascript, C or C++, Go)</li> <li>Networking (bonding, firewalling, bridging, switching, network file system tuning, MTU issues, etc.) </li> <li>Virtualization / Cloud computing concepts (provisioning, monitoring, orchestration, etc.)</li> </ul> <li>Ability to learn quickly, thrive on change and handle the pressure of a customer facing job</li> <li>Strong written and verbal English communication skills</li> <li>Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments </li> <li>Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <p>Noting that we require and will perform a background check for this role.</p> <h3><strong>Nice-to-have skills</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience supporting virtualized environments (KVM, Virtual Box, VMWare)</li> <li>Experience with other open-source desktop technologies</li> <li>Active contribution to open-source projects/forum/code</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p> <p>#LI-remote</p>
